units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|description|16|0
units.english: Travel with the Free Worlds militia to the <system> system and drive off the Navy fleet that is occupying the system.
units.italian: Viaggia con la milizia delle Free Worlds fino al sistema <system> e respingi la flotta della Marina che occupa il sistema.

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|The mood in the spaceport is solemn. No one has had time yet to count up the losses, on both sides of the battle, but it is likely that over a thousand lives were lost. And because the Navy is held in such high regard even here where Parliament and the Paradise Planets are viewed with disgust, many of the militia captains are almost as saddened by the loss of Navy lives as by the loss of some of their own.|28|0
units.english: The mood in the spaceport is solemn. No one has had time yet to count up the losses, on both sides of the battle, but it is likely that over a thousand lives were lost. And because the Navy is held in such high regard even here where Parliament and the Paradise Planets are viewed with disgust, many of the militia captains are almost as saddened by the loss of Navy lives as by the loss of some of their own.
units.italian: L'umore nello spazioporto è solenne. Nessuno ha ancora avuto il tempo di contare le perdite, da entrambe le parti della battaglia, ma è probabile che siano andate perse più di mille vite. E dato che la Marina è tenuta in così alta considerazione anche qui, dove il Parlamento e i Mondi Paradisiaci sono guardati con disgusto, molti capitani della milizia sono quasi altrettanto addolorati per la perdita di vite della Marina che per quella dei loro compagni.

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	You find Tomek walking among the fleet, conversing with a large group of captains and crew members and assessing the damage they have suffered. When he sees you he says, "Captain <last>! How is <ship> holding together?"|29|0
units.english: You find Tomek walking among the fleet, conversing with a large group of captains and crew members and assessing the damage they have suffered. When he sees you he says, "Captain <last>! How is <ship> holding together?"
units.italian: Trovi Tomek che cammina fra la flotta, parlando con un folto gruppo di capitani e membri dell'equipaggio e valutando i danni subiti. Quando ti vede dice: "Capitano <last>! Come sta la <ship>?"

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	"She took a bit of a pounding, but I've patched her up."|31|0
units.english: "She took a bit of a pounding, but I've patched her up."
units.italian: "Ha preso un bel po' di botte, ma l'ho rattoppata."

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	"Just fine. It'd take more than a few Carriers to destroy the <ship>."|32|0
units.english: "Just fine. It'd take more than a few Carriers to destroy the <ship>."
units.italian: "Benissimo. Ci vorrebbe più di qualche Carrier per distruggere la <ship>."

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	"Glad to hear it," he says before returning to the crowd. "Listen! We need to press our advantage before the Republic has time to call for reinforcements. If we strike quickly, we could be able to retake Kornephoros from them. It's important to break the blockade on that system for the sake of trade with the rest of the galaxy. And on top of that, if you were not aware, Councilor Katya Reynolds was on Clink when the Navy took the system and needs to be rescued." You hear some chatter coming from the crowd as a result of this news; it seems like Katya's investigation on Clink was not public knowledge.|34|0
units.english: "Glad to hear it," he says before returning to the crowd. "Listen! We need to press our advantage before the Republic has time to call for reinforcements. If we strike quickly, we could be able to retake Kornephoros from them. It's important to break the blockade on that system for the sake of trade with the rest of the galaxy. And on top of that, if you were not aware, Councilor Katya Reynolds was on Clink when the Navy took the system and needs to be rescued." You hear some chatter coming from the crowd as a result of this news; it seems like Katya's investigation on Clink was not public knowledge.
units.italian: "Sono contento di sentirlo," dice prima di tornare verso la folla. "Ascoltate! Dobbiamo sfruttare il nostro vantaggio prima che la Repubblica abbia il tempo di chiedere rinforzi. Se colpiamo in fretta, potremmo riprendere Kornephoros. È importante rompere il blocco su quel sistema, per il bene del commercio con il resto della galassia. E inoltre, se non lo sapete, la consigliera Katya Reynolds era su Clink quando la Marina ha preso il sistema e deve essere salvata." Senti un mormorio nella folla dopo questa notizia; sembra che l'indagine di Katya su Clink non fosse di pubblico dominio.

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	"We have a large fleet of reinforcements coming in from the Rim," Tomek continues, "and a few ships here that are able to fight another battle. I need you all to take off, wait for the reinforcements to arrive, and then retake Kornephoros. If the Navy ships retreat, let them retreat. If they surrender, let them surrender. If they stay and fight, disable them if you can. Destroy them only if you must. Am I understood?"|35|0
units.english: "We have a large fleet of reinforcements coming in from the Rim," Tomek continues, "and a few ships here that are able to fight another battle. I need you all to take off, wait for the reinforcements to arrive, and then retake Kornephoros. If the Navy ships retreat, let them retreat. If they surrender, let them surrender. If they stay and fight, disable them if you can. Destroy them only if you must. Am I understood?"
units.italian: "Abbiamo una grande flotta di rinforzi in arrivo dal Bordo," continua Tomek, "e qualche nave qui in grado di sostenere un'altra battaglia. Voglio che decolliate tutti, aspettiate l'arrivo dei rinforzi e poi riprendiate Kornephoros. Se le navi della Marina si ritirano, lasciatele ritirare. Se si arrendono, lasciatele arrendere. Se restano a combattere, mettetele fuori uso se potete. Distruggetele solo se dovete. Sono stato chiaro?"

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	"Yes sir!" the captains respond in unison.|36|0
units.english: "Yes sir!" the captains respond in unison.
units.italian: "Sissignore!" rispondono all'unisono i capitani.

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	"Then move out!" Tomek yells, prompting the captains and crew to scramble for their ships.|37|0
units.english: "Then move out!" Tomek yells, prompting the captains and crew to scramble for their ships.
units.italian: "Allora muovetevi!" urla Tomek, e i capitani e gli equipaggi si precipitano verso le loro navi.

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	Tomek returns to you after rousing the militia to action. "Still in this fight with us?"|38|0
units.english: Tomek returns to you after rousing the militia to action. "Still in this fight with us?"
units.italian: Tomek torna da te dopo aver spinto la milizia all'azione. "Sei ancora con noi in questa battaglia?"

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	"Yes, sir. I'll move out immediately."|40|0
units.english: "Yes, sir. I'll move out immediately."
units.italian: "Sì, signore. Mi muovo subito."

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	"I wish it hadn't come to this."|42|0
units.english: "I wish it hadn't come to this."
units.italian: "Vorrei che non si fosse arrivati a questo."

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	"We all do," he says. "No one wanted this. Not us, certainly not the Navy. But if they attack us to take our freedom, we must defend ourselves in order to keep it. Understood?"|44|0
units.english: "We all do," he says. "No one wanted this. Not us, certainly not the Navy. But if they attack us to take our freedom, we must defend ourselves in order to keep it. Understood?"
units.italian: "Lo vorremmo tutti," dice. "Nessuno voleva questa guerra. Non noi, e di certo non la Marina. Ma se ci attaccano per toglierci la libertà, dobbiamo difenderci per mantenerla. Capito?"

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	"Yes, sir. I'll prepare my ship for another battle."|46|0
units.english: "Yes, sir. I'll prepare my ship for another battle."
units.italian: "Sì, signore. Preparo la nave per un'altra battaglia."

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|dialog|123|0
units.english: There are still Navy ships patrolling overhead. Staying on <planet> while your allies are dying in orbit would be a very bad idea.
units.italian: Ci sono ancora navi della Marina che pattugliano là sopra. Restare su <planet> mentre i tuoi alleati muoiono in orbita sarebbe un'idea pessima.

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|log|126|0
units.english: The Free Worlds have retaken the Kornephoros system, with heavy losses on both sides. And unfortunately, there is no sign of Katya; she may have been taken prisoner by the Navy.
units.italian: Le Free Worlds hanno ripreso il sistema Kornephoros, con gravi perdite da entrambe le parti. E purtroppo non c'è traccia di Katya; potrebbe essere stata presa prigioniera dalla Marina.

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|The last of the Navy vessels in orbit has been subdued. As you land, you find that several Free Worlds troop transports have already set down in the spaceport and corralled the remaining Navy officers into a small circle. You would estimate that there are several hundred Navy prisoners. Another transport lands, carrying more prisoners: the Navy troops who had been guarding the mines on Clink.|128|0
units.english: The last of the Navy vessels in orbit has been subdued. As you land, you find that several Free Worlds troop transports have already set down in the spaceport and corralled the remaining Navy officers into a small circle. You would estimate that there are several hundred Navy prisoners. Another transport lands, carrying more prisoners: the Navy troops who had been guarding the mines on Clink.
units.italian: L'ultima nave della Marina in orbita è stata sopraffatta. Mentre atterri, scopri che diversi trasporti di truppe delle Free Worlds sono già scesi nello spazioporto e hanno radunato gli ufficiali della Marina rimasti in un piccolo cerchio. Valuteresti che ci siano diverse centinaia di prigionieri della Marina. Atterra un altro trasporto, con altri prigionieri: le truppe della Marina che sorvegliavano le miniere su Clink.

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	For several hours, nothing changes: the Navy troops are huddled into a small circle, surrounded by guards. When lunchtime comes, some of the guards go to the market and fetch some of the vendors who sell meals out of carts there; they return with the carts and hand out food to the prisoners. Then, another transport lands and Tomek steps out.|129|0
units.english: For several hours, nothing changes: the Navy troops are huddled into a small circle, surrounded by guards. When lunchtime comes, some of the guards go to the market and fetch some of the vendors who sell meals out of carts there; they return with the carts and hand out food to the prisoners. Then, another transport lands and Tomek steps out.
units.italian: Per diverse ore non cambia nulla: le truppe della Marina stanno accalcate in un piccolo cerchio, circondate dalle guardie. Quando arriva mezzogiorno, alcune guardie vanno al mercato e portano lì i venditori che preparano pasti sui loro carretti; tornano con i carretti e distribuiscono il cibo ai prigionieri. Poi atterra un altro trasporto e ne scende Tomek.

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	He pulls you aside and asks you, "How are things going here?"|130|0
units.english: He pulls you aside and asks you, "How are things going here?"
units.italian: Ti prende da parte e ti chiede: "Come vanno le cose qui?"

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	"Very quiet. They haven't given us any trouble."|132|0
units.english: "Very quiet. They haven't given us any trouble."
units.italian: "Molto tranquille. Non ci hanno dato alcun problema."

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	"The battle was brutal. I hope we don't have to keep doing that."|133|0
units.english: "The battle was brutal. I hope we don't have to keep doing that."
units.italian: "La battaglia è stata brutale. Spero che non dovremo continuare a fare una cosa del genere."

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	"Glad to hear it," he says.|136|0
units.english: "Glad to hear it," he says.
units.italian: "Sono contento di sentirlo," dice.

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	"I hope so too," he says. "Maybe we can make a start in that direction right now."|140|0
units.english: "I hope so too," he says. "Maybe we can make a start in that direction right now."
units.italian: "Lo spero anch'io," dice. "Forse possiamo cominciare a muoverci in quella direzione proprio adesso."

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	Tomek climbs up onto the hull of a nearby ship and addresses the prisoners. "Hello," he says. A few of the Navy officers respond, warily. "My name is Tomek Voigt. Our militia is very loosely organized, but I'm the one in charge of organizing it." That gets a few laughs from the Free Worlds guards. "As such, I am responsible for deciding your fate."|143|0
units.english: Tomek climbs up onto the hull of a nearby ship and addresses the prisoners. "Hello," he says. A few of the Navy officers respond, warily. "My name is Tomek Voigt. Our militia is very loosely organized, but I'm the one in charge of organizing it." That gets a few laughs from the Free Worlds guards. "As such, I am responsible for deciding your fate."
units.italian: Tomek sale sullo scafo di una nave lì vicino e si rivolge ai prigionieri. "Salve," dice. Qualche ufficiale della Marina risponde, con diffidenza. "Mi chiamo Tomek Voigt. La nostra milizia è organizzata in modo molto fluido, ma sono io quello che la organizza." Questo strappa qualche risata alle guardie delle Free Worlds. "E come tale, sono io che decido del vostro destino."

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	At that, a hush falls over the crowd. "The Council has decided," he continues, "that any of you who gives us your parole, swearing to take no further part in fighting the Free Worlds, will be returned to Republic space. You will give us your word of honor that you will either seek reassignment in another part of the galaxy, or resign your commission."|144|0
units.english: At that, a hush falls over the crowd. "The Council has decided," he continues, "that any of you who gives us your parole, swearing to take no further part in fighting the Free Worlds, will be returned to Republic space. You will give us your word of honor that you will either seek reassignment in another part of the galaxy, or resign your commission."
units.italian: A queste parole cala il silenzio sulla folla. "Il Consiglio ha deciso," continua, "che chiunque di voi ci dia la propria parola, giurando di non prendere più parte ai combattimenti contro le Free Worlds, sarà riportato nello spazio della Repubblica. Ci darete la vostra parola d'onore che cercherete un nuovo incarico in un'altra parte della galassia, oppure che rassegnerete le dimissioni dalla vostra carica."

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	A few of the Free Worlds guards shout, "What?" But only a surprising few. The rest are nodding, seemingly pleased with the Council's choice. Tomek climbs down from the hull and approaches the prisoners, and you notice Alondo and Freya have joined him.|145|0
units.english: A few of the Free Worlds guards shout, "What?" But only a surprising few. The rest are nodding, seemingly pleased with the Council's choice. Tomek climbs down from the hull and approaches the prisoners, and you notice Alondo and Freya have joined him.
units.italian: Qualche guardia delle Free Worlds grida: "Che cosa?" Ma solo una minoranza sorprendente. Gli altri annuiscono, apparentemente soddisfatti della scelta del Consiglio. Tomek scende dallo scafo e si avvicina ai prigionieri, e noti che Alondo e Freya si sono uniti a lui.

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	One of the Navy officers stands up. "I'll take that oath," he says, "if you'll honor your part of it."|146|0
units.english: One of the Navy officers stands up. "I'll take that oath," he says, "if you'll honor your part of it."
units.italian: Uno degli ufficiali della Marina si alza. "Accetto quel giuramento," dice, "se voi rispetterete la vostra parte."

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	Tomek takes the man's hands, looks him in the eyes, and asks, "Do you swear before God and these witnesses to take no further part in military actions against the Free Worlds?"|147|0
units.english: Tomek takes the man's hands, looks him in the eyes, and asks, "Do you swear before God and these witnesses to take no further part in military actions against the Free Worlds?"
units.italian: Tomek prende le mani dell'uomo, lo guarda negli occhi e chiede: "Giuri davanti a Dio e a questi testimoni di non prendere più parte ad azioni militari contro le Free Worlds?"

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	"I do," says the officer. Several of the other prisoners stand up, and before long all but a handful have sworn the oath.|148|0
units.english: "I do," says the officer. Several of the other prisoners stand up, and before long all but a handful have sworn the oath.
units.italian: "Lo giuro," dice l'ufficiale. Diversi altri prigionieri si alzano, e in poco tempo tutti tranne una manciata hanno giurato.

units.id: mission:Liberate Kornephoros|	After they finish, Tomek turns to you and a few other captains. "Emily, Marco, <first>, Sarah, please meet me in the spaceport cafe when you are ready." He walks off.|149|0
units.english: After they finish, Tomek turns to you and a few other captains. "Emily, Marco, <first>, Sarah, please meet me in the spaceport cafe when you are ready." He walks off.
units.italian: Quando hanno finito, Tomek si volta verso di te e verso qualche altro capitano. "Emily, Marco, <first>, Sarah, per favore raggiungetemi al caffè dello spazioporto quando siete pronti." Si allontana.

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole|name|160|0
units.english: Prisoner Parole
units.italian: Parola dei prigionieri

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole|description|161|0
units.english: Escort a fleet of transports carrying prisoners of war to <planet>. The temporary ceasefire will end on <date>.
units.italian: Scorta una flotta di trasporti con prigionieri di guerra fino a <planet>. Il cessate il fuoco temporaneo finirà il <date>.

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole|When you have all gathered in the cafe, Tomek explains the situation to you. "Alondo has arranged for a one-week ceasefire to return the prisoners who have given us their parole," he says. "That gives you just enough time to transport them to New Tibet and return here. If you encounter Republic ships, do not engage them. Just drop off the prisoners and return. Any questions?"|175|0
units.english: When you have all gathered in the cafe, Tomek explains the situation to you. "Alondo has arranged for a one-week ceasefire to return the prisoners who have given us their parole," he says. "That gives you just enough time to transport them to New Tibet and return here. If you encounter Republic ships, do not engage them. Just drop off the prisoners and return. Any questions?"
units.italian: Quando vi siete riuniti tutti al caffè, Tomek vi spiega la situazione. "Alondo ha ottenuto un cessate il fuoco di una settimana per restituire i prigionieri che ci hanno dato la parola," dice. "Questo vi dà giusto il tempo di trasportarli a New Tibet e tornare qui. Se incontrate navi della Repubblica, non ingaggiate battaglia. Lasciate i prigionieri e tornate. Domande?"

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole|	"No, I'm ready to go."|177|0
units.english: "No, I'm ready to go."
units.italian: "No, sono pronto a partire."

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole|	"What should we do if they attack us?"|179|0
units.english: "What should we do if they attack us?"
units.italian: "Che cosa dobbiamo fare se ci attaccano?"

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole|	"What will be done with the soldiers who didn't swear the oath?"|180|0
units.english: "What will be done with the soldiers who didn't swear the oath?"
units.italian: "Che cosa sarà fatto dei soldati che non hanno giurato?"

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole|	"If you can, return here without engaging them. No point in losing more lives. Besides, the Navy are honorable and will respect the ceasefire, I have no doubt about that. Only if you linger will things become difficult for you. Now get going. Time is limited."|183|0
units.english: "If you can, return here without engaging them. No point in losing more lives. Besides, the Navy are honorable and will respect the ceasefire, I have no doubt about that. Only if you linger will things become difficult for you. Now get going. Time is limited."
units.italian: "Se potete, tornate qui senza ingaggiarli. Non ha senso perdere altre vite. E del resto la Marina è onorevole e rispetterà il cessate il fuoco, non ne ho dubbio. Solo se vi attardate le cose si faranno difficili per voi. Ora andate. Il tempo è limitato."

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole|	"They will be transported to a penal facility on Bourne and cared for well, and if at any point they change their minds, they will be allowed to leave. Now get going. Time is limited."|187|0
units.english: "They will be transported to a penal facility on Bourne and cared for well, and if at any point they change their minds, they will be allowed to leave. Now get going. Time is limited."
units.italian: "Saranno trasportati in una struttura penitenziaria su Bourne e trattati bene, e se in qualsiasi momento cambieranno idea, sarà permesso loro di andarsene. Ora andate. Il tempo è limitato."

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole|dialog|198|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left part of your convoy behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una parte del convoglio! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole|dialog|200|0
units.english: You drop off the Navy prisoners on <planet>. Now, it's time to get back to Deep with your fleet before the ceasefire ends.
units.italian: Lasci i prigionieri della Marina su <planet>. Ora è tempo di tornare a Deep con la tua flotta, prima che il cessate il fuoco finisca.

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole 2|name|206|0
units.english: Prisoner Parole
units.italian: Parola dei prigionieri

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole 2|description|207|0
units.english: Return to Deep before the cease-fire ends.
units.italian: Torna a Deep prima che il cessate il fuoco finisca.

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole 2|dialog|223|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left part of your convoy behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una parte del convoglio! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole 2|log|228|0
units.english: Returned some Navy prisoners of war, after they gave their parole and promised not to take part in any future battles against the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Hai restituito alcuni prigionieri di guerra della Marina, dopo che hanno dato la loro parola e promesso di non prendere parte a future battaglie contro le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole 2|Tomek seems very relieved to see you all back in one piece. "Thank you for your service," he says. "Please report to your local militia commanders for your next orders. Captain <last>, remain here."|230|0
units.english: Tomek seems very relieved to see you all back in one piece. "Thank you for your service," he says. "Please report to your local militia commanders for your next orders. Captain <last>, remain here."
units.italian: Tomek sembra molto sollevato nel vedervi tutti tornati interi. "Grazie per il vostro servizio," dice. "Presentatevi ai vostri comandanti della milizia locale per i prossimi ordini. Capitano <last>, rimani qui."

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole 2|	After everyone else has left the room, he tells you, "I'm sorry, but I've got some bad news for you. We've searched the entire outpost on Clink. No sign of Katya. The miners don't know what happened to her, but I'd say it's a safe bet that she's either dead, or a prisoner."|231|0
units.english: After everyone else has left the room, he tells you, "I'm sorry, but I've got some bad news for you. We've searched the entire outpost on Clink. No sign of Katya. The miners don't know what happened to her, but I'd say it's a safe bet that she's either dead, or a prisoner."
units.italian: Quando tutti gli altri hanno lasciato la stanza, ti dice: "Mi dispiace, ma ho brutte notizie per te. Abbiamo perquisito tutto l'avamposto su Clink. Nessuna traccia di Katya. I minatori non sanno che cosa le sia successo, ma direi che è quasi certo che sia morta o prigioniera."

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole 2|	"So, what do we do now?"|233|0
units.english: "So, what do we do now?"
units.italian: "Allora, che cosa facciamo adesso?"

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole 2|	"I wish we'd known that a few days earlier. We could have arranged a prisoner exchange."|235|0
units.english: "I wish we'd known that a few days earlier. We could have arranged a prisoner exchange."
units.italian: "Vorrei che l'avessimo saputo qualche giorno prima. Avremmo potuto organizzare uno scambio di prigionieri."

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole 2|	"I know," he says. "That's what a lot of our people are saying now. But what we did, a pure good-faith gesture with nothing demanded in return - we may come to be glad of that. My hope was to set a precedent, to shape the character of whatever conflict comes out of this, and I still think that was the right thing to do."|237|0
units.english: "I know," he says. "That's what a lot of our people are saying now. But what we did, a pure good-faith gesture with nothing demanded in return - we may come to be glad of that. My hope was to set a precedent, to shape the character of whatever conflict comes out of this, and I still think that was the right thing to do."
units.italian: "Lo so," dice. "È quello che stanno dicendo molti dei nostri, adesso. Ma quello che abbiamo fatto, un gesto di pura buona fede senza chiedere nulla in cambio, potrebbe farci piacere in futuro. La mia speranza era creare un precedente, dare forma al carattere di qualunque conflitto nasca da questa storia, e continuo a pensare che fosse la cosa giusta da fare."

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole 2|	"So, what do we do now?" you ask.|238|0
units.english: "So, what do we do now?" you ask.
units.italian: "Allora, che cosa facciamo adesso?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Prisoner Parole 2|	"The Navy has had two crushing defeats," he says. "They will be hesitant to attack again until their numbers are much stronger. That gives us some time for diplomacy, to strengthen our position, and to look for allies, or at least sympathizers. Which is where you come in. I'm going to ask you to transport Alondo for a set of diplomatic missions. Meet us in the spaceport when you are ready."|241|0
units.english: "The Navy has had two crushing defeats," he says. "They will be hesitant to attack again until their numbers are much stronger. That gives us some time for diplomacy, to strengthen our position, and to look for allies, or at least sympathizers. Which is where you come in. I'm going to ask you to transport Alondo for a set of diplomatic missions. Meet us in the spaceport when you are ready."
units.italian: "La Marina ha subito due sconfitte schiaccianti," dice. "Esiterà ad attaccare di nuovo finché le sue forze non saranno molto più numerose. Questo ci dà un po' di tempo per la diplomazia, per rafforzare la nostra posizione e cercare alleati, o almeno simpatizzanti. Ed è qui che entri in gioco tu. Ti chiederò di trasportare Alondo per una serie di missioni diplomatiche. Incontraci allo spazioporto quando sei pronto."

units.id: mission:oathkeepers founded|log|252|0
units.english: Apparently the paroled Navy prisoners from the battle for Kornephoros plan to keep their promise to not fight against the Free Worlds. They've formed a new Navy regiment guarding the far north of human space.
units.italian: A quanto pare i prigionieri della Marina rilasciati sulla parola dopo la battaglia per Kornephoros hanno intenzione di mantenere la promessa di non combattere contro le Free Worlds. Hanno formato un nuovo reggimento della Marina che sorveglia l'estremo nord dello spazio umano.

units.id: mission:oathkeepers founded|log|253|0
units.english: The "Oathkeepers" are a regiment of Navy officers who were captured by the Free Worlds and paroled on the condition that they take no further part in fighting against the Free Worlds. They are led by William Danforth, a famous Navy admiral. Their stated mission is to protect the Paradise Worlds from the pirates who live on the anarchist worlds in the far north of human space.
units.italian: Gli "Oathkeepers" sono un reggimento di ufficiali della Marina catturati dalle Free Worlds e rilasciati sulla parola, a condizione che non prendano più parte ai combattimenti contro le Free Worlds. Sono guidati da William Danforth, un famoso ammiraglio della Marina. La loro missione dichiarata è proteggere i Mondi Paradisiaci dai pirati che vivono sui mondi anarchici nell'estremo nord dello spazio umano.

units.id: mission:oathkeepers founded|log|254|0
units.english: Danforth is a famous Navy Admiral who is a folk hero throughout human space due to his fair and honorable behavior and his willingness to use his fleet to assist people in need, even when he has to go against Parliament's orders to do so. He is currently in charge of the Navy regiment who call themselves the "Oathkeepers."
units.italian: Danforth è un famoso ammiraglio della Marina, un eroe popolare in tutto lo spazio umano per il suo comportamento leale e onorevole e per la sua disponibilità a usare la flotta per aiutare chi è in difficoltà, anche quando questo significa andare contro gli ordini del Parlamento. Attualmente è a capo del reggimento della Marina che si fa chiamare "Oathkeepers".

units.id: mission:oathkeepers founded|When you land on <origin>, it seems that everyone in the spaceport is talking about a recent news story: the Navy has just announced the formation of a new regiment, called the Oathkeepers. This regiment is staffed mostly by prisoners you paroled from Kornephoros, who want to honor their oath to take no further part in the conflict against the Free Worlds. They will be headquartered on Farpoint, in the far north, to defend that region of space against pirate incursions.|256|0
units.english: When you land on <origin>, it seems that everyone in the spaceport is talking about a recent news story: the Navy has just announced the formation of a new regiment, called the Oathkeepers. This regiment is staffed mostly by prisoners you paroled from Kornephoros, who want to honor their oath to take no further part in the conflict against the Free Worlds. They will be headquartered on Farpoint, in the far north, to defend that region of space against pirate incursions.
units.italian: Quando atterri su <origin>, sembra che tutti nello spazioporto parlino di una notizia recente: la Marina ha appena annunciato la formazione di un nuovo reggimento, chiamato Oathkeepers. Ne fanno parte soprattutto i prigionieri che hai rilasciato sulla parola da Kornephoros, i quali vogliono onorare il giuramento di non prendere più parte al conflitto contro le Free Worlds. Avranno il quartier generale su Farpoint, nell'estremo nord, per difendere quella regione di spazio dalle incursioni dei pirati.

units.id: mission:oathkeepers founded|	Furthermore, the leader of the Oathkeepers will be Admiral Danforth, an elderly admiral who is something of a folk hero and is spoken of with admiration and respect even here in Free space. Although he was not one of the paroled prisoners, he has become an outspoken advocate for a diplomatic solution to the Free Worlds conflict.|257|0
units.english: Furthermore, the leader of the Oathkeepers will be Admiral Danforth, an elderly admiral who is something of a folk hero and is spoken of with admiration and respect even here in Free space. Although he was not one of the paroled prisoners, he has become an outspoken advocate for a diplomatic solution to the Free Worlds conflict.
units.italian: Inoltre, a guidare gli Oathkeepers sarà l'ammiraglio Danforth, un ammiraglio anziano che è una specie di eroe popolare e di cui si parla con ammirazione e rispetto anche qui nello spazio delle Free Worlds. Anche se non era uno dei prigionieri rilasciati sulla parola, è diventato un convinto sostenitore di una soluzione diplomatica al conflitto con le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:oathkeepers founded|	It's heartening news, but you also can't help noticing how many people in the spaceport are talking now about how the Navy really is full of "decent" and "honorable" people, and it's a shame that the Free Worlds had to fight them. By responding to your generous gesture with one of their own, the Navy has won a definite political victory, and given that they needed to defend the North anyway, it is a victory that cost them very little.|258|0
units.english: It's heartening news, but you also can't help noticing how many people in the spaceport are talking now about how the Navy really is full of "decent" and "honorable" people, and it's a shame that the Free Worlds had to fight them. By responding to your generous gesture with one of their own, the Navy has won a definite political victory, and given that they needed to defend the North anyway, it is a victory that cost them very little.
units.italian: È una notizia incoraggiante, ma non puoi fare a meno di notare quante persone nello spazioporto stiano parlando del fatto che la Marina è davvero piena di gente "perbene" e "onorevole", e che è un peccato che le Free Worlds abbiano dovuto combatterla. Rispondendo al tuo gesto generoso con uno altrettanto generoso, la Marina ha ottenuto una netta vittoria politica, e dato che doveva comunque difendere il Nord, è una vittoria che le è costata pochissimo.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|name|265|0
units.english: Syndicate Diplomacy
units.italian: Diplomazia con il Sindacato

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|description|266|0
units.english: Transport Alondo Gruyere to the Syndicate headquarters on <planet>.
units.italian: Trasporta Alondo Gruyere al quartier generale del Sindacato su <planet>.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|blocked|272|0
units.english: Alondo contacts you and says, "Captain, you're going to need a bunk free for me. Do you have space?" You do not, so you should complete or abort another mission to make room for him, then return here.
units.italian: Alondo ti contatta e dice: "Capitano, avrai bisogno di una cuccetta libera per me. Hai spazio?" Non ne hai, quindi dovresti completare o interrompere un'altra missione per fargli posto, poi tornare qui.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|You meet Tomek and Alondo in the spaceport. "We've decided that now would be a good time for diplomatic missions," says Alondo. "We've proven that we are a force to reckon with, but also that we are open to working for peace. We'll start with the Syndicate, as a relationship with them would be a significant advantage for us."|280|0
units.english: You meet Tomek and Alondo in the spaceport. "We've decided that now would be a good time for diplomatic missions," says Alondo. "We've proven that we are a force to reckon with, but also that we are open to working for peace. We'll start with the Syndicate, as a relationship with them would be a significant advantage for us."
units.italian: Incontri Tomek e Alondo allo spazioporto. "Abbiamo deciso che ora sarebbe un buon momento per le missioni diplomatiche," dice Alondo. "Abbiamo dimostrato di essere una forza con cui fare i conti, ma anche di essere aperti a lavorare per la pace. Cominceremo con il Sindacato, perché un rapporto con loro sarebbe per noi un vantaggio significativo."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|	"Do you think they will fight on our side?"|282|0
units.english: "Do you think they will fight on our side?"
units.italian: "Pensi che combatteranno dalla nostra parte?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|	"Wait, isn't the Syndicate an evil megacorporation?"|283|0
units.english: "Wait, isn't the Syndicate an evil megacorporation?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, il Sindacato non è una megacorporazione malvagia?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|	"Certainly not," says Alondo. "Unlike us, the Syndicate has few grievances with the Republic. While the Navy does not patrol the Core, the Syndicate funds their own private security for the region. I don't see what they'd gain from joining the fight on our side. But they are very interested in maximizing their profits, so I pray we can arrange to purchase ship materials from them. And if nothing else, I pray they at least will promise not to hire out their security forces as mercenaries to the Republic."|286|0
units.english: "Certainly not," says Alondo. "Unlike us, the Syndicate has few grievances with the Republic. While the Navy does not patrol the Core, the Syndicate funds their own private security for the region. I don't see what they'd gain from joining the fight on our side. But they are very interested in maximizing their profits, so I pray we can arrange to purchase ship materials from them. And if nothing else, I pray they at least will promise not to hire out their security forces as mercenaries to the Republic."
units.italian: "Certamente no," dice Alondo. "A differenza nostra, il Sindacato ha pochi motivi di lamentela con la Repubblica. La Marina non pattuglia il Nucleo, e il Sindacato finanzia una propria sicurezza privata per la regione. Non vedo che cosa guadagnerebbe a unirsi alla battaglia dalla nostra parte. Ma è molto interessato a massimizzare i propri profitti, quindi confido che possiamo organizzare l'acquisto di materiali per le navi da loro. E se non altro, confido che almeno promettano di non affittare le loro forze di sicurezza come mercenari alla Repubblica."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|	"Well, they do have a long record of environmental and human rights violations. But they are also the single largest employer in the galaxy, and a main reason for the stability the Republic has enjoyed for the last few centuries. The Syndicate is also not a monolith. There are at least some good people within the Syndicate. I... used to know one," Alondo says with some apprehension. "So, I wouldn't call the Syndicate 'evil.' It's more complicated than that."|290|0
units.english: "Well, they do have a long record of environmental and human rights violations. But they are also the single largest employer in the galaxy, and a main reason for the stability the Republic has enjoyed for the last few centuries. The Syndicate is also not a monolith. There are at least some good people within the Syndicate. I... used to know one," Alondo says with some apprehension. "So, I wouldn't call the Syndicate 'evil.' It's more complicated than that."
units.italian: "Beh, hanno una lunga storia di violazioni ambientali e dei diritti umani. Ma sono anche il più grande datore di lavoro della galassia, e una delle ragioni principali della stabilità di cui la Repubblica gode da alcuni secoli. Il Sindacato, poi, non è un monolite. Ci sono almeno alcune persone perbene dentro il Sindacato. Io... ne conoscevo una," dice Alondo con una certa apprensione. "Quindi non definirei il Sindacato 'malvagio'. È più complicato di così."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|	"Reaching Syndicate space could be difficult once the Navy has time to regroup," says Tomek. "This may be the last window of opportunity we get for a while to meet with them in person."|293|0
units.english: "Reaching Syndicate space could be difficult once the Navy has time to regroup," says Tomek. "This may be the last window of opportunity we get for a while to meet with them in person."
units.italian: "Raggiungere lo spazio del Sindacato potrebbe essere difficile una volta che la Marina avrà il tempo di riorganizzarsi," dice Tomek. "Questa potrebbe essere l'ultima finestra di opportunità che avremo per un po' per incontrarli di persona."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|	"I have plenty of contacts in the Dirt Belt," says Alondo, "so if a planet won't let us land, we can just hail them and I should be able to negotiate with them. In fact, I'm hoping that a side effect of this trip will be to judge how much sympathy we have in the surrounding systems."|294|0
units.english: "I have plenty of contacts in the Dirt Belt," says Alondo, "so if a planet won't let us land, we can just hail them and I should be able to negotiate with them. In fact, I'm hoping that a side effect of this trip will be to judge how much sympathy we have in the surrounding systems."
units.italian: "Ho molti contatti nella Fascia di Terra," dice Alondo, "quindi se un pianeta non ci lascerà atterrare, potremo semplicemente chiamarlo e dovrei riuscire a negoziare. Anzi, spero che un effetto collaterale di questo viaggio sia capire quanta simpatia abbiamo nei sistemi intorno."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|	"Sounds good! Let's do it!"|296|0
units.english: "Sounds good! Let's do it!"
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene! Facciamolo!"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|	"Why meet in person? How do we know this isn't a trap?"|298|0
units.english: "Why meet in person? How do we know this isn't a trap?"
units.italian: "Perché incontrarli di persona? Come sappiamo che non è una trappola?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|	"What should we do if we encounter Navy ships?"|299|0
units.english: "What should we do if we encounter Navy ships?"
units.italian: "Che cosa dobbiamo fare se incontriamo navi della Marina?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|	"While data moves through the hyperspace network faster than ships, having any substantial back and forth would take longer than if we simply showed up in person. The Syndicate is also often driven by greed, and we're worth more as customers of the Syndicate than as prisoners of the Republic. If nothing else, showing up in person is a sign of good faith. It puts our trust in the Syndicate, trust that they'd be unlikely to betray given the risk they'd see us taking simply to meet with them."|302|0
units.english: "While data moves through the hyperspace network faster than ships, having any substantial back and forth would take longer than if we simply showed up in person. The Syndicate is also often driven by greed, and we're worth more as customers of the Syndicate than as prisoners of the Republic. If nothing else, showing up in person is a sign of good faith. It puts our trust in the Syndicate, trust that they'd be unlikely to betray given the risk they'd see us taking simply to meet with them."
units.italian: "I dati viaggiano nella rete dell'iperspazio più velocemente delle navi, ma qualsiasi scambio sostanziale richiederebbe più tempo di quanto ne serva per presentarsi di persona. Il Sindacato, poi, è spesso spinto dall'avidità, e valiamo di più come clienti del Sindacato che come prigionieri della Repubblica. Se non altro, presentarsi di persona è un segno di buona fede. Mette la nostra fiducia nel Sindacato, una fiducia che difficilmente tradirebbero, visto il rischio che ci vedrebbero correre solo per incontrarli."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|	"I hope you're right! Let's get going."|304|0
units.english: "I hope you're right! Let's get going."
units.italian: "Spero che tu abbia ragione! Andiamo."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|	"I would suggest evading them," Alondo says. "From a diplomatic perspective, I'd rather let them live, but Tomek might think otherwise."|308|0
units.english: "I would suggest evading them," Alondo says. "From a diplomatic perspective, I'd rather let them live, but Tomek might think otherwise."
units.italian: "Suggerirei di evitarli," dice Alondo. "Da un punto di vista diplomatico preferirei lasciarli vivi, ma Tomek potrebbe pensarla diversamente."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|	"No," Tomek responds. "I agree. Just as you say there are good people within the Syndicate, there are good people within the Navy as well. It's one thing to fight during a battle, but we're not looking to invade Republic territory, only pass through it. Save your energy and only defend yourself if you must."|309|0
units.english: "No," Tomek responds. "I agree. Just as you say there are good people within the Syndicate, there are good people within the Navy as well. It's one thing to fight during a battle, but we're not looking to invade Republic territory, only pass through it. Save your energy and only defend yourself if you must."
units.italian: "No," risponde Tomek. "Sono d'accordo. Come dici tu che ci sono persone perbene dentro il Sindacato, ci sono persone perbene anche dentro la Marina. Una cosa è combattere in battaglia, un'altra è che vogliamo invadere il territorio della Repubblica: vogliamo solo attraversarlo. Risparmia le energie e difenditi solo se devi."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|	"Okay. Let's get going!"|311|0
units.english: "Okay. Let's get going!"
units.italian: "Va bene. Andiamo!"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1|dialog|315|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Alondo hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Alondo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|name|321|0
units.english: Tarazed Diplomacy
units.italian: Diplomazia con Tarazed

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|description|322|0
units.english: Transport Alondo Gruyere to <planet> to negotiate with Tarazed Corporation.
units.italian: Trasporta Alondo Gruyere su <planet> per negoziare con la Tarazed Corporation.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|log|335|0
units.english: Visited the Syndicate and worked out a deal where they promised to stay neutral. They are expecting to profit from selling weapons to both sides in this war. Also discovered that Katya is in the Republic's custody and is accused of terrorist activity.
units.italian: Hai visitato il Sindacato e hai definito un accordo in cui promette di restare neutrale. Conta di guadagnare vendendo armi a entrambe le parti di questa guerra. Hai anche scoperto che Katya è in custodia della Repubblica ed è accusata di attività terroristica.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|log|336|0
units.english: Katya was on Clink when the Navy invaded the Kornephoros system, and was taken captive by them and imprisoned as a war criminal.
units.italian: Katya era su Clink quando la Marina ha invaso il sistema Kornephoros, ed è stata catturata e imprigionata come criminale di guerra.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|log|337|0
units.english: Samuel Remington is the Syndicate's head of public relations, and he seemed to help get the Free Worlds a better deal with the Syndicate than they might have otherwise received. He and Alondo seem to have a history together, although it is one that neither will discuss in detail.
units.italian: Samuel Remington è il responsabile delle pubbliche relazioni del Sindacato, e sembra aver aiutato le Free Worlds a ottenere un accordo migliore di quello che avrebbero altrimenti ricevuto. Lui e Alondo sembrano avere un passato insieme, anche se nessuno dei due ne parla in dettaglio.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|As you land, Alondo says to you, "Let me do the talking, please." You are met almost immediately by two men in suits, who escort you to a room in the Syndicate headquarters. Six men are sitting on one side of a large mahogany conference table; they gesture for the two of you to be seated on the other side.|340|0
units.english: As you land, Alondo says to you, "Let me do the talking, please." You are met almost immediately by two men in suits, who escort you to a room in the Syndicate headquarters. Six men are sitting on one side of a large mahogany conference table; they gesture for the two of you to be seated on the other side.
units.italian: Mentre atterri, Alondo ti dice: "Lascia parlare me, per favore." Venite accolti quasi subito da due uomini in abito scuro, che vi accompagnano in una stanza del quartier generale del Sindacato. Sei uomini sono seduti da un lato di un grande tavolo da conferenza in mogano; vi fanno cenno di sedervi dall'altro lato.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	You introduce yourselves. "Thank you for meeting with us," says Alondo.|341|0
units.english: You introduce yourselves. "Thank you for meeting with us," says Alondo.
units.italian: Vi presentate. "Grazie per averci ricevuto," dice Alondo.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	A man who appears much younger than the others introduces himself as Samuel Remington and responds. "Hearing that representatives of the Free Worlds were on their way was certainly a surprise. I apologize that CEO Korban could not meet with us today. He sent me in his stead to ensure that this meeting was handled with the utmost delicacy. So, what might it be that brings you here?"|342|0
units.english: A man who appears much younger than the others introduces himself as Samuel Remington and responds. "Hearing that representatives of the Free Worlds were on their way was certainly a surprise. I apologize that CEO Korban could not meet with us today. He sent me in his stead to ensure that this meeting was handled with the utmost delicacy. So, what might it be that brings you here?"
units.italian: Un uomo che sembra molto più giovane degli altri si presenta come Samuel Remington e risponde. "Sentire che rappresentanti delle Free Worlds erano in arrivo è stata certo una sorpresa. Mi scuso perché il CEO Korban oggi non ha potuto incontrarvi. Ha mandato me al suo posto per assicurarsi che questo incontro fosse gestito con la massima delicatezza. Dunque, che cosa vi porta qui?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"We would like to secure the purchase of construction materials for new ships," says Alondo. "As well as ask that the Syndicate refrains from joining the war as mercenaries. Our grievance is with the Republic, not the Syndicate."|343|0
units.english: "We would like to secure the purchase of construction materials for new ships," says Alondo. "As well as ask that the Syndicate refrains from joining the war as mercenaries. Our grievance is with the Republic, not the Syndicate."
units.italian: "Vorremmo assicurarci l'acquisto di materiali da costruzione per nuove navi," dice Alondo. "E chiedere che il Sindacato si astenga dall'entrare in guerra come mercenario. La nostra contesa è con la Repubblica, non con il Sindacato."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"We are always open to new business opportunities," says another man, Lopez, "although negotiating with known terrorists is... distasteful." He leafs through a folder of papers, pulls one out, and slides it over to you. It is a picture of Katya, and the caption under it reads, "Terrorist ringleader captured in raid on Kornephoros system." It is dated a few days after the Navy's initial assault, before you retook the system from them.|344|0
units.english: "We are always open to new business opportunities," says another man, Lopez, "although negotiating with known terrorists is... distasteful." He leafs through a folder of papers, pulls one out, and slides it over to you. It is a picture of Katya, and the caption under it reads, "Terrorist ringleader captured in raid on Kornephoros system." It is dated a few days after the Navy's initial assault, before you retook the system from them.
units.italian: "Siamo sempre aperti a nuove opportunità commerciali," dice un altro uomo, Lopez, "anche se negoziare con noti terroristi è... disgustoso." Sfoglia una cartellina di carte, ne estrae una e la fa scivolare verso di voi. È una foto di Katya, e la didascalia sotto dice: "Capo banda terrorista catturato in un raid nel sistema Kornephoros." Porta una data di qualche giorno dopo l'assalto iniziale della Marina, prima che riprendeste il sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	(Let Alondo handle this.)|346|0
units.english: (Let Alondo handle this.)
units.italian: (Lascia che se ne occupi Alondo.)

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	(Try to explain what Katya was doing in that system.)|347|0
units.english: (Try to explain what Katya was doing in that system.)
units.italian: (Prova a spiegare che cosa ci faceva Katya in quel sistema.)

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	Alondo has turned very pale, but finally he says, "They have not announced this publicly."|350|0
units.english: Alondo has turned very pale, but finally he says, "They have not announced this publicly."
units.italian: Alondo è diventato pallidissimo, ma alla fine dice: "Non l'hanno annunciato pubblicamente."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"No," says Lopez, "they have only shared it with certain... trusted friends of the Republic."|351|0
units.english: "No," says Lopez, "they have only shared it with certain... trusted friends of the Republic."
units.italian: "No," dice Lopez, "l'hanno condiviso solo con certi... amici fidati della Repubblica."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	Alondo says, "They haven't announced anything because they know she was innocent. She was hunting the terrorists, not helping them."|352|0
units.english: Alondo says, "They haven't announced anything because they know she was innocent. She was hunting the terrorists, not helping them."
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Non hanno annunciato niente perché sanno che era innocente. Stava dando la caccia ai terroristi, non li stava aiutando."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"She was there trying to find the terrorists. She wasn't one of them," you say.|356|0
units.english: "She was there trying to find the terrorists. She wasn't one of them," you say.
units.italian: "Era là per cercare i terroristi. Non era una di loro," dici.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	Alondo side eyes you, looking very pale.|357|0
units.english: Alondo side eyes you, looking very pale.
units.italian: Alondo ti lancia un'occhiata di traverso, pallidissimo.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"That may be true," says a third man, Badenoch. "I am willing to believe you were hunting the terrorists, because I am aware through my own sources that the Free Worlds secured the services of a certain Ijs Springborn, whose skills would be well suited to such a hunt. And who might not be in as safe a position today if you had not given him a reason to leave this sector of space, where he is... universally despised. Regardless, we cannot sell supplies to enemies of the Republic."|360|0
units.english: "That may be true," says a third man, Badenoch. "I am willing to believe you were hunting the terrorists, because I am aware through my own sources that the Free Worlds secured the services of a certain Ijs Springborn, whose skills would be well suited to such a hunt. And who might not be in as safe a position today if you had not given him a reason to leave this sector of space, where he is... universally despised. Regardless, we cannot sell supplies to enemies of the Republic."
units.italian: "Può essere vero," dice un terzo uomo, Badenoch. "Sono disposto a credere che steste dando la caccia ai terroristi, perché so da fonti mie che le Free Worlds si sono assicurate i servizi di un certo Ijs Springborn, le cui capacità sarebbero adatte proprio a una caccia del genere. E che oggi forse non sarebbe in una posizione così sicura, se non gli aveste dato una ragione per lasciare questo settore di spazio, dove è... universalmente disprezzato. Ciò detto, non possiamo vendere forniture ai nemici della Repubblica."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"Piracy is on the rise in the Dirt Belt," says Alondo. "And I know you have customers there. Such as the Tarazed Corporation. If we can count you among our friends, we could ensure that your convoys reach Tarazed unmolested."|361|0
units.english: "Piracy is on the rise in the Dirt Belt," says Alondo. "And I know you have customers there. Such as the Tarazed Corporation. If we can count you among our friends, we could ensure that your convoys reach Tarazed unmolested."
units.italian: "La pirateria è in aumento nella Fascia di Terra," dice Alondo. "E so che avete clienti là. Come la Tarazed Corporation. Se possiamo considerarvi fra i nostri amici, potremmo assicurarci che i vostri convogli arrivino a Tarazed indisturbati."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"And you would no doubt immediately purchase said supplies from Tarazed," says Badenoch.|362|0
units.english: "And you would no doubt immediately purchase said supplies from Tarazed," says Badenoch.
units.italian: "E voi senza dubbio comprereste subito quelle forniture da Tarazed," dice Badenoch.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	A much older man sitting next to him, Akihito, says, "Of course, such weapons would end up being bought at a significant price markup." He is grinning.|363|0
units.english: A much older man sitting next to him, Akihito, says, "Of course, such weapons would end up being bought at a significant price markup." He is grinning.
units.italian: Un uomo molto più anziano seduto accanto a lui, Akihito, dice: "Certo, e quelle armi finirebbero per essere comprate con un sensibile ricarico sul prezzo." Sta sogghignando.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"No," Remington says, surprising some of the other men at the table. "No markups necessary." None of the other men argue with Remington over this.|364|0
units.english: "No," Remington says, surprising some of the other men at the table. "No markups necessary." None of the other men argue with Remington over this.
units.italian: "No," dice Remington, sorprendendo alcuni degli altri uomini al tavolo. "Nessun ricarico necessario." Nessuno degli altri discute con Remington su questo punto.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	You speak for a while longer, but Alondo manages to hash out a deal where the Free Worlds will defend any Syndicate ships they encounter within the Dirt Belt in return for a promise that the Syndicate will not serve as Republic mercenaries and will not prevent you from purchasing their equipment indirectly through Tarazed. In addition, Remington suggested that you might find some "extra goodies" among the Syndicate convoys heading to Tarazed specifically. You thank the Syndicate leaders, and begin the trip back to your ship.|365|0
units.english: You speak for a while longer, but Alondo manages to hash out a deal where the Free Worlds will defend any Syndicate ships they encounter within the Dirt Belt in return for a promise that the Syndicate will not serve as Republic mercenaries and will not prevent you from purchasing their equipment indirectly through Tarazed. In addition, Remington suggested that you might find some "extra goodies" among the Syndicate convoys heading to Tarazed specifically. You thank the Syndicate leaders, and begin the trip back to your ship.
units.italian: Parlate ancora per un po', ma Alondo riesce a definire un accordo: le Free Worlds difenderanno qualsiasi nave del Sindacato incontrino nella Fascia di Terra, in cambio della promessa che il Sindacato non servirà come mercenario della Repubblica e non vi impedirà di comprare il suo equipaggiamento indirettamente tramite Tarazed. Inoltre Remington ha suggerito che potreste trovare qualche "dolcetto in più" proprio nei convogli del Sindacato diretti a Tarazed. Ringraziate i capi del Sindacato e cominciate il viaggio di ritorno alla nave.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	Alondo is silent. As you're about to leave the spaceport for the landing pads, you hear someone shout behind you. "No need to be a stranger, Gruyere. Can't stick around for a drink?" You turn to look at who it is, but Alondo keeps walking. You find Samuel Remington approaching, paying you no mind. "Are you still mad at me, Gruyere?" he asks.|366|0
units.english: Alondo is silent. As you're about to leave the spaceport for the landing pads, you hear someone shout behind you. "No need to be a stranger, Gruyere. Can't stick around for a drink?" You turn to look at who it is, but Alondo keeps walking. You find Samuel Remington approaching, paying you no mind. "Are you still mad at me, Gruyere?" he asks.
units.italian: Alondo è silenzioso. Mentre state per lasciare lo spazioporto per le piazzole di atterraggio, senti qualcuno gridare dietro di voi. "Non c'è bisogno di fare lo sconosciuto, Gruyere. Non puoi fermarti per un drink?" Ti volti per vedere chi sia, ma Alondo continua a camminare. Trovi Samuel Remington che si avvicina, senza badare a te. "Sei ancora arrabbiato con me, Gruyere?" chiede.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	(Stand in Remington's way.)|368|0
units.english: (Stand in Remington's way.)
units.italian: (Mettiti sulla strada di Remington.)

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	(Don't engage.)|370|0
units.english: (Don't engage.)
units.italian: (Non dargli corda.)

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	Remington stops a few paces past you as Alondo boards your ship. Remington shakes his head before looking back to you. "I guess a guy can't talk to an old friend."|372|0
units.english: Remington stops a few paces past you as Alondo boards your ship. Remington shakes his head before looking back to you. "I guess a guy can't talk to an old friend."
units.italian: Remington si ferma qualche passo più in là mentre Alondo sale sulla tua nave. Remington scuote la testa prima di guardare di nuovo verso di te. "Immagino che uno non possa parlare con un vecchio amico."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	You take a step into Remington's path as Alondo boards your ship. Remington stops face-to-face with you. "What, a guy can't talk to an old friend?" he says while looking over your shoulder.|376|0
units.english: You take a step into Remington's path as Alondo boards your ship. Remington stops face-to-face with you. "What, a guy can't talk to an old friend?" he says while looking over your shoulder.
units.italian: Fai un passo sulla strada di Remington mentre Alondo sale sulla tua nave. Remington si ferma faccia a faccia con te. "Come, uno non può parlare con un vecchio amico?" dice guardandoti alle spalle.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"He's clearly not interested."|379|0
units.english: "He's clearly not interested."
units.italian: "Chiaramente non gli interessa."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"You know Alondo?"|381|0
units.english: "You know Alondo?"
units.italian: "Conosci Alondo?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"More than most," Remington says with a chuckle. "He was never one to show gratitude for gifts. I hope you enjoy the new toys in those shipments I just secured more than he does."|383|0
units.english: "More than most," Remington says with a chuckle. "He was never one to show gratitude for gifts. I hope you enjoy the new toys in those shipments I just secured more than he does."
units.italian: "Più di quanto immagini," dice Remington con un risolino. "Non è mai stato uno da mostrare gratitudine per i regali. Spero che i nuovi giocattoli in quelle spedizioni che ho appena assicurato ti piacciano più che a lui."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"As if that's ever stopped me before," Remington says with a chuckle. "He was never one to show gratitude for gifts. I hope you enjoy the new toys in those shipments I just secured more than he does."|387|0
units.english: "As if that's ever stopped me before," Remington says with a chuckle. "He was never one to show gratitude for gifts. I hope you enjoy the new toys in those shipments I just secured more than he does."
units.italian: "Come se questo mi avesse mai fermato prima," dice Remington con un risolino. "Non è mai stato uno da mostrare gratitudine per i regali. Spero che i nuovi giocattoli in quelle spedizioni che ho appena assicurato ti piacciano più che a lui."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"What new toys?" you ask.|390|0
units.english: "What new toys?" you ask.
units.italian: "Quali nuovi giocattoli?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"You'll see," he says, turning back to the spaceport and leaving you.|391|0
units.english: "You'll see," he says, turning back to the spaceport and leaving you.
units.italian: "Vedrai," dice, voltandosi di nuovo verso lo spazioporto e lasciandoti lì.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	You join Alondo on your ship and find him solemnly staring out a window.|392|0
units.english: You join Alondo on your ship and find him solemnly staring out a window.
units.italian: Raggiungi Alondo sulla tua nave e lo trovi che fissa solennemente fuori dal finestrino.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"It seems like the negotiations went pretty well."|394|0
units.english: "It seems like the negotiations went pretty well."
units.italian: "Mi sembra che le trattative siano andate piuttosto bene."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"What was that all about?"|396|0
units.english: "What was that all about?"
units.italian: "Che cosa era tutta quella scena?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"What do we do about Katya?"|398|0
units.english: "What do we do about Katya?"
units.italian: "Che cosa facciamo per Katya?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"Samuel and I have... a history. One I'd rather not discuss," Alondo responds. "Anyway, we must continue with our mission. Time for us to make a visit to Tarazed. Let's get going."|402|0
units.english: "Samuel and I have... a history. One I'd rather not discuss," Alondo responds. "Anyway, we must continue with our mission. Time for us to make a visit to Tarazed. Let's get going."
units.italian: "Samuel e io abbiamo... un passato. Uno di cui preferirei non parlare," risponde Alondo. "Comunque dobbiamo proseguire la nostra missione. È tempo di fare una visita a Tarazed. Andiamo."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"They did. Although it feels like it was almost too easy. Support from Samuel isn't too unexpected, but I'd have expected the others to fight him over squeezing us a bit more." Alondo pauses for a moment. "Anyway, we must continue with our mission. Time for us to make a visit to Tarazed."|406|0
units.english: "They did. Although it feels like it was almost too easy. Support from Samuel isn't too unexpected, but I'd have expected the others to fight him over squeezing us a bit more." Alondo pauses for a moment. "Anyway, we must continue with our mission. Time for us to make a visit to Tarazed."
units.italian: "Sono andate. Anche se sembra che sia stato quasi troppo facile. Il sostegno di Samuel non è troppo inatteso, ma mi sarei aspettato che gli altri lo combattessero per spremerei un po' di più." Alondo si ferma un momento. "Comunque dobbiamo proseguire la nostra missione. È tempo di fare una visita a Tarazed."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|	"I'll have to talk that over with the Council when we get back. But if she is a prisoner of the Intelligence Bureau, there is no way we can rescue her. Her only hope is that they will recognize her innocence. For now, we must continue with our mission. Time for us to make a visit to Tarazed."|410|0
units.english: "I'll have to talk that over with the Council when we get back. But if she is a prisoner of the Intelligence Bureau, there is no way we can rescue her. Her only hope is that they will recognize her innocence. For now, we must continue with our mission. Time for us to make a visit to Tarazed."
units.italian: "Dovrò parlarne con il Consiglio quando torniamo. Ma se è prigioniera dell'Ufficio dell'Intelligence, non c'è modo di salvarla. La sua unica speranza è che riconoscano la sua innocenza. Per ora dobbiamo proseguire la nostra missione. È tempo di fare una visita a Tarazed."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B|dialog|420|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Alondo hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Alondo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|name|426|0
units.english: Poisonwood Diplomacy
units.italian: Diplomazia con Poisonwood

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|description|427|0
units.english: Travel to <planet> with Alondo Gruyere, to make one final diplomatic visit.
units.italian: Va' su <planet> con Alondo Gruyere, per fare un'ultima visita diplomatica.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|log|440|0
units.english: The extra Syndicate supplies have begun arriving at Tarazed, and they include weaponry and outfits not normally shipped to the South. Spoke with Emily Lane, the CEO of the Tarazed Corporation. She is suspicious of this supposed gesture of good will from the Syndicate, and suggests remaining vigilant of the Syndicate's actions.
units.italian: Le forniture extra del Sindacato hanno cominciato ad arrivare a Tarazed, e comprendono armi ed equipaggiamenti che di solito non vengono spediti al Sud. Hai parlato con Emily Lane, il CEO della Tarazed Corporation. È sospettosa di questo presunto gesto di buona volontà del Sindacato e suggerisce di restare vigili sulle sue azioni.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|When you arrive at <origin>, you find that there are already some Syndicate ships here unloading cargo that must have been sent ahead of you. You catch a glimpse of some of the crates and see large amounts of ship materials, as well as crates of blasters, Proton Guns, and other Syndicate products.|442|0
units.english: When you arrive at <origin>, you find that there are already some Syndicate ships here unloading cargo that must have been sent ahead of you. You catch a glimpse of some of the crates and see large amounts of ship materials, as well as crates of blasters, Proton Guns, and other Syndicate products.
units.italian: Quando arrivi su <origin>, scopri che ci sono già alcune navi del Sindacato che scaricano un carico che dev'essere stato spedito prima di te. Intravedi alcune casse e vedi grandi quantità di materiali per navi, oltre a casse di blaster, cannoni protonici e altri prodotti del Sindacato.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|	Upon contacting the Tarazed Corporation, you and Alondo are led into the Tarazed board room, which is different from the Syndicate one in two respects. First, it is much less fancy. And second, there are women present: unlike the notoriously misogynistic Syndicate, Tarazed is currently run by a female CEO, Emily Lane.|443|0
units.english: Upon contacting the Tarazed Corporation, you and Alondo are led into the Tarazed board room, which is different from the Syndicate one in two respects. First, it is much less fancy. And second, there are women present: unlike the notoriously misogynistic Syndicate, Tarazed is currently run by a female CEO, Emily Lane.
units.italian: Dopo aver contattato la Tarazed Corporation, tu e Alondo venite condotti nella sala riunioni di Tarazed, che è diversa da quella del Sindacato per due aspetti. Primo, è molto meno lussuosa. Secondo, ci sono delle donne: a differenza del Sindacato, notoriamente misogino, Tarazed è attualmente guidata da un CEO donna, Emily Lane.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|	"I'm pleased to welcome you here," says Emily. "It's nice to finally speak with you directly, Alondo. Many of us are sympathetic to your cause."|444|0
units.english: "I'm pleased to welcome you here," says Emily. "It's nice to finally speak with you directly, Alondo. Many of us are sympathetic to your cause."
units.italian: "Sono lieta di darvi il benvenuto qui," dice Emily. "È bello parlare finalmente con te di persona, Alondo. Molti di noi simpatizzano per la vostra causa."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|	"Thank you," says Alondo, "although for the time being the best way to support us may be for you to remain neutral in this conflict." He explains the negotiations with the Syndicate and the idea of Tarazed being a go-between for Syndicate supplies.|445|0
units.english: "Thank you," says Alondo, "although for the time being the best way to support us may be for you to remain neutral in this conflict." He explains the negotiations with the Syndicate and the idea of Tarazed being a go-between for Syndicate supplies.
units.italian: "Grazie," dice Alondo, "anche se per il momento il modo migliore per sostenerci potrebbe essere restare neutrali in questo conflitto." Spiega le trattative con il Sindacato e l'idea di Tarazed come intermediario per le forniture del Sindacato.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|	"I don't like dealing with the Syndicate," says Emily, "but like yourselves, we could not build ships without the systems they manufacture. Of course, the materials we receive from Free space are equally valuable. But if we remain nominally a part of the Republic, they will have full access to this system, including searching incoming and outgoing freighters."|446|0
units.english: "I don't like dealing with the Syndicate," says Emily, "but like yourselves, we could not build ships without the systems they manufacture. Of course, the materials we receive from Free space are equally valuable. But if we remain nominally a part of the Republic, they will have full access to this system, including searching incoming and outgoing freighters."
units.italian: "Non mi piace trattare con il Sindacato," dice Emily, "ma come voi, non potremmo costruire navi senza i sistemi che producono. Naturalmente i materiali che riceviamo dallo spazio delle Free Worlds sono altrettanto preziosi. Ma se restiamo nominalmente parte della Repubblica, avranno pieno accesso a questo sistema, compresa la possibilità di perquisire i mercantili in arrivo e in partenza."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|	"You receive weapons and ship materials all the time. As long as they don't know it's going to us, they shouldn't care."|448|0
units.english: "You receive weapons and ship materials all the time. As long as they don't know it's going to us, they shouldn't care."
units.italian: "Ricevete armi e materiali per navi in continuazione. Finché non sanno che vanno a noi, non dovrebbe importare."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|	(Let Alondo do the talking.)|450|0
units.english: (Let Alondo do the talking.)
units.italian: (Lascia parlare Alondo.)

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|	"True," says Alondo, "but a Navy fleet here would be vulnerable to being cut off from Republic space, so unless they occupy the whole Dirt Belt, I do not think they would risk it."|451|0
units.english: "True," says Alondo, "but a Navy fleet here would be vulnerable to being cut off from Republic space, so unless they occupy the whole Dirt Belt, I do not think they would risk it."
units.italian: "Vero," dice Alondo, "ma una flotta della Marina qui sarebbe vulnerabile al rischio di essere tagliata fuori dallo spazio della Repubblica, quindi a meno che non occupino tutta la Fascia di Terra, non credo che correrebbero il rischio."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|	"Perhaps so," Emily responds. "Although I must ask what sort of strings you pulled to manage what you have. Shortly before you arrived we began receiving Syndicate supplies that we never ordered. Quad Blaster Turrets. Proton guns. Anti-missile turrets. Even atomic thrusters from the Deep, which the Syndicate does not normally sell. Is this all for the Free Worlds?"|453|0
units.english: "Perhaps so," Emily responds. "Although I must ask what sort of strings you pulled to manage what you have. Shortly before you arrived we began receiving Syndicate supplies that we never ordered. Quad Blaster Turrets. Proton guns. Anti-missile turrets. Even atomic thrusters from the Deep, which the Syndicate does not normally sell. Is this all for the Free Worlds?"
units.italian: "Forse," risponde Emily. "Anche se devo chiedervi quali corde abbiate tirato per ottenere quello che avete ottenuto. Poco prima del vostro arrivo abbiamo cominciato a ricevere forniture del Sindacato che non avevamo mai ordinato. Torrette blaster quadruple. Cannoni protonici. Torrette antimissile. Persino propulsori atomici della Deep, che il Sindacato di solito non vende. È tutto per le Free Worlds?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|	Alondo pauses. "I have... an old friend within the Syndicate. He was a part of the negotiations, and mentioned that there would be 'extra goodies' within the coming convoys. We haven't been on speaking terms for years, and I suppose this is his attempt to get back on my good side."|454|0
units.english: Alondo pauses. "I have... an old friend within the Syndicate. He was a part of the negotiations, and mentioned that there would be 'extra goodies' within the coming convoys. We haven't been on speaking terms for years, and I suppose this is his attempt to get back on my good side."
units.italian: Alondo si ferma. "Ho... un vecchio amico dentro il Sindacato. Faceva parte delle trattative e ha accennato che ci sarebbero stati dei 'dolcetti in più' nei prossimi convogli. Non ci parliamo da anni, e suppongo che questo sia il suo tentativo di tornare nelle mie grazie."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|	"I doubt that supplies in these amounts are just an attempt at old friends trying to get back together," says Emily. "The Syndicate does not play games like this without having something to gain from it. I would not think too highly of this gesture."|455|0
units.english: "I doubt that supplies in these amounts are just an attempt at old friends trying to get back together," says Emily. "The Syndicate does not play games like this without having something to gain from it. I would not think too highly of this gesture."
units.italian: "Dubito che forniture di queste quantità siano solo un tentativo di vecchi amici di riappacificarsi," dice Emily. "Il Sindacato non fa giochi del genere senza averci qualcosa da guadagnare. Non penserei troppo bene di questo gesto."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|	They continue talking for a while, and you leave well convinced that Tarazed is willing to support you and that the best way they can do that for now is by remaining neutral. There were questions raised about the intentions of the Syndicate, though.|456|0
units.english: They continue talking for a while, and you leave well convinced that Tarazed is willing to support you and that the best way they can do that for now is by remaining neutral. There were questions raised about the intentions of the Syndicate, though.
units.italian: Continuano a parlare per un po', e te ne vai ben convinto che Tarazed sia disposta a sostenervi e che il modo migliore per farlo, per ora, sia restare neutrale. Sono state sollevate delle domande sulle intenzioni del Sindacato, però.
