units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|	"Now," says Alondo, "I'd like to make one more diplomatic visit. The planet <planet> has insisted on remaining loyal to the Republic, even though they are deep inside our space. I'd like to meet with their leaders and see if they will reconsider joining us."|457|0
units.english: "Now," says Alondo, "I'd like to make one more diplomatic visit. The planet <planet> has insisted on remaining loyal to the Republic, even though they are deep inside our space. I'd like to meet with their leaders and see if they will reconsider joining us."
units.italian: "Ora," dice Alondo, "vorrei fare un'ultima visita diplomatica. Il pianeta <planet> ha insistito per restare fedele alla Repubblica, anche se si trova in profondità dentro il nostro spazio. Vorrei incontrare i loro capi e vedere se riconsidereranno l'idea di unirsi a noi."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C|dialog|467|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Alondo hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Alondo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|name|473|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|description|474|0
units.english: Return to <planet> with Alondo, to report on the outcome of your diplomatic mission.
units.italian: Torna su <planet> con Alondo, per riferire sull'esito della tua missione diplomatica.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|log|484|0
units.english: Tried to convince Poisonwood, a world adjacent to Free Worlds territory, to switch sides. But, they are fiercely loyal to the Republic because the Navy freed them from being dominated by Alpha warlords decades ago.
units.italian: Hai cercato di convincere Poisonwood, un mondo confinante con il territorio delle Free Worlds, a cambiare schieramento. Ma sono ferocemente fedeli alla Repubblica, perché la Marina li ha liberati decenni fa dal dominio dei signori della guerra Alphas.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|As you are landing on Poisonwood, Alondo explains, "Three decades ago, this was a slave colony. The Navy was responsible for liberating them, and they still feel a deep debt to the Republic as a result. But even if they do not join us, we can maybe establish more friendly relations with them."|486|0
units.english: As you are landing on Poisonwood, Alondo explains, "Three decades ago, this was a slave colony. The Navy was responsible for liberating them, and they still feel a deep debt to the Republic as a result. But even if they do not join us, we can maybe establish more friendly relations with them."
units.italian: Mentre atterri su Poisonwood, Alondo spiega: "Trent'anni fa questa era una colonia di schiavi. La Marina è stata responsabile della loro liberazione, e di conseguenza sentono ancora un debito profondo verso la Repubblica. Ma anche se non si uniranno a noi, forse possiamo stabilire rapporti più amichevoli con loro."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	Soon after you land, the governor of Poisonwood sends an aide to escort you to her office. The governor is probably in her late fifties, and as you are speaking the sunlight occasionally catches her face or arms at exactly the right angle to show the faint, criss-crossing lines of very old scars. She must have been one of the slaves who were freed by the Navy.|487|0
units.english: Soon after you land, the governor of Poisonwood sends an aide to escort you to her office. The governor is probably in her late fifties, and as you are speaking the sunlight occasionally catches her face or arms at exactly the right angle to show the faint, criss-crossing lines of very old scars. She must have been one of the slaves who were freed by the Navy.
units.italian: Poco dopo che atterri, la governatrice di Poisonwood manda un assistente a scortarvi nel suo ufficio. La governatrice avrà probabilmente quasi sessant'anni, e mentre parlate la luce del sole le coglie a volte il viso o le braccia esattamente all'angolo giusto per mostrare le linee tenui e incrociate di cicatrici molto vecchie. Dev'essere stata una delle schiave liberate dalla Marina.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	As soon as you are seated, she says, "Now, I don't want to give you false hope. We will not be joining the Free Worlds."|488|0
units.english: As soon as you are seated, she says, "Now, I don't want to give you false hope. We will not be joining the Free Worlds."
units.italian: Appena vi siete seduti, dice: "Ora, non voglio darvi false speranze. Non ci uniremo alle Free Worlds."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"Understood," says Alondo. "We've come primarily to assure you that the Free Worlds will never attempt to take control of a planet that has not willingly chosen to join us. But without our support, your world is isolated and vulnerable."|489|0
units.english: "Understood," says Alondo. "We've come primarily to assure you that the Free Worlds will never attempt to take control of a planet that has not willingly chosen to join us. But without our support, your world is isolated and vulnerable."
units.italian: "Capito," dice Alondo. "Siamo venuti soprattutto per assicurarvi che le Free Worlds non tenteranno mai di prendere il controllo di un pianeta che non abbia scelto volontariamente di unirsi a noi. Ma senza il nostro sostegno, il vostro mondo è isolato e vulnerabile."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"Indeed," she says, grimacing. They talk for a while, but it is clear she does not think her people would ever support even a treaty of neutrality with the "rebellion." Finally, she changes the subject. "Captain <last>," she says, "what do you believe is the greatest threat that humanity faces today?"|490|0
units.english: "Indeed," she says, grimacing. They talk for a while, but it is clear she does not think her people would ever support even a treaty of neutrality with the "rebellion." Finally, she changes the subject. "Captain <last>," she says, "what do you believe is the greatest threat that humanity faces today?"
units.italian: "Esatto," dice, con una smorfia. Parlano per un po', ma è chiaro che non ritiene che la sua gente sosterrebbe mai nemmeno un trattato di neutralità con la "ribellione". Alla fine cambia argomento. "Capitano <last>," dice, "quale ritiene che sia la più grande minaccia che l'umanità affronta oggi?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"Corrupt government."|492|0
units.english: "Corrupt government."
units.italian: "Un governo corrotto."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"Powerful corporations and unbridled capitalism."|493|0
units.english: "Powerful corporations and unbridled capitalism."
units.italian: "Le corporazioni potenti e il capitalismo senza freni."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"The return of the Alphas, or something like them."|495|0
units.english: "The return of the Alphas, or something like them."
units.italian: "Il ritorno degli Alphas, o di qualcosa di simile."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"Piracy and anarchy, like the pirates who dominated your world."|497|0
units.english: "Piracy and anarchy, like the pirates who dominated your world."
units.italian: "La pirateria e l'anarchia, come i pirati che dominavano il vostro mondo."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"Alien invasion."|499|0
units.english: "Alien invasion."
units.italian: "Un'invasione aliena."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"Me."|501|0
units.english: "Me."
units.italian: "Io."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	She laughs. "A typical Free Worlds answer. I will confess, I am none too fond of Parliament, ordering the Navy to spend its time up in the paradise sector assisting snobby rich pilots who've run out of fuel instead of down here defending against the very real threats that lurk on the pirate worlds."|508|0
units.english: She laughs. "A typical Free Worlds answer. I will confess, I am none too fond of Parliament, ordering the Navy to spend its time up in the paradise sector assisting snobby rich pilots who've run out of fuel instead of down here defending against the very real threats that lurk on the pirate worlds."
units.italian: Ride. "Una risposta tipica delle Free Worlds. Confesso che non sono affatto una grande sostenitrice del Parlamento, che ordina alla Marina di passare il tempo nel settore paradisiaco ad assistere piloti ricchi e snob rimasti senza carburante, invece di difendere quaggiù dalle minacce molto reali che si annidano sui mondi pirata."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"Since there is only one corporation in the galaxy that fits that description," she says, "I assume you are talking about the Syndicate. Any human organization can take on a life of its own, and act in ways that any of its individual members would consider immoral. That is a danger the Syndicate does face. but I find myself more concerned with certain threats that are closer to home."|512|0
units.english: "Since there is only one corporation in the galaxy that fits that description," she says, "I assume you are talking about the Syndicate. Any human organization can take on a life of its own, and act in ways that any of its individual members would consider immoral. That is a danger the Syndicate does face. but I find myself more concerned with certain threats that are closer to home."
units.italian: "Dato che c'è una sola corporazione nella galassia che corrisponde a quella descrizione," dice, "suppongo che parliate del Sindacato. Qualsiasi organizzazione umana può prendere vita propria e agire in modi che ognuno dei suoi singoli membri considererebbe immorali. È un pericolo che il Sindacato corre davvero. Ma io mi trovo più preoccupata per certe minacce che sono più vicine a casa."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	She seems surprised. "Not many in your generation would say that," she says. "Even here on Poisonwood, where we ought to know better, many of those who were born after the days of slavery think the Alphas are no more than a myth, a story that Parliament uses to justify maintaining such a large Navy."|516|0
units.english: She seems surprised. "Not many in your generation would say that," she says. "Even here on Poisonwood, where we ought to know better, many of those who were born after the days of slavery think the Alphas are no more than a myth, a story that Parliament uses to justify maintaining such a large Navy."
units.italian: Sembra sorpresa. "Non molti della tua generazione direbbero così," dice. "Anche qui su Poisonwood, dove dovremmo saperne di più, molti di quelli nati dopo gli anni della schiavitù pensano che gli Alphas non siano altro che un mito, una storia che il Parlamento usa per giustificare il mantenimento di una Marina così grande."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	Alondo looks concerned. "I've heard the stories from the liberation of Poisonwood," he says, "but there was never any evidence. No photos, none of them captured. I thought it was just hype."|517|0
units.english: Alondo looks concerned. "I've heard the stories from the liberation of Poisonwood," he says, "but there was never any evidence. No photos, none of them captured. I thought it was just hype."
units.italian: Alondo sembra preoccupato. "Ho sentito i racconti della liberazione di Poisonwood," dice, "ma non c'è mai stata alcuna prova. Nessuna foto, nessuno di loro catturato. Pensavo fosse solo propaganda."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	She laughs. "Thugs. Children with no hope for the future. Petty criminals. The pirates are poorly organized, and their glory days are long past. But you are right, in a way, because those lawless worlds provide a hiding place for the few individuals who actually are a danger to our species. And that is the threat that weighs most heavily on my mind."|521|0
units.english: She laughs. "Thugs. Children with no hope for the future. Petty criminals. The pirates are poorly organized, and their glory days are long past. But you are right, in a way, because those lawless worlds provide a hiding place for the few individuals who actually are a danger to our species. And that is the threat that weighs most heavily on my mind."
units.italian: Ride. "Teppisti. Ragazzini senza speranza nel futuro. Piccoli criminali. I pirati sono male organizzati e i loro giorni di gloria sono finiti da tempo. Ma hai ragione, in un certo senso, perché quei mondi senza legge offrono un nascondiglio ai pochi individui che davvero sono un pericolo per la nostra specie. Ed è quella la minaccia che mi pesa di più sulla mente."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	She laughs. "You must watch far too many videos. The most powerful species in this galaxy are also the most peace-loving. Trust me, I should know. Here on the edge of human space, we receive... visitors, on occasion. They do not interfere in human events, but they came seeking information on a threat that concerns us both."|525|0
units.english: She laughs. "You must watch far too many videos. The most powerful species in this galaxy are also the most peace-loving. Trust me, I should know. Here on the edge of human space, we receive... visitors, on occasion. They do not interfere in human events, but they came seeking information on a threat that concerns us both."
units.italian: Ride. "Devi guardare troppi video. Le specie più potenti di questa galassia sono anche le più amanti della pace. Fidati, lo so bene. Qui ai margini dello spazio umano riceviamo... visite, ogni tanto. Non si intromettono negli affari umani, ma sono venuti a cercare informazioni su una minaccia che riguarda entrambi."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	She frowns. "That's in rather poor taste, don't you think? You certainly do have a certain... reputation, I'll admit. You might be the greatest threat the Republic faces today, but humanity? The threat I worry about is far greater than any single captain, no matter how powerful their fleet is."|529|0
units.english: She frowns. "That's in rather poor taste, don't you think? You certainly do have a certain... reputation, I'll admit. You might be the greatest threat the Republic faces today, but humanity? The threat I worry about is far greater than any single captain, no matter how powerful their fleet is."
units.italian: Si acciglia. "È di cattivo gusto, non ti pare? Certo, hai una certa... reputazione, lo ammetto. Potresti essere la più grande minaccia che la Repubblica affronta oggi, ma per l'umanità? La minaccia di cui mi preoccupo è molto più grande di qualsiasi singolo capitano, per quanto potente sia la sua flotta."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"What sort of threat?" you ask.|532|0
units.english: "What sort of threat?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che tipo di minaccia?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"Our world was enslaved for nearly a decade," she says. "Most of my childhood. We had been little more than an anarchist colony ourselves before that, though, so the Republic did nothing to aid us. Until the Disappearance."|535|0
units.english: "Our world was enslaved for nearly a decade," she says. "Most of my childhood. We had been little more than an anarchist colony ourselves before that, though, so the Republic did nothing to aid us. Until the Disappearance."
units.italian: "Il nostro mondo è stato in schiavitù per quasi un decennio," dice. "Quasi tutta la mia infanzia. Prima di allora, però, eravamo poco più di una colonia anarchica, quindi la Repubblica non fece nulla per aiutarci. Fino alla Sparizione."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"What was the Disappearance?"|537|0
units.english: "What was the Disappearance?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è stata la Sparizione?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"I was a teenage slave working in the factories at the time," she says. "Exactly the wrong age, as it turned out. One day the overseers informed us that all the eighteen-year-old girls had to have mandatory 'health checkups' that day. I won't describe what the 'checkup' involved, but it was bewildering and unpleasant. And nearly all those girls disappeared, that day. They never returned from the 'checkups.' Only a few of us were left behind. Most of the leftovers were girls who had been unlucky enough to already be pregnant at that age. Or lucky, as it turned out. But I didn't understand why they didn't take me."|539|0
units.english: "I was a teenage slave working in the factories at the time," she says. "Exactly the wrong age, as it turned out. One day the overseers informed us that all the eighteen-year-old girls had to have mandatory 'health checkups' that day. I won't describe what the 'checkup' involved, but it was bewildering and unpleasant. And nearly all those girls disappeared, that day. They never returned from the 'checkups.' Only a few of us were left behind. Most of the leftovers were girls who had been unlucky enough to already be pregnant at that age. Or lucky, as it turned out. But I didn't understand why they didn't take me."
units.italian: "All'epoca ero un'adolescente schiava che lavorava nelle fabbriche," dice. "Esattamente l'età sbagliata, come si è scoperto. Un giorno i sorveglianti ci informarono che tutte le ragazze di diciotto anni dovevano fare dei 'controlli medici' obbligatori quel giorno. Non descriverò che cosa prevedesse il 'controllo', ma è stato sconcertante e sgradevole. E quasi tutte quelle ragazze sono sparite, quel giorno. Non sono mai tornate dai 'controlli'. Solo poche di noi sono state lasciate indietro. Per lo più erano ragazze che avevano avuto la sfortuna di essere già incinte a quell'età. O la fortuna, come si è scoperto. Ma non capivo perché non avessero preso me."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	Alondo seems very disturbed by the story. "They were selling girls into prostitution?" he says.|540|0
units.english: Alondo seems very disturbed by the story. "They were selling girls into prostitution?" he says.
units.italian: Alondo sembra molto turbato dalla storia. "Vendevano le ragazze alla prostituzione?" dice.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"That's what we assumed," she says, "but there were dozens of girls like me who were not taken, even though we were not pregnant. It didn't make sense. Anyway, somehow news of that event got off-world and not long after, the Navy came in massive numbers, destroyed the slaver fleets and liberated our planet. In the process, they tried to invade an underground facility up in the mountains, which is where they thought the girls were being kept. But the facility was rigged to self-destruct, and they never found out what had been going on inside the facility. No one inside it survived."|541|0
units.english: "That's what we assumed," she says, "but there were dozens of girls like me who were not taken, even though we were not pregnant. It didn't make sense. Anyway, somehow news of that event got off-world and not long after, the Navy came in massive numbers, destroyed the slaver fleets and liberated our planet. In the process, they tried to invade an underground facility up in the mountains, which is where they thought the girls were being kept. But the facility was rigged to self-destruct, and they never found out what had been going on inside the facility. No one inside it survived."
units.italian: "È quello che abbiamo supposto," dice, "ma c'erano decine di ragazze come me che non sono state prese, anche se non erano incinte. Non aveva senso. Comunque, in qualche modo la notizia di quell'evento è uscita dal pianeta e non molto dopo è arrivata la Marina in forze enormi, ha distrutto le flotte degli schiavisti e ha liberato il nostro pianeta. Nel farlo hanno cercato di invadere un impianto sotterraneo su nelle montagne, dove pensavano che le ragazze fossero tenute. Ma l'impianto era predisposto per autodistruggersi, e non hanno mai scoperto che cosa succedesse là dentro. Nessuno all'interno è sopravvissuto."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"Did you ever find out why they let you go?"|543|0
units.english: "Did you ever find out why they let you go?"
units.italian: "Avete mai scoperto perché vi hanno lasciate andare?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"My parents said it was because I was so willful and stubborn, too hard to control," she says. "But years later, we began to discover that all of us who were passed over had one thing in common. We were all infertile. Had been already, the day of the Disappearance. Which means that either a bunch of pirates had suddenly decided they wanted to leave behind their lives of crime and settle down and raise families... or those girls were being used as incubators."|545|0
units.english: "My parents said it was because I was so willful and stubborn, too hard to control," she says. "But years later, we began to discover that all of us who were passed over had one thing in common. We were all infertile. Had been already, the day of the Disappearance. Which means that either a bunch of pirates had suddenly decided they wanted to leave behind their lives of crime and settle down and raise families... or those girls were being used as incubators."
units.italian: "I miei genitori dicevano che era perché ero troppo volitiva e testarda, difficile da controllare," dice. "Ma anni dopo abbiamo cominciato a scoprire che tutte noi che eravamo state saltate avevamo una cosa in comune. Eravamo tutte sterili. Lo eravamo già, il giorno della Sparizione. Il che significa che o un gruppo di pirati aveva improvvisamente deciso di lasciarsi alle spalle la vita criminale per metter su famiglia... oppure quelle ragazze venivano usate come incubatrici."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	Alondo says, "I hear that was common during the Alpha wars. Alpha genetics were so unstable, they needed hundreds of test subjects to produce a handful of viable Alpha babies. Those were evil days."|546|0
units.english: Alondo says, "I hear that was common during the Alpha wars. Alpha genetics were so unstable, they needed hundreds of test subjects to produce a handful of viable Alpha babies. Those were evil days."
units.italian: Alondo dice: "Ho sentito che era comune durante le guerre con gli Alphas. La genetica degli Alphas era così instabile che avevano bisogno di centinaia di soggetti di prova per produrre una manciata di bambini Alphas vitali. Erano giorni malvagi."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"Days that may yet return," she says. "Somewhere, maybe even nearby on Bloodsea or Greenrock or Albatross, the remnants of the Alphas may still be hiding. Creatures bred to be strong and clever and able to kill without a hint of remorse. And now that this sector of space is yours, the duty of defending against them becomes yours, as well. That is why I agreed to talk with you: to warn you of that reality."|547|0
units.english: "Days that may yet return," she says. "Somewhere, maybe even nearby on Bloodsea or Greenrock or Albatross, the remnants of the Alphas may still be hiding. Creatures bred to be strong and clever and able to kill without a hint of remorse. And now that this sector of space is yours, the duty of defending against them becomes yours, as well. That is why I agreed to talk with you: to warn you of that reality."
units.italian: "Giorni che potrebbero ancora tornare," dice. "Da qualche parte, magari anche qui vicino, su Bloodsea o Greenrock o Albatross, i resti degli Alphas potrebbero essere ancora nascosti. Creature allevate per essere forti e astute e capaci di uccidere senza il minimo rimorso. E ora che questo settore di spazio è vostro, anche il dovere di difendersi da loro diventa vostro. È per questo che ho accettato di parlare con voi: per avvertirvi di quella realtà."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	You and Alondo return to your ship with one more thing for the fledgling Free Worlds to worry about. "I guess now we should return to <planet> and report to the Council," he says.|548|0
units.english: You and Alondo return to your ship with one more thing for the fledgling Free Worlds to worry about. "I guess now we should return to <planet> and report to the Council," he says.
units.italian: Tu e Alondo tornate alla nave con un pensiero in più di cui le giovani Free Worlds devono preoccuparsi. "Credo che ora dovremmo tornare su <planet> e riferire al Consiglio," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|dialog|552|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Alondo hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Alondo non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|You meet Tomek, Freya, and JJ at the spaceport, and the entire Council quickly convenes. Given that you were Alondo's transportation during his mission, you are included in the meeting. Alondo outlines the results of the diplomatic mission, which he believes has been a success. Upon hearing about the extra supplies heading to Tarazed, Tomek suggests increasing patrols in the Dirt Belt to the east to help defend Syndicate convoys while also moving supplies from Tarazed to various Free planets.|560|0
units.english: You meet Tomek, Freya, and JJ at the spaceport, and the entire Council quickly convenes. Given that you were Alondo's transportation during his mission, you are included in the meeting. Alondo outlines the results of the diplomatic mission, which he believes has been a success. Upon hearing about the extra supplies heading to Tarazed, Tomek suggests increasing patrols in the Dirt Belt to the east to help defend Syndicate convoys while also moving supplies from Tarazed to various Free planets.
units.italian: Incontri Tomek, Freya e JJ allo spazioporto, e il Consiglio al completo si riunisce in fretta. Dato che eri il trasporto di Alondo durante la sua missione, sei incluso nella riunione. Alondo riassume i risultati della missione diplomatica, che ritiene un successo. Sentendo delle forniture extra dirette a Tarazed, Tomek propone di aumentare le pattuglie nella Fascia di Terra a est, per aiutare a difendere i convogli del Sindacato e allo stesso tempo spostare i rifornimenti da Tarazed ai vari pianeti delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"We're still healing from the last set of battles," says JJ. "An increased Free Worlds presence outside of our declared territory could be seen as a provocation."|561|0
units.english: "We're still healing from the last set of battles," says JJ. "An increased Free Worlds presence outside of our declared territory could be seen as a provocation."
units.italian: "Ci stiamo ancora riprendendo dall'ultima serie di battaglie," dice JJ. "Una presenza maggiore delle Free Worlds fuori dal nostro territorio dichiarato potrebbe essere vista come una provocazione."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"No doubt it will, but we need to uphold our end of the bargain with the Syndicate if we want to keep them as a tentative ally," Tomek responds. "We also have our deal with Tarazed for them to begin selling some of their ships within our territory. Those ships won't do us much good if they're getting blasted to pieces by pirates before they even get here."|562|0
units.english: "No doubt it will, but we need to uphold our end of the bargain with the Syndicate if we want to keep them as a tentative ally," Tomek responds. "We also have our deal with Tarazed for them to begin selling some of their ships within our territory. Those ships won't do us much good if they're getting blasted to pieces by pirates before they even get here."
units.italian: "Lo sarà senz'altro, ma dobbiamo mantenere la nostra parte dell'accordo con il Sindacato se vogliamo tenercelo come alleato provvisorio," risponde Tomek. "Abbiamo anche il nostro accordo con Tarazed perché comincino a vendere alcune delle loro navi nel nostro territorio. Quelle navi non ci serviranno a molto se vengono fatte a pezzi dai pirati prima ancora di arrivare."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"A deal with Tarazed for new ships? When did you make that?"|564|0
units.english: "A deal with Tarazed for new ships? When did you make that?"
units.italian: "Un accordo con Tarazed per nuove navi? Quando l'hai fatto?"

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"I'm willing to volunteer for escort duty."|566|0
units.english: "I'm willing to volunteer for escort duty."
units.italian: "Sono disposto a offrirmi volontario per il servizio di scorta."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"No need," says JJ. "We have plenty of captains who are already assigned to escort duty. We may need you elsewhere."|567|0
units.english: "No need," says JJ. "We have plenty of captains who are already assigned to escort duty. We may need you elsewhere."
units.italian: "Non serve," dice JJ. "Abbiamo molti capitani già assegnati al servizio di scorta. Potremmo aver bisogno di te altrove."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"Prior to when things went hot," says Tomek, "I saw to it that we could secure a supply line for new warships outside of our borders. Southbound may be a fine shipyard, but they alone can't supply us the warships we need, especially when the largest warship they build is the Bastion. Unfortunately, the Navy attacked before things could be finalized, and the outbreak of war has slowed things down, but Tarazed has assured us the deal is moving forward."|570|0
units.english: "Prior to when things went hot," says Tomek, "I saw to it that we could secure a supply line for new warships outside of our borders. Southbound may be a fine shipyard, but they alone can't supply us the warships we need, especially when the largest warship they build is the Bastion. Unfortunately, the Navy attacked before things could be finalized, and the outbreak of war has slowed things down, but Tarazed has assured us the deal is moving forward."
units.italian: "Prima che la situazione degenerasse," dice Tomek, "mi sono assicurato di poter garantire una linea di rifornimento per nuove navi da guerra fuori dai nostri confini. Southbound sarà anche un buon cantiere, ma da sola non può fornirci le navi da guerra che ci servono, tanto più che la più grande che costruisce è la Bastion. Purtroppo la Marina ha attaccato prima che si potesse concludere tutto, e lo scoppio della guerra ha rallentato le cose, ma Tarazed ci ha assicurato che l'accordo va avanti."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"Don't forget that Tarazed is also our only supplier of fighters for Southbound's Type F Haulers," Freya adds. "Unless you count the Boxwing, but those don't help much in a fight."|571|0
units.english: "Don't forget that Tarazed is also our only supplier of fighters for Southbound's Type F Haulers," Freya adds. "Unless you count the Boxwing, but those don't help much in a fight."
units.italian: "Non dimenticare che Tarazed è anche il nostro unico fornitore di caccia per i trasportatori Type F di Southbound," aggiunge Freya. "A meno che tu non voglia contare sui Boxwing, ma in combattimento non aiutano molto."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"There are a lot of moving parts at play in this conflict, Captain <last>," says JJ. "All we ask is that you stay focused on where we aim you, and you let us handle the finer details."|572|0
units.english: "There are a lot of moving parts at play in this conflict, Captain <last>," says JJ. "All we ask is that you stay focused on where we aim you, and you let us handle the finer details."
units.italian: "In questo conflitto ci sono molti pezzi in movimento, Capitano <last>," dice JJ. "Ti chiediamo solo di restare concentrato su dove ti puntiamo, e di lasciare a noi i dettagli più fini."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	After further discussion on the matter, the Council approves the increased patrols, although JJ remains somewhat apprehensive.|574|0
units.english: After further discussion on the matter, the Council approves the increased patrols, although JJ remains somewhat apprehensive.
units.italian: Dopo altre discussioni sull'argomento, il Consiglio approva l'aumento delle pattuglie, anche se JJ resta un po' apprensivo.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"There is one other thing," Alondo says. "The Syndicate informed us that the Republic has Katya in custody, accused of terrorism."|575|0
units.english: "There is one other thing," Alondo says. "The Syndicate informed us that the Republic has Katya in custody, accused of terrorism."
units.italian: "C'è un'altra cosa," dice Alondo. "Il Sindacato ci ha informati che la Repubblica ha Katya in custodia, accusata di terrorismo."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	The news is a shock to everyone. "I had begun to worry that was the case," says Freya.|576|0
units.english: The news is a shock to everyone. "I had begun to worry that was the case," says Freya.
units.italian: La notizia è uno shock per tutti. "Avevo cominciato a temere che fosse così," dice Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"My contacts within the Navy have heard rumors, but I suppose this confirms it," says JJ.|577|0
units.english: "My contacts within the Navy have heard rumors, but I suppose this confirms it," says JJ.
units.italian: "I miei contatti nella Marina avevano sentito voci, ma suppongo che questo lo confermi," dice JJ.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"Why have they not announced it publicly?" asks Tomek.|578|0
units.english: "Why have they not announced it publicly?" asks Tomek.
units.italian: "Perché non l'hanno annunciato pubblicamente?" chiede Tomek.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	"I suspect it's because they know she is innocent," says Alondo. "They say it is impossible to tell a lie to the Questioners, and in this case that will work in her favor."|579|0
units.english: "I suspect it's because they know she is innocent," says Alondo. "They say it is impossible to tell a lie to the Questioners, and in this case that will work in her favor."
units.italian: "Sospetto che sia perché sanno che è innocente," dice Alondo. "Dicono che sia impossibile mentire agli Interrogatori, e in questo caso sarà a suo favore."

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	After further discussion, the Council eventually dismisses you as they move on to other topics that don't directly concern you.|580|0
units.english: After further discussion, the Council eventually dismisses you as they move on to other topics that don't directly concern you.
units.italian: Dopo altre discussioni, il Consiglio alla fine ti congeda, passando ad altri argomenti che non ti riguardano direttamente.

units.id: mission:FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D|	A while later, after the Council meeting is adjourned, Tomek approaches you and says, "Meet me in the spaceport when you are ready for your next assignment. Also," he gives you <payment>, "the Council has approved a bonus for you. Excellent work, Captain."|581|0
units.english: A while later, after the Council meeting is adjourned, Tomek approaches you and says, "Meet me in the spaceport when you are ready for your next assignment. Also," he gives you <payment>, "the Council has approved a bonus for you. Excellent work, Captain."
units.italian: Un po' più tardi, dopo che la riunione del Consiglio è stata aggiornata, Tomek ti si avvicina e dice: "Incontrami allo spazioporto quando sei pronto per il tuo prossimo incarico. E inoltre," ti dà <payment>, "il Consiglio ha approvato un bonus per te. Ottimo lavoro, Capitano."

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1|name|587|0
units.english: Early Warning Systems
units.italian: Sistemi di allerta precoce

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1|description|588|0
units.english: Land on the abandoned planet <destination> and place sensors there to monitor Navy fleet activity in the system.
units.italian: Atterra sul pianeta abbandonato <destination> e installa lì dei sensori per monitorare l'attività della flotta della Marina nel sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1|blocked|592|0
units.english: Freya contacts you and says, "<first>, you're going to need ten tons of cargo space for this next mission." You should return here after freeing up <capacity>.
units.italian: Freya ti contatta e dice: "<first>, avrai bisogno di dieci tonnellate di spazio cargo per questa prossima missione." Dovresti tornare qui dopo aver liberato <capacity>.

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1|You meet up with Tomek and Freya, who are looking over a map of the nearby systems. "This is a choke point," says Freya, pointing to the Wei system. "Any attack on us will come either through Wei or Lesath, and Wei is much more likely. And that also means that if we can monitor what is happening there, we will have advance warning of any attack."|600|0
units.english: You meet up with Tomek and Freya, who are looking over a map of the nearby systems. "This is a choke point," says Freya, pointing to the Wei system. "Any attack on us will come either through Wei or Lesath, and Wei is much more likely. And that also means that if we can monitor what is happening there, we will have advance warning of any attack."
units.italian: Incontri Tomek e Freya, che stanno esaminando una mappa dei sistemi vicini. "Questo è un punto di strozzatura," dice Freya, indicando il sistema Wei. "Qualsiasi attacco contro di noi arriverà da Wei o da Lesath, e Wei è molto più probabile. E questo significa anche che, se riusciamo a monitorare che cosa succede là, avremo un avviso anticipato di qualsiasi attacco."

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1|	"And with us strengthening our patrols to the east, we'll need any advance warning we can get, even if only a single day." says Tomek. "Now, as you may know, the planet Hope is in the Wei system. It's a former colony that is now an ice planet. Our plan is to deploy a sensor network on Hope, tracking every ship in system. Freya designed the equipment, so she can explain how to deploy it."|601|0
units.english: "And with us strengthening our patrols to the east, we'll need any advance warning we can get, even if only a single day." says Tomek. "Now, as you may know, the planet Hope is in the Wei system. It's a former colony that is now an ice planet. Our plan is to deploy a sensor network on Hope, tracking every ship in system. Freya designed the equipment, so she can explain how to deploy it."
units.italian: "E dato che stiamo rafforzando le pattuglie a est, avremo bisogno di ogni avviso anticipato che possiamo ottenere, anche di un solo giorno," dice Tomek. "Ora, come forse saprai, il pianeta Hope è nel sistema Wei. È un'ex colonia che ora è un pianeta di ghiaccio. Il nostro piano è installare su Hope una rete di sensori che segua ogni nave nel sistema. Freya ha progettato l'equipaggiamento, quindi può spiegarti come installarlo."

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1|	Freya explains where on the planet each sensor should be installed, and how to cover them in insulative shielding so their heat and energy signatures will be difficult to detect. "Once the network is deployed," she says, "you will begin receiving telemetry. A good way to test it is to make sure it is picking up your own ship. Any questions?"|602|0
units.english: Freya explains where on the planet each sensor should be installed, and how to cover them in insulative shielding so their heat and energy signatures will be difficult to detect. "Once the network is deployed," she says, "you will begin receiving telemetry. A good way to test it is to make sure it is picking up your own ship. Any questions?"
units.italian: Freya spiega dove va installato ciascun sensore sul pianeta e come ricoprirlo di schermature isolanti, così che le sue firme termiche ed energetiche siano difficili da rilevare. "Una volta installata la rete," dice, "comincerai a ricevere la telemetria. Un buon modo per provarla è assicurarsi che rilevi la tua stessa nave. Domande?"

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1|	"No, sounds good."|604|0
units.english: "No, sounds good."
units.italian: "No, mi sembra bene."

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1B|name|614|0
units.english: Early Warning Systems
units.italian: Sistemi di allerta precoce

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1B|description|615|0
units.english: Report back to Freya on <planet>.
units.italian: Riferisci a Freya su <planet>.

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|log|654|0
units.english: Planted some sensors on the abandoned world of Hope, as an early warning system for Navy raids on Free Worlds space. The Navy appears to be doing something on this world as well.
units.italian: Hai installato alcuni sensori sul mondo abbandonato di Hope, come sistema di allerta precoce contro le incursioni della Marina nello spazio delle Free Worlds. A quanto pare anche la Marina sta facendo qualcosa su questo mondo.

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|You land on Hope, place Freya's surveillance rigs in the locations she specified, and fire them up. Telemetry starts coming in, and you verify that your own ship is showing up in the scans. However, they are also picking up an unidentified heat signature on another part of Hope. Do you investigate?|656|0
units.english: You land on Hope, place Freya's surveillance rigs in the locations she specified, and fire them up. Telemetry starts coming in, and you verify that your own ship is showing up in the scans. However, they are also picking up an unidentified heat signature on another part of Hope. Do you investigate?
units.italian: Atterri su Hope, installi gli apparecchi di sorveglianza di Freya nei punti che ha indicato e li accendi. La telemetria comincia ad arrivare, e verifichi che anche la tua nave compare nelle scansioni. Però rilevano anche una firma termica non identificata in un'altra zona di Hope. Vuoi indagare?

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	(Of course!)|658|0
units.english: (Of course!)
units.italian: (Certo, altroché!)

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	(No, sounds risky.)|659|0
units.english: (No, sounds risky.)
units.italian: (No, sembra rischioso.)

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	You approach the location, flying low to avoid detection, and come upon a Navy Gunboat, landed on the planet. Some distance away from the ship, several figures in thick snowsuits are setting up some sort of equipment with lots of antennae. It seems that the Navy had the same idea as Freya, of using this world as a listening post. Your sensors show that the Gunboat is powered down.|664|0
units.english: You approach the location, flying low to avoid detection, and come upon a Navy Gunboat, landed on the planet. Some distance away from the ship, several figures in thick snowsuits are setting up some sort of equipment with lots of antennae. It seems that the Navy had the same idea as Freya, of using this world as a listening post. Your sensors show that the Gunboat is powered down.
units.italian: Ti avvicini alla posizione volando basso per non essere rilevato, e arrivi davanti a una cannoniera della Marina atterrata sul pianeta. A una certa distanza dalla nave, diverse figure in pesanti tute da neve stanno montando una specie di apparecchiatura con molte antenne. Sembra che la Marina abbia avuto la stessa idea di Freya: usare questo mondo come posto di ascolto. I tuoi sensori mostrano che la cannoniera è spenta.

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	The moment your ship comes over the horizon, they start running back toward the Gunboat. You destroy their equipment with a few well-placed shots, then train your guns on the crew members, who are still some distance from their ship. When they realize they cannot get back to it before being shot, they raise their hands in surrender.|665|0
units.english: The moment your ship comes over the horizon, they start running back toward the Gunboat. You destroy their equipment with a few well-placed shots, then train your guns on the crew members, who are still some distance from their ship. When they realize they cannot get back to it before being shot, they raise their hands in surrender.
units.italian: Nel momento in cui la tua nave appare all'orizzonte, quelli cominciano a correre verso la cannoniera. Distruggi la loro apparecchiatura con qualche colpo ben piazzato, poi punti i cannoni sull'equipaggio, che è ancora a una certa distanza dalla nave. Quando capiscono che non possono arrivarci prima di essere colpiti, alzano le mani in segno di resa.

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	You count eight crew members in the group, which is the typical crew complement of a Gunboat. That may mean the Gunboat is uncrewed, and you could kill the crew and steal it. On the other hand, if there are more crew aboard the ship it would be better to destroy it first, then finish off the landing crew.|666|0
units.english: You count eight crew members in the group, which is the typical crew complement of a Gunboat. That may mean the Gunboat is uncrewed, and you could kill the crew and steal it. On the other hand, if there are more crew aboard the ship it would be better to destroy it first, then finish off the landing crew.
units.italian: Conti otto membri dell'equipaggio nel gruppo, che è il numero tipico di una cannoniera. Questo potrebbe significare che la cannoniera è senza equipaggio, e potresti uccidere l'equipaggio e prendertela. D'altra parte, se a bordo ci fosse altro equipaggio, sarebbe meglio distruggere prima la nave e poi finire il gruppo a terra.

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	(Destroy the ship, then finish off the crew.)|668|0
units.english: (Destroy the ship, then finish off the crew.)
units.italian: (Distruggi la nave, poi finisci l'equipaggio.)

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	(Kill the landing crew, then steal their ship.)|670|0
units.english: (Kill the landing crew, then steal their ship.)
units.italian: (Uccidi il gruppo a terra, poi prenditi la nave.)

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	(Accept the crew's surrender.)|672|0
units.english: (Accept the crew's surrender.)
units.italian: (Accetta la resa dell'equipaggio.)

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	It turns out you made the right choice: someone is indeed onboard the Gunboat still, because the moment you open fire it raises shields and starts powering up its engines and weapons. But, your initial shots must have damaged some critical systems, because it only manages to fire a few shots at you and to lift off about thirty meters into the air before crashing back down onto the ice and exploding. You quickly pick off the landing crew as well; they have no place to hide on the broad, flat glacial expanse.|676|0
units.english: It turns out you made the right choice: someone is indeed onboard the Gunboat still, because the moment you open fire it raises shields and starts powering up its engines and weapons. But, your initial shots must have damaged some critical systems, because it only manages to fire a few shots at you and to lift off about thirty meters into the air before crashing back down onto the ice and exploding. You quickly pick off the landing crew as well; they have no place to hide on the broad, flat glacial expanse.
units.italian: A quanto pare hai fatto la scelta giusta: qualcuno è davvero ancora a bordo della cannoniera, perché nel momento in cui apri il fuoco alza gli scudi e comincia ad accendere motori e armi. Ma i tuoi primi colpi devono aver danneggiato qualche sistema critico, perché riesce solo a spararti qualche colpo e a sollevarsi di una trentina di metri prima di schiantarsi di nuovo sul ghiaccio ed esplodere. Elimini in fretta anche il gruppo a terra; non hanno dove nascondersi nella distesa glaciale ampia e piatta.

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	Your own mission is complete, so it's time to return to <planet> and report to Freya.|677|0
units.english: Your own mission is complete, so it's time to return to <planet> and report to Freya.
units.italian: La tua missione è conclusa, quindi è tempo di tornare su <planet> e riferire a Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	The landing crew has absolutely nowhere to hide in this glacial field; you pick them off easily. There is no response from the ship, so you land beside it and prepare to board it. But, the moment you open your hatch, the other ship roars to life, powering up its engines and beating a hasty retreat while firing a few parting shots at you from its turret. You fire up your own engines and pursue it...|681|0
units.english: The landing crew has absolutely nowhere to hide in this glacial field; you pick them off easily. There is no response from the ship, so you land beside it and prepare to board it. But, the moment you open your hatch, the other ship roars to life, powering up its engines and beating a hasty retreat while firing a few parting shots at you from its turret. You fire up your own engines and pursue it...
units.italian: Il gruppo a terra non ha assolutamente dove nascondersi in questo campo glaciale; li elimini facilmente. Non c'è risposta dalla nave, quindi atterri accanto e ti prepari ad abbordarla. Ma nel momento in cui apri il portello, l'altra nave si risveglia con un rombo, accende i motori e batte in ritirata in fretta, sparandoti qualche colpo di commiato dalla torretta. Accendi i tuoi motori e la insegui...

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	Most ships are equipped with external speakers for exactly this sort of situation. You target the ship, and your scanners identify it as the <npc>.|688|0
units.english: Most ships are equipped with external speakers for exactly this sort of situation. You target the ship, and your scanners identify it as the <npc>.
units.italian: La maggior parte delle navi è dotata di altoparlanti esterni proprio per situazioni come questa. Inquadri la nave, e i tuoi scanner la identificano come la <npc>.

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	"Crew of the <npc>, this is Captain <last> of the Free Worlds ship <ship>," you announce. "I accept your surrender, but will you each give me your word of honor that you will take no further part in fighting the Free Worlds?"|689|0
units.english: "Crew of the <npc>, this is Captain <last> of the Free Worlds ship <ship>," you announce. "I accept your surrender, but will you each give me your word of honor that you will take no further part in fighting the Free Worlds?"
units.italian: "Equipaggio della <npc>, sono il Capitano <last> della nave <ship> delle Free Worlds," annunci. "Accetto la vostra resa, ma mi date ciascuno la vostra parola d'onore che non prenderete più parte ai combattimenti contro le Free Worlds?"

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	The soldiers appear to think for a brief moment before one of them holds their hand high in front of them, giving you a thumbs-up sign. The rest of the soldiers quickly follow suit without any hesitation.|690|0
units.english: The soldiers appear to think for a brief moment before one of them holds their hand high in front of them, giving you a thumbs-up sign. The rest of the soldiers quickly follow suit without any hesitation.
units.italian: I soldati sembrano riflettere un momento, poi uno di loro alza la mano davanti a sé e ti fa il pollice in su. Gli altri lo imitano subito, senza esitazione.

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	"Thank you," you reply. "You may return to your ship and fly back to Republic space."|691|0
units.english: "Thank you," you reply. "You may return to your ship and fly back to Republic space."
units.italian: "Grazie," rispondi. "Potete tornare alla vostra nave e rientrare nello spazio della Repubblica."

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	The Navy soldiers exchange looks, apparently surprised, but they recover quickly. One of them snaps to attention and salutes you. You return the salute, and then, realizing their captain can't see you, flash your ship's external lights in acknowledgment. The <npc>'s crew fall into formation, march back to their ship, fire up their engines, and take off. Their weapon systems remain unarmed and inactive, as far as your sensors can tell.|692|0
units.english: The Navy soldiers exchange looks, apparently surprised, but they recover quickly. One of them snaps to attention and salutes you. You return the salute, and then, realizing their captain can't see you, flash your ship's external lights in acknowledgment. The <npc>'s crew fall into formation, march back to their ship, fire up their engines, and take off. Their weapon systems remain unarmed and inactive, as far as your sensors can tell.
units.italian: I soldati della Marina si scambiano sguardi, apparentemente sorpresi, ma si riprendono in fretta. Uno di loro scatta sull'attenti e ti fa il saluto. Ricambi il saluto, e poi, rendendoti conto che il loro capitano non può vederti, fai lampeggiare le luci esterne della nave in segno di riconoscimento. L'equipaggio della <npc> si mette in formazione, torna alla nave, accende i motori e decolla. I sistemi d'arma restano scarichi e inattivi, per quanto possano dire i tuoi sensori.

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1C|	Your mission on this planet done, you launch into space too, monitoring the Navy ship.|693|0
units.english: Your mission on this planet done, you launch into space too, monitoring the Navy ship.
units.italian: Conclusa la tua missione su questo pianeta, decolli anche tu, tenendo d'occhio la nave della Marina.

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1D|name|705|0
units.english: Destroy Sensors
units.italian: Distruggi i sensori

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1D|description|706|0
units.english: Travel back to <destination> and destroy any Republic sensors you find there.
units.italian: Torna su <destination> e distruggi tutti i sensori della Repubblica che ci trovi.

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1D|You report back to Freya and Tomek. "I saw a weird sensor blip," you say, "but I was afraid to follow up on it. It may have been the Navy, planting sensors of their own, or doing something else on the planet."|716|0
units.english: You report back to Freya and Tomek. "I saw a weird sensor blip," you say, "but I was afraid to follow up on it. It may have been the Navy, planting sensors of their own, or doing something else on the planet."
units.italian: Riferisci a Freya e Tomek. "Ho visto uno strano segnale dei sensori," dici, "ma avevo paura di andare a controllare. Potrebbero essere stati della Marina, che installava sensori propri, o che faceva qualcos'altro sul pianeta."

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1D|You report back to Freya and Tomek. "The sensors are deployed," you say, "but I caught the Navy doing the same thing. I destroyed one of their installations, but there might be others."|719|0
units.english: You report back to Freya and Tomek. "The sensors are deployed," you say, "but I caught the Navy doing the same thing. I destroyed one of their installations, but there might be others."
units.italian: Riferisci a Freya e Tomek. "I sensori sono installati," dici, "ma ho sorpreso la Marina a fare la stessa cosa. Ho distrutto una delle loro installazioni, ma potrebbero essercene altre."

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1D|	Tomek frowns. "What do you think, Freya?"|721|0
units.english: Tomek frowns. "What do you think, Freya?"
units.italian: Tomek si acciglia. "Che cosa ne pensi, Freya?"

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1D|	"I'd say, live and let live. We have no plans to expand north, so it doesn't cost us anything for them to know what is happening in that system. And we don't have resources to spare on sweeping the planet for their sensors."|722|0
units.english: "I'd say, live and let live. We have no plans to expand north, so it doesn't cost us anything for them to know what is happening in that system. And we don't have resources to spare on sweeping the planet for their sensors."
units.italian: "Direi: vivi e lascia vivere. Non abbiamo piani di espansione a nord, quindi non ci costa niente che sappiano che cosa succede in quel sistema. E non abbiamo risorse da sprecare per setacciare il pianeta in cerca dei loro sensori."

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1D|	"Makes sense to me."|724|0
units.english: "Makes sense to me."
units.italian: "Mi sembra sensato."

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1D|	"Well, I'd rather not give them any advantage, no matter how slight."|725|0
units.english: "Well, I'd rather not give them any advantage, no matter how slight."
units.italian: "Beh, preferirei non dargli alcun vantaggio, per quanto piccolo."

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1D|	"Good," says Freya, "because I've got a much more interesting job for you to do next. The people at Kraz Cybernetics have a new toy they want to test out, and I volunteered you to help out. They're waiting for you on Rust, in the Kraz system."|728|0
units.english: "Good," says Freya, "because I've got a much more interesting job for you to do next. The people at Kraz Cybernetics have a new toy they want to test out, and I volunteered you to help out. They're waiting for you on Rust, in the Kraz system."
units.italian: "Bene," dice Freya, "perché ho un lavoro molto più interessante per te. Quelli della Kraz Cybernetics hanno un giocattolo nuovo che vogliono provare, e ti ho offerto volontario per dare una mano. Ti aspettano su Rust, nel sistema Kraz."

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1D|	"It's up to you," says Tomek. "If you want to go back there, you can. But it'll just create more ill will, without gaining us any tactical advantage."|732|0
units.english: "It's up to you," says Tomek. "If you want to go back there, you can. But it'll just create more ill will, without gaining us any tactical advantage."
units.italian: "Dipende da te," dice Tomek. "Se vuoi tornarci, puoi. Ma creerà solo altra ostilità, senza darci alcun vantaggio tattico."

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1D|	"Also," says Freya, "I've got a much more interesting mission for you. The people at Kraz Cybernetics have a new toy they want to test out, and I volunteered you to help out. They're waiting for you on Rust, in the Kraz system."|733|0
units.english: "Also," says Freya, "I've got a much more interesting mission for you. The people at Kraz Cybernetics have a new toy they want to test out, and I volunteered you to help out. They're waiting for you on Rust, in the Kraz system."
units.italian: "Inoltre," dice Freya, "ho una missione molto più interessante per te. Quelli della Kraz Cybernetics hanno un giocattolo nuovo che vogliono provare, e ti ho offerto volontario per dare una mano. Ti aspettano su Rust, nel sistema Kraz."

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1D|	"Sorry, but I hate leaving a job unfinished. I want to destroy those sensors."|735|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I hate leaving a job unfinished. I want to destroy those sensors."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma odio lasciare un lavoro a metà. Voglio distruggere quei sensori."

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1D|	"Okay, you've convinced me."|736|0
units.english: "Okay, you've convinced me."
units.italian: "Va bene, mi hai convinto."

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1D|	"Fine," says Freya, "but report to Rust when you're done. And try not to get yourself killed." She's clearly disappointed in you.|739|0
units.english: "Fine," says Freya, "but report to Rust when you're done. And try not to get yourself killed." She's clearly disappointed in you.
units.italian: "Bene," dice Freya, "ma presentati su Rust quando hai finito. E cerca di non farti ammazzare." È chiaramente delusa da te.

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1D|log|749|0
units.english: Destroyed some Navy sensor installations on Hope, but it will likely be only a matter of days before they replace them.
units.italian: Hai distrutto alcune installazioni di sensori della Marina su Hope, ma probabilmente passeranno solo pochi giorni prima che le sostituiscano.

units.id: mission:FW Hope Recon 1D|You spend a while sweeping the planet and hoping that the Navy won't come after you. In all, you discover three more sensor installations. There is no way to be sure if you found them all, but it's time now for you to report for duty on Rust.|751|0
units.english: You spend a while sweeping the planet and hoping that the Navy won't come after you. In all, you discover three more sensor installations. There is no way to be sure if you found them all, but it's time now for you to report for duty on Rust.
units.italian: Passi un po' di tempo a setacciare il pianeta, sperando che la Marina non ti dia la caccia. In tutto scopri altre tre installazioni di sensori. Non c'è modo di essere sicuro di averle trovate tutte, ma ora è tempo di presentarti in servizio su Rust.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1|name|757|0
units.english: Weapons Testing
units.italian: Prova delle armi

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1|description|758|0
units.english: Report to <destination> to assist in some experimental weapons testing.
units.italian: Presentati su <destination> per assistere a una prova sperimentale di armi.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|name|771|0
units.english: Weapons Testing
units.italian: Prova delle armi

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|description|772|0
units.english: As a test for the new Plasma Turret, assist the Walloping Window-Blind in destroying the Red Nile, a pirate ship that is probably in the <marks> system. Then return to <planet>.
units.italian: Come prova della nuova torretta al plasma, aiuta la Walloping Window-Blind a distruggere la Red Nile, una nave pirata che probabilmente si trova nel sistema <marks>. Poi torna su <planet>.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|log|781|0
units.english: Barmy Edward is the Chief Offensive Engineer at Kraz Cybernetics, known for his inventive and sometimes impractical weapon designs. Supposedly, his engineers gave him the "Barmy" sobriquet after an incident where an experimental epoxy cannon he was working on exploded and glued him to the ceiling.
units.italian: Barmy Edward è il capo ingegnere offensivo della Kraz Cybernetics, noto per i suoi progetti di armi fantasiosi e a volte poco pratici. A quanto pare i suoi ingegneri gli hanno affibbiato il soprannome "Barmy" dopo un incidente in cui un cannone sperimentale a base di resina epossidica su cui stava lavorando è esploso e lo ha incollato al soffitto.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|You are met in the spaceport by a junior engineer from Kraz Cybernetics, who leads you to their facility and introduces you to his boss, who is known as "Barmy Edward." Edward is wearing a set of thick welding glasses and smoking a cigarette. "Pleased to meet you," he says, extending a hand that is encased in a heavy leather glove.|784|0
units.english: You are met in the spaceport by a junior engineer from Kraz Cybernetics, who leads you to their facility and introduces you to his boss, who is known as "Barmy Edward." Edward is wearing a set of thick welding glasses and smoking a cigarette. "Pleased to meet you," he says, extending a hand that is encased in a heavy leather glove.
units.italian: Nello spazioporto ti accoglie un ingegnere junior della Kraz Cybernetics, che ti porta alla loro struttura e ti presenta il suo capo, noto come "Barmy Edward". Edward indossa un paio di spessi occhiali da saldatura e sta fumando una sigaretta. "Piacere di conoscerti," dice, tendendoti una mano racchiusa in un pesante guanto di cuoio.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"Pleased to meet you, too, sir."|786|0
units.english: "Pleased to meet you, too, sir."
units.italian: "Piacere mio, signore."

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"Same here."|787|0
units.english: "Same here."
units.italian: "Altrettanto."

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"Don't call me 'sir,'" he says. "I'm not wearing a suit."|790|0
units.english: "Don't call me 'sir,'" he says. "I'm not wearing a suit."
units.italian: "Non chiamarmi 'signore'," dice. "Non porto la cravatta."

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"Sorry," you say. "It's just all these militia habits I'm learning."|791|0
units.english: "Sorry," you say. "It's just all these militia habits I'm learning."
units.italian: "Scusa," dici. "Sono tutte queste abitudini da milizia che sto imparando."

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"I've heard good things about your work," he says. "Assisting the Free Worlds and all. Not that I'm big on politics, but I do like blowing things up."|795|0
units.english: "I've heard good things about your work," he says. "Assisting the Free Worlds and all. Not that I'm big on politics, but I do like blowing things up."
units.italian: "Ho sentito parlare bene del tuo lavoro," dice. "Aiutare le Free Worlds e tutto il resto. Non che mi interessi molto la politica, ma mi piace far saltare le cose in aria."

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"Me too."|797|0
units.english: "Me too."
units.italian: "Anche a me."

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"Well, we try to only blow things up when strictly necessary."|798|0
units.english: "Well, we try to only blow things up when strictly necessary."
units.italian: "Beh, noi cerchiamo di far saltare le cose in aria solo quando è strettamente necessario."

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"Of course," he says. "Anyway, I bet you're wondering what new toys we're going to let you play with." You nod. He says, "We've been trying to come up with a weapon for our capital ships, something that's a match for one of the Navy's Heavy Laser Turrets. Something more elegant than those awful Quad Blaster Turrets the Syndicate makes. So I thought, why not take the biggest thing we've got, and then mount a pair of them on a turret?" He beckons for you to follow, and leads you through a door and into a hangar.|801|0
units.english: "Of course," he says. "Anyway, I bet you're wondering what new toys we're going to let you play with." You nod. He says, "We've been trying to come up with a weapon for our capital ships, something that's a match for one of the Navy's Heavy Laser Turrets. Something more elegant than those awful Quad Blaster Turrets the Syndicate makes. So I thought, why not take the biggest thing we've got, and then mount a pair of them on a turret?" He beckons for you to follow, and leads you through a door and into a hangar.
units.italian: "Certo," dice. "Comunque, scommetto che ti stai chiedendo con quali giocattoli nuovi ti faremo giocare." Annuisci. Dice: "Stavamo cercando di mettere a punto un'arma per le nostre navi capitali, qualcosa che regga il confronto con una delle torrette laser pesanti della Marina. Qualcosa di più elegante di quelle orribili torrette blaster quadruple che produce il Sindacato. Così ho pensato: perché non prendere la cosa più grande che abbiamo e montarne un paio su una torretta?" Ti fa cenno di seguirlo e ti guida attraverso una porta in un hangar.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	In front of you is a turret. It is almost absurdly large: a pair of Plasma Cannons mounted on a massive rotating base. "Sixty tons," says Barmy Edward. "Draws more power than... well, than anything else, practically. Runs a little hot, too."|803|0
units.english: In front of you is a turret. It is almost absurdly large: a pair of Plasma Cannons mounted on a massive rotating base. "Sixty tons," says Barmy Edward. "Draws more power than... well, than anything else, practically. Runs a little hot, too."
units.italian: Davanti a te c'è una torretta. È grande quasi in modo assurdo: un paio di cannoni al plasma montati su una massiccia base rotante. "Sessanta tonnellate," dice Barmy Edward. "Assorbe più energia di... beh, praticamente di qualsiasi altra cosa. Scalda anche un bel po'."

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"It's so... big!"|805|0
units.english: "It's so... big!"
units.italian: "È così... grande!"

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"I want one!"|806|0
units.english: "I want one!"
units.italian: "Ne voglio una!"

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"That's the ugliest turret I've ever seen."|808|0
units.english: "That's the ugliest turret I've ever seen."
units.italian: "È la torretta più brutta che abbia mai visto."

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"Kind of mesmerizing, huh?" he says.|811|0
units.english: "Kind of mesmerizing, huh?" he says.
units.italian: "Un po' ipnotica, eh?" dice.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"Well, you'll have to wait a month or two for us to work out the kinks," he says.|815|0
units.english: "Well, you'll have to wait a month or two for us to work out the kinks," he says.
units.italian: "Beh, dovrai aspettare un mese o due perché sistemiamo i difetti," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"If you're looking for pretty," he says, "go buy one of those wussy guns that Lovelace Labs churn out. We don't do pretty here."|819|0
units.english: "If you're looking for pretty," he says, "go buy one of those wussy guns that Lovelace Labs churn out. We don't do pretty here."
units.italian: "Se cerchi la bellezza," dice, "vai a comprarti uno di quei cannoncini mollaccioni che sfornano ai Lovelace Labs. Qui non facciamo cose belle."

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"So, where do I come in?" you ask.|822|0
units.english: "So, where do I come in?" you ask.
units.italian: "Allora, dove entro in scena io?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"Well, the Council says no testing against the Navy... yet. No point in provoking a fight just to try out an untested weapon. So I asked them what other target they could suggest, and they mentioned this pirate ship by the name of Red Nile that's been haunting the <marks> system, sniping on merchants that take a wrong turn and end up there."|823|0
units.english: "Well, the Council says no testing against the Navy... yet. No point in provoking a fight just to try out an untested weapon. So I asked them what other target they could suggest, and they mentioned this pirate ship by the name of Red Nile that's been haunting the <marks> system, sniping on merchants that take a wrong turn and end up there."
units.italian: "Beh, il Consiglio dice niente test contro la Marina... per ora. Non ha senso provocare uno scontro solo per provare un'arma mai collaudata. Così ho chiesto che altro bersaglio potessero suggerire, e mi hanno parlato di questa nave pirata di nome Red Nile che infesta il sistema <marks>, cecchinando i mercanti che sbagliano strada e finiscono là."

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	With a grand gesture, he indicates an aging Tarazed Falcon parked in the far corner of the hangar. It's a little rusty, and the paint is flaking, but a Falcon is an impressive ship under any circumstances. "We packed four of our prototypes into our department's very own test ship, the Walloping Window-Blind. We can't let you fly her, of course," he says, "on account of she's dearer to us than our own children. So the plan is, the Window-Blind will accompany you to <marks>, and you fight the pirates together, taking careful note of how the guns perform. Sound like fun?"|824|0
units.english: With a grand gesture, he indicates an aging Tarazed Falcon parked in the far corner of the hangar. It's a little rusty, and the paint is flaking, but a Falcon is an impressive ship under any circumstances. "We packed four of our prototypes into our department's very own test ship, the Walloping Window-Blind. We can't let you fly her, of course," he says, "on account of she's dearer to us than our own children. So the plan is, the Window-Blind will accompany you to <marks>, and you fight the pirates together, taking careful note of how the guns perform. Sound like fun?"
units.italian: Con un gesto ampio ti indica un vecchio Falcon di Tarazed parcheggiato nell'angolo più lontano dell'hangar. È un po' arrugginito e la vernice si sta staccando, ma un Falcon è una nave impressionante in ogni caso. "Abbiamo infilato quattro dei nostri prototipi nella nave collaudo del nostro reparto, la Walloping Window-Blind. Non possiamo lasciarti pilotarla, naturalmente," dice, "perché ci è più cara dei nostri figli. Quindi il piano è: la Window-Blind ti accompagna su <marks>, combattete insieme i pirati, e tu prendi nota con attenzione di come si comportano i cannoni. Ti sembra divertente?"

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"You bet!"|826|0
units.english: "You bet!"
units.italian: "Decisamente!"

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"What sort of ship is the Red Nile?"|828|0
units.english: "What sort of ship is the Red Nile?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di nave è la Red Nile?"

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"One of those antiques from Betelgeuse," he says. "Shouldn't give you any bother. Meet us back here when you're done."|830|0
units.english: "One of those antiques from Betelgeuse," he says. "Shouldn't give you any bother. Meet us back here when you're done."
units.italian: "Una di quelle antichità di Betelgeuse," dice. "Non dovrebbe darti fastidio. Torna qui quando hai finito."

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|dialog|844|0
units.english: The <npc> has been eliminated. Time to return to <destination> and report to Barmy Edward.
units.italian: La <npc> è stata eliminata. È tempo di tornare su <destination> e riferire a Barmy Edward.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|dialog|847|0
units.english: You have returned to <planet>, but your mission is not complete - either the Red Nile is not destroyed, or you have left the Walloping Window-Blind behind.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma la tua missione non è completa: o la Red Nile non è stata distrutta, o hai lasciato indietro la Walloping Window-Blind.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|log|851|0
units.english: Assisted a Kraz Cybernetics engineer known as Barmy Edward with a test of a new and extremely powerful Plasma Cannon turret.
units.italian: Hai assistito un ingegnere della Kraz Cybernetics noto come Barmy Edward nella prova di una nuova ed estremamente potente torretta con cannoni al plasma.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|When you enter the hangar, the Window-Blind has just returned, and a team of engineers is looking it over. Barmy Edward puts down his work to come over and debrief you. "How did the turrets perform?" he asks.|854|0
units.english: When you enter the hangar, the Window-Blind has just returned, and a team of engineers is looking it over. Barmy Edward puts down his work to come over and debrief you. "How did the turrets perform?" he asks.
units.italian: Quando entri nell'hangar, la Window-Blind è appena rientrata, e una squadra di ingegneri la sta esaminando. Barmy Edward posa il lavoro per venire a farti il debriefing. "Come si sono comportate le torrette?" chiede.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"Very impressive. I want a few of those on my own ship."|856|0
units.english: "Very impressive. I want a few of those on my own ship."
units.italian: "Molto impressionanti. Ne voglio un paio sulla mia nave."

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"Well, I was a bit worried about the ship overheating, but otherwise they work well."|857|0
units.english: "Well, I was a bit worried about the ship overheating, but otherwise they work well."
units.italian: "Beh, ero un po' preoccupato per il surriscaldamento della nave, ma per il resto funzionano bene."

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"Yes," he said, "the team sent me some videos of the battle. First-rate carnage. I was very pleased. Any weak spots you noticed?"|860|0
units.english: "Yes," he said, "the team sent me some videos of the battle. First-rate carnage. I was very pleased. Any weak spots you noticed?"
units.italian: "Sì," dice, "la squadra mi ha mandato qualche video della battaglia. Un massacro di prima qualità. Sono molto soddisfatto. Punti deboli che hai notato?"

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"Yes, it will require a lot of cooling," he says. "Any other weak spots?"|864|0
units.english: "Yes, it will require a lot of cooling," he says. "Any other weak spots?"
units.italian: "Sì, richiederà molto raffreddamento," dice. "Altri punti deboli?"

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"It seems like the only way to fit a gun this big into most ships is by leaving half the hardpoints empty. It's a bit impractical."|868|0
units.english: "It seems like the only way to fit a gun this big into most ships is by leaving half the hardpoints empty. It's a bit impractical."
units.italian: "Sembra che l'unico modo per montare un cannone così grande sulla maggior parte delle navi sia lasciare vuota metà dei punti di attacco. È un po' poco pratico."

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"It worked well against a large ship, but I wonder how well the turrets could track fighters."|869|0
units.english: "It worked well against a large ship, but I wonder how well the turrets could track fighters."
units.italian: "Ha funzionato bene contro una nave grande, ma mi chiedo quanto bene le torrette riescano a seguire i caccia."

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"It's true," he says, "most ships are designed expecting to be equipped with a larger number of smaller guns. But we think this might open up some interesting new directions in ship design.|873|0
units.english: "It's true," he says, "most ships are designed expecting to be equipped with a larger number of smaller guns. But we think this might open up some interesting new directions in ship design.
units.italian: "È vero," dice, "la maggior parte delle navi è progettata prevedendo un numero maggiore di cannoni più piccoli. Ma pensiamo che questo possa aprire qualche nuova direzione interessante nella progettazione delle navi.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"I guess we'll need to test it to find out," he says, "but our main goal was to have a weapon that could do serious damage to a Cruiser. Right now the Navy's heaviest ships have ours severely outgunned.|877|0
units.english: "I guess we'll need to test it to find out," he says, "but our main goal was to have a weapon that could do serious damage to a Cruiser. Right now the Navy's heaviest ships have ours severely outgunned.
units.italian: "Immagino che dovremo provarlo per scoprirlo," dice, "ma il nostro obiettivo principale era avere un'arma capace di fare danni seri a un incrociatore. Al momento le navi più pesanti della Marina hanno le nostre nettamente surclassate come armamento.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"This is to thank you for your help." Barmy hands you <payment>. "To help you pay for your first Plasma Turret once we've got them on the market," he says.|880|0
units.english: "This is to thank you for your help." Barmy hands you <payment>. "To help you pay for your first Plasma Turret once we've got them on the market," he says.
units.italian: "Questo è per ringraziarti del tuo aiuto." Barmy ti dà <payment>. "Per aiutarti a pagare la tua prima torretta al plasma, quando le avremo messe sul mercato," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"When do you think that will be?" you ask.|881|0
units.english: "When do you think that will be?" you ask.
units.italian: "Quando pensi che sarà?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Plasma Testing 1B|	"A month or two. I'll send you a message when they're available. Oh, and as for your next assignment, you're escorting a supply convoy to the front. You can meet up with them in the spaceport."|882|0
units.english: "A month or two. I'll send you a message when they're available. Oh, and as for your next assignment, you're escorting a supply convoy to the front. You can meet up with them in the spaceport."
