units.italian: "Un mese o due. Ti manderò un messaggio quando saranno disponibili. Oh, e quanto al tuo prossimo incarico, scorterai un convoglio di rifornimenti al fronte. Puoi incontrarli allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:plasma turret available|When you land, a message pops up on your communicator from Barmy Edward. A photograph is enclosed as well. The message reads:|894|0
units.english: When you land, a message pops up on your communicator from Barmy Edward. A photograph is enclosed as well. The message reads:
units.italian: Quando atterri, sul comunicatore ti compare un messaggio di Barmy Edward. C'è anche una fotografia allegata. Il messaggio dice:

units.id: mission:plasma turret available|	Rejoice, Captain! The next time you are on Rust, you will be able to purchase Plasma Turrets for your very own.|896|0
units.english: Rejoice, Captain! The next time you are on Rust, you will be able to purchase Plasma Turrets for your very own.
units.italian: Rallegrati, Capitano! La prossima volta che sarai su Rust potrai comprare le torrette al plasma tutte per te.

units.id: mission:plasma turret available|				Regards,|897|0
units.english: Regards,
units.italian: Cordiali saluti,

units.id: mission:plasma turret available|						B. Edward Tivrusky|898|0
units.english: B. Edward Tivrusky
units.italian: B. Edward Tivrusky

units.id: mission:plasma turret available|						Chief Offensive Engineer|899|0
units.english: Chief Offensive Engineer
units.italian: Capo ingegnere offensivo

units.id: mission:plasma turret available|						Kraz Cybernetics|900|0
units.english: Kraz Cybernetics
units.italian: Kraz Cybernetics

units.id: mission:FW Supply Convoy 1|name|907|0
units.english: Escort Supply Convoy
units.italian: Scorta rifornimenti

units.id: mission:FW Supply Convoy 1|description|908|0
units.english: Escort this convoy carrying equipment from Kraz Cybernetics to the militia base on <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta questo convoglio che trasporta equipaggiamento della Kraz Cybernetics alla base della milizia su <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Supply Convoy 1|In the spaceport, you meet up with a woman wearing a militia uniform and carrying a clipboard. "Are you Captain <last>?" she asks. You nod. "We have a large shipment of weapons and equipment that needs to go to the militia base on <planet>. Your job is to make sure none of these ships get... lost in transit." She points to a large landing pad where you count ten Star Barges lined up next to each other.|918|0
units.english: In the spaceport, you meet up with a woman wearing a militia uniform and carrying a clipboard. "Are you Captain <last>?" she asks. You nod. "We have a large shipment of weapons and equipment that needs to go to the militia base on <planet>. Your job is to make sure none of these ships get... lost in transit." She points to a large landing pad where you count ten Star Barges lined up next to each other.
units.italian: Nello spazioporto incontri una donna in uniforme della milizia con una cartellina in mano. "È lei il Capitano <last>?" chiede. Annuisci. "Abbiamo un grosso carico di armi ed equipaggiamento che deve andare alla base della milizia su <planet>. Il suo compito è assicurarsi che nessuna di queste navi si... perda per strada." Indica una grande piazzola di atterraggio dove conti dieci Star Barge allineate una accanto all'altra.

units.id: mission:FW Supply Convoy 1|	"Isn't it risky to transport valuable cargo in such flimsy and vulnerable ships?"|920|0
units.english: "Isn't it risky to transport valuable cargo in such flimsy and vulnerable ships?"
units.italian: "Non è rischioso trasportare un carico prezioso su navi così fragili e vulnerabili?"

units.id: mission:FW Supply Convoy 1|	"Hey, I'm a starship captain, not a cattle herder!"|921|0
units.english: "Hey, I'm a starship captain, not a cattle herder!"
units.italian: "Ehi, io sono un capitano di astronave, non un mandriano!"

units.id: mission:FW Supply Convoy 1|	"No problem. I'll see to it that they arrive safely."|923|0
units.english: "No problem. I'll see to it that they arrive safely."
units.italian: "Nessun problema. Farò in modo che arrivino sane e salve."

units.id: mission:FW Supply Convoy 1|	"It would be, except that our Free Worlds military presence has nearly, though not entirely, eliminated piracy in the Rim. So while we still need an escort, we're saving a lot of money on crew salaries by using ships that can be piloted by one person."|926|0
units.english: "It would be, except that our Free Worlds military presence has nearly, though not entirely, eliminated piracy in the Rim. So while we still need an escort, we're saving a lot of money on crew salaries by using ships that can be piloted by one person."
units.italian: "Lo sarebbe, se non fosse che la nostra presenza militare delle Free Worlds ha quasi, ma non del tutto, eliminato la pirateria nel Bordo. Quindi, anche se ci serve ancora una scorta, risparmiamo un sacco di soldi sugli stipendi degli equipaggi usando navi che si pilotano da sole una persona."

units.id: mission:FW Supply Convoy 1|	"Okay, I hope you're right!"|928|0
units.english: "Okay, I hope you're right!"
units.italian: "Va bene, spero che tu abbia ragione!"

units.id: mission:FW Supply Convoy 1|	She grins. "Yes, I know it's not terribly glamorous work, and keeping track of a big fleet of slow ships is a pain. But, Bulk Freighters are just too expensive to use on internal cargo convoys. Just make sure you do a headcount when you arrive in each system."|932|0
units.english: She grins. "Yes, I know it's not terribly glamorous work, and keeping track of a big fleet of slow ships is a pain. But, Bulk Freighters are just too expensive to use on internal cargo convoys. Just make sure you do a headcount when you arrive in each system."
units.italian: Sogghigna. "Sì, lo so che non è un lavoro molto glamour, e tenere d'occhio una grande flotta di navi lente è una seccatura. Ma i Bulk Freighter costano troppo per usarli nei convogli interni. Assicurati solo di fare il conto quando arrivi in ogni sistema."

units.id: mission:FW Supply Convoy 1|	"Okay, whatever it takes to further the cause of freedom, I'll do it."|934|0
units.english: "Okay, whatever it takes to further the cause of freedom, I'll do it."
units.italian: "Va bene, qualunque cosa serva a portare avanti la causa della libertà, la farò."

units.id: mission:FW Supply Convoy 1|dialog|952|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left part of your convoy behind! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro una parte del convoglio! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Supply Convoy 1|dialog|954|0
units.english: You make sure that all ten Star Barges have landed safely, then report to the quartermaster. He thanks you for your work, and mentions that Tomek has asked to see you in the spaceport bar.
units.italian: Ti assicuri che tutte e dieci le Star Barge siano atterrate sane e salve, poi riferisci al quartiermastro. Ti ringrazia per il lavoro e ti dice che Tomek ti ha chiesto al bar dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|name|959|0
units.english: Pirate Reconnaissance
units.italian: Ricognizione pirata

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|description|960|0
units.english: Scout out four pirate systems on the southern fringe of human space, then report back to Tomek on <planet>.
units.italian: Esplora quattro sistemi pirata ai margini meridionali dello spazio umano, poi riferisci a Tomek su <planet>.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|log|973|0
units.english: Tomek, from the Free Worlds Council, is trying to decide how to best deal with the threat of the pirates to the south of Free Worlds space.
units.italian: Tomek, del Consiglio delle Free Worlds, sta cercando di decidere come affrontare al meglio la minaccia dei pirati a sud dello spazio delle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|You find Tomek sitting at the spaceport bar with a galactic map. The map has notes written all over it, with lines marking the current Free Worlds and Republic territories. "Good to see you, <first>!" he says. "I pray whatever weapons Barmy Edward had you testing worked well. Most of his inventions are pure genius, but some are just bizarre and useless."|975|0
units.english: You find Tomek sitting at the spaceport bar with a galactic map. The map has notes written all over it, with lines marking the current Free Worlds and Republic territories. "Good to see you, <first>!" he says. "I pray whatever weapons Barmy Edward had you testing worked well. Most of his inventions are pure genius, but some are just bizarre and useless."
units.italian: Trovi Tomek seduto al bar dello spazioporto con una mappa galattica. La mappa è piena di annotazioni, con linee che segnano i territori attuali delle Free Worlds e della Repubblica. "Bello vederti, <first>!" dice. "Spero che le armi che Barmy Edward ti ha fatto provare abbiano funzionato bene. La maggior parte delle sue invenzioni è puro genio, ma alcune sono solo bizzarre e inutili."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|	You describe to him the impressive performance of the Plasma Turrets, and the challenge of finding a ship with enough size for them. "Excellent!" he says. "That opens up some interesting tactical possibilities. But now it's time to switch gears entirely."|976|0
units.english: You describe to him the impressive performance of the Plasma Turrets, and the challenge of finding a ship with enough size for them. "Excellent!" he says. "That opens up some interesting tactical possibilities. But now it's time to switch gears entirely."
units.italian: Gli descrivi le prestazioni impressionanti delle torrette al plasma e la difficoltà di trovare una nave abbastanza grande per montarle. "Eccellente!" dice. "Si aprono possibilità tattiche interessanti. Ma ora è tempo di cambiare completamente discorso."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|	He smooths out the map, sweeping a few stray peanuts and crumbs off it. Apparently he's been sitting here for quite a while. "Right now," he says, "the Navy is leaving us alone, and we have no good reason to attack them. So the Council has been turning its attention to other matters, namely the pirates. They're a big threat to our shipping, and every shipment lost to piracy is a dent in our war effort. Plus, if we could do something about them it would gain us a whole lot of support in the nearby Republic systems. If we can gain sympathy from Republic worlds, then we will lower the Republic's appetite for war."|977|0
units.english: He smooths out the map, sweeping a few stray peanuts and crumbs off it. Apparently he's been sitting here for quite a while. "Right now," he says, "the Navy is leaving us alone, and we have no good reason to attack them. So the Council has been turning its attention to other matters, namely the pirates. They're a big threat to our shipping, and every shipment lost to piracy is a dent in our war effort. Plus, if we could do something about them it would gain us a whole lot of support in the nearby Republic systems. If we can gain sympathy from Republic worlds, then we will lower the Republic's appetite for war."
units.italian: Stende bene la mappa, spazzandone via qualche arachide e briciola sparse. A quanto pare è seduto qui da parecchio. "Al momento," dice, "la Marina ci lascia in pace, e non abbiamo un buon motivo per attaccarla. Così il Consiglio ha cominciato a occuparsi di altre questioni, cioè dei pirati. Sono una grande minaccia per i nostri trasporti, e ogni carico perso per la pirateria è un colpo al nostro sforzo bellico. E poi, se riuscissimo a fare qualcosa per loro, guadagneremmo un bel po' di sostegno nei sistemi della Repubblica qui vicino. Se riusciamo a guadagnarci la simpatia dei mondi della Repubblica, ridurremo la voglia di guerra della Repubblica."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|	"Agreed."|979|0
units.english: "Agreed."
units.italian: "D'accordo."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|	"But isn't the Navy still the bigger threat?"|981|0
units.english: "But isn't the Navy still the bigger threat?"
units.italian: "Ma la Marina non resta comunque la minaccia più grande?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|	"They certainly are, but there's little we can do about them right now aside from prepare for their next move. We have absolutely no desire to take all of human space away from the Republic. All we want is the freedom to govern our own selves, here in our one corner of the galaxy. So attacking systems that the Republic holds right now would make absolutely no sense, and would likely only embolden the Republic, reinforcing their desire to see us conquered."|983|0
units.english: "They certainly are, but there's little we can do about them right now aside from prepare for their next move. We have absolutely no desire to take all of human space away from the Republic. All we want is the freedom to govern our own selves, here in our one corner of the galaxy. So attacking systems that the Republic holds right now would make absolutely no sense, and would likely only embolden the Republic, reinforcing their desire to see us conquered."
units.italian: "Certo che sì, ma al momento possiamo fare poco contro di loro, a parte prepararci alla loro prossima mossa. Non abbiamo alcun desiderio di togliere alla Repubblica tutto lo spazio umano. Vogliamo solo la libertà di governare noi stessi, qui nel nostro angolo di galassia. Quindi attaccare sistemi che la Repubblica controlla ora non avrebbe assolutamente senso, e probabilmente non farebbe che incoraggiare la Repubblica, rafforzando la sua voglia di vederci conquistati."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|	"I suppose you're right," you say.|984|0
units.english: "I suppose you're right," you say.
units.italian: "Suppongo che tu abbia ragione," dici.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|	"So, here's the plan," he says. "These four systems belong to the pirates." He points to them on the map. "We want you to scout out all four systems. Just a quick fly-through, no need to land on their planets. Then report back to us, and we'll decide what our next step will be."|987|0
units.english: "So, here's the plan," he says. "These four systems belong to the pirates." He points to them on the map. "We want you to scout out all four systems. Just a quick fly-through, no need to land on their planets. Then report back to us, and we'll decide what our next step will be."
units.italian: "Allora, il piano è questo," dice. "Questi quattro sistemi appartengono ai pirati." Li indica sulla mappa. "Vogliamo che tu esplori tutti e quattro i sistemi. Solo un rapido sorvolo, non serve atterrare sui loro pianeti. Poi riferisci a noi, e decideremo quale sarà il nostro prossimo passo."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|	"Sounds good."|989|0
units.english: "Sounds good."
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|	"What about the pirate systems to the north of Men?"|991|0
units.english: "What about the pirate systems to the north of Men?"
units.italian: "E i sistemi pirata che stanno a nord di Men?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|	Tomek shrugs. "Simply put, those worlds aren't a threat to us right now. From what we can gather, most of the factions there are focused on internal power struggles at the moment rather than piracy in the Rim. Those CCOR guerrillas are more than enough to keep any pirate warlords there busy for the immediate future."|992|0
units.english: Tomek shrugs. "Simply put, those worlds aren't a threat to us right now. From what we can gather, most of the factions there are focused on internal power struggles at the moment rather than piracy in the Rim. Those CCOR guerrillas are more than enough to keep any pirate warlords there busy for the immediate future."
units.italian: Tomek alza le spalle. "Detto semplicemente, quei mondi non sono una minaccia per noi al momento. Da quanto riusciamo a capire, la maggior parte delle fazioni là è concentrata su lotte interne per il potere, più che sulla pirateria nel Bordo. Quei guerriglieri della CCOR bastano e avanzano per tenere occupato qualsiasi signore della guerra pirata, per il futuro immediato."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|	"CCOR?"|994|0
units.english: "CCOR?"
units.italian: "CCOR?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|	"Understood."|996|0
units.english: "Understood."
units.italian: "Capito."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|	Tomek looks surprised. "I assumed you knew. The Confederated Councils of the Outer Rim was a government that tried to practice its own particular flavor of communism outside of the Republic's influence. They fell around 50 years ago, and their former planets are now under the control of either pirate gangs or guerrilla groups trying to restore the CCOR. I wouldn't worry about the guerrillas too much - at this point, they're little more than a pirate gang themselves."|999|0
units.english: Tomek looks surprised. "I assumed you knew. The Confederated Councils of the Outer Rim was a government that tried to practice its own particular flavor of communism outside of the Republic's influence. They fell around 50 years ago, and their former planets are now under the control of either pirate gangs or guerrilla groups trying to restore the CCOR. I wouldn't worry about the guerrillas too much - at this point, they're little more than a pirate gang themselves."
units.italian: Tomek sembra sorpreso. "Pensavo che lo sapessi. I Consigli Confederati del Bordo Esterno (CCOR) erano un governo che cercava di praticare la propria personale variante di comunismo fuori dall'influenza della Repubblica. Sono caduti circa 50 anni fa, e i loro vecchi pianeti sono ora sotto il controllo di bande pirata o di gruppi di guerriglia che cercano di restaurare la CCOR. Non mi preoccuperei troppo dei guerriglieri: a questo punto non sono molto più di una banda pirata loro stessi."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|	As you are about to leave, he says, "Oh, one other thing: you've been approved for a salary raise to 2,100 credits. We figure that helping you maintain a slightly larger ship is a worthwhile investment. Congratulations, Captain."|1001|0
units.english: As you are about to leave, he says, "Oh, one other thing: you've been approved for a salary raise to 2,100 credits. We figure that helping you maintain a slightly larger ship is a worthwhile investment. Congratulations, Captain."
units.italian: Mentre stai per andartene, dice: "Oh, un'altra cosa: ti è stato approvato un aumento di stipendio a 2.100 crediti. Pensiamo che aiutarti a mantenere una nave un po' più grande sia un investimento che vale la pena. Congratulazioni, Capitano."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 1|dialog|1007|0
units.english: You have scouted out all four pirate systems that Tomek asked you to visit. Time to head back to the spaceport bar and see if he is waiting for you.
units.italian: Hai esplorato tutti e quattro i sistemi pirata che Tomek ti ha chiesto di visitare. È tempo di tornare al bar dello spazioporto e vedere se ti sta aspettando.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1|name|1013|0
units.english: Senator Huygens
units.italian: La senatrice Huygens

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1|description|1014|0
units.english: Meet Senator Arianna Huygens on <planet>, and transport her to the new Free Worlds Senate building on Bourne.
units.italian: Incontra la senatrice Arianna Huygens su <planet> e trasportala al nuovo palazzo del Senato delle Free Worlds su Bourne.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1|log|1023|0
units.english: The Free Worlds have finally elected a Senate, which will be convening for the first time soon on Bourne.
units.italian: Le Free Worlds hanno finalmente eletto un Senato, che si riunirà per la prima volta a breve su Bourne.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1|Surprisingly, when you get back to <origin> you find that Tomek is no longer there. A courier hands you a short note: "Captain <last>: because the decision of how to deal with the pirates is of interest to all the Free Worlds, the Council has decided to convene the first session of the Free Worlds Senate ahead of schedule. I have already left for Bourne. You have been assigned to transport Senator Arianna Huygens of <planet>; please pick her up as soon as possible and bring her with you."|1025|0
units.english: Surprisingly, when you get back to <origin> you find that Tomek is no longer there. A courier hands you a short note: "Captain <last>: because the decision of how to deal with the pirates is of interest to all the Free Worlds, the Council has decided to convene the first session of the Free Worlds Senate ahead of schedule. I have already left for Bourne. You have been assigned to transport Senator Arianna Huygens of <planet>; please pick her up as soon as possible and bring her with you."
units.italian: Sorprendentemente, quando torni su <origin> scopri che Tomek non è più lì. Un corriere ti consegna un breve biglietto: "Capitano <last>: poiché la decisione su come affrontare i pirati interessa tutte le Free Worlds, il Consiglio ha deciso di convocare la prima sessione del Senato delle Free Worlds in anticipo sui tempi. Sono già partito per Bourne. Le è stato assegnato il trasporto della senatrice Arianna Huygens di <planet>; la prega di andare a prenderla il prima possibile e di portarla con sé."

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|name|1032|0
units.english: Senator Huygens
units.italian: La senatrice Huygens

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|description|1033|0
units.english: Transport Senator Arianna Huygens to <destination>.
units.italian: Trasporta la senatrice Arianna Huygens su <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|blocked|1037|0
units.english: You have reached <origin>, but you do not have a bunk free for Senator Huygens. You should return here after freeing up a bunk.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <origin>, ma non hai una cuccetta libera per la senatrice Huygens. Dovresti tornare qui dopo aver liberato una cuccetta.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|Senator Huygens turns out to be an attractive woman in her mid-fifties, with a dour expression on her face. "About time you showed up," is all she says when you introduce yourself.|1046|0
units.english: Senator Huygens turns out to be an attractive woman in her mid-fifties, with a dour expression on her face. "About time you showed up," is all she says when you introduce yourself.
units.italian: La senatrice Huygens si rivela una donna attraente sulla metà dei cinquant'anni, con un'espressione burbera. "Era ora che ti facessi vedere," è tutto quello che dice quando ti presenti.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	You take one of her suitcases and lead her into your ship to her room. Once you get there, she says, "I'm glad the Council relented and agreed to convene the Senate. I had begun to worry that the democracy we signed up for had become an oligarchy instead."|1047|0
units.english: You take one of her suitcases and lead her into your ship to her room. Once you get there, she says, "I'm glad the Council relented and agreed to convene the Senate. I had begun to worry that the democracy we signed up for had become an oligarchy instead."
units.italian: Le prendi una delle valigie e la guidi nella tua nave fino alla sua cabina. Quando arrivate, dice: "Sono contenta che il Consiglio abbia ceduto e abbia accettato di convocare il Senato. Avevo cominciato a temere che la democrazia che abbiamo sottoscritto fosse diventata un'oligarchia."

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"What do you mean?" you ask.|1048|0
units.english: "What do you mean?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che cosa vuoi dire?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"Don't play dumb. I mean the Council, deciding everything."|1049|0
units.english: "Don't play dumb. I mean the Council, deciding everything."
units.italian: "Non fare il finto tonto. Parlo del Consiglio, che decide tutto."

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"Don't worry, it was never their intention to hold on to power once each world had had sufficient time to elect their own representatives."|1051|0
units.english: "Don't worry, it was never their intention to hold on to power once each world had had sufficient time to elect their own representatives."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, non è mai stata loro intenzione tenersi il potere una volta che ogni mondo avesse avuto il tempo sufficiente per eleggere i propri rappresentanti."

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"Hey, the Council has provided great leadership at a time when no one else was ready to take charge. Give them some respect."|1052|0
units.english: "Hey, the Council has provided great leadership at a time when no one else was ready to take charge. Give them some respect."
units.italian: "Ehi, il Consiglio ha dato una grande guida in un momento in cui nessun altro era pronto a prendere il comando. Portagli un po' di rispetto."

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	She looks angry for a minute, then her expression softens. "Oh, pardon me," she says. "I was treating you like another scheming politician, but now I realize you're way too clueless for that. Tell me, Captain, do you know what makes politics similar to piloting a ship?"|1053|0
units.english: She looks angry for a minute, then her expression softens. "Oh, pardon me," she says. "I was treating you like another scheming politician, but now I realize you're way too clueless for that. Tell me, Captain, do you know what makes politics similar to piloting a ship?"
units.italian: Sembra arrabbiata per un minuto, poi la sua espressione si addolcisce. "Oh, mi scusi," dice. "La stavo trattando come l'ennesimo politico intrigante, ma ora mi rendo conto che è troppo sprovveduto per esserlo. Mi dica, Capitano, sa che cosa rende la politica simile al pilotare una nave?"

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"I have no idea."|1055|0
units.english: "I have no idea."
units.italian: "Non ne ho idea."

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"Ummm... they both involve momentous decisions that have serious consequences?"|1056|0
units.english: "Ummm... they both involve momentous decisions that have serious consequences?"
units.italian: "Ehm... entrambe comportano decisioni epocali con conseguenze serie?"

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"They both require someone skilled and decisive to be in command?"|1057|0
units.english: "They both require someone skilled and decisive to be in command?"
units.italian: "Entrambe richiedono che al comando ci sia qualcuno abile e deciso?"

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"The correct answer," she says, "was, 'nothing whatsoever; they are entirely different disciplines.' Now, hurry up, I hope to be on Bourne a week from now." You consider explaining to her that it's impossible to get there that fast, but decide against it.|1060|0
units.english: "The correct answer," she says, "was, 'nothing whatsoever; they are entirely different disciplines.' Now, hurry up, I hope to be on Bourne a week from now." You consider explaining to her that it's impossible to get there that fast, but decide against it.
units.italian: "La risposta corretta," dice, "era: 'assolutamente niente; sono discipline del tutto diverse'. Ora sbrigati, spero di essere su Bourne fra una settimana." Valuti se spiegarle che è impossibile arrivarci così in fretta, ma decidi di no.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"The correct answer," she says, "was, 'nothing whatsoever; they are entirely different disciplines.' Now, hurry up, I hope to be on Bourne a week from now." You consider explaining to her that it's impossible to get there that fast using a hyperdrive, but decide against it.|1063|0
units.english: "The correct answer," she says, "was, 'nothing whatsoever; they are entirely different disciplines.' Now, hurry up, I hope to be on Bourne a week from now." You consider explaining to her that it's impossible to get there that fast using a hyperdrive, but decide against it.
units.italian: "La risposta corretta," dice, "era: 'assolutamente niente; sono discipline del tutto diverse'. Ora sbrigati, spero di essere su Bourne fra una settimana." Valuti se spiegarle che è impossibile arrivarci così in fretta con un iperpropulsore, ma decidi di no.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	It's a good thing you have a jump drive.|1064|0
units.english: It's a good thing you have a jump drive.
units.italian: Meno male che hai un motore di salto.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|dialog|1068|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Senator Huygens hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta la senatrice Huygens non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|log|1070|0
units.english: Ijs is now working to found the Conservatory, a publicly funded Free Worlds university that will have a particular focus on terraforming technology. Their goal is to make terraforming methods efficient enough that even Dirt Belt worlds will be able to afford them.
units.italian: Ijs ora sta lavorando per fondare il Conservatorio, un'università delle Free Worlds finanziata con fondi pubblici che avrà un'attenzione particolare per la tecnologia del terraformaggio. Il loro obiettivo è rendere i metodi di terraformaggio abbastanza efficienti che persino i mondi della Fascia di Terra possano permetterseli.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|You drop off Senator Huygens, who appears uncharacteristically pleased. "Good work Captain <last>, I see we made good time. It seems you're far more reliable than most captains I work with," she says before walking off.|1074|0
units.english: You drop off Senator Huygens, who appears uncharacteristically pleased. "Good work Captain <last>, I see we made good time. It seems you're far more reliable than most captains I work with," she says before walking off.
units.italian: Fai scendere la senatrice Huygens, che sembra insolitamente soddisfatta. "Bel lavoro, Capitano <last>, vedo che abbiamo fatto buon tempo. Sembra che lei sia molto più affidabile della maggior parte dei capitani con cui lavoro," dice prima di allontanarsi.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|You drop off Senator Huygens, who says nothing by way of acknowledging your help except, "It's about time we got here." She hurries off.|1077|0
units.english: You drop off Senator Huygens, who says nothing by way of acknowledging your help except, "It's about time we got here." She hurries off.
units.italian: Fai scendere la senatrice Huygens, che non dice nulla per riconoscere il tuo aiuto se non: "Era ora di arrivare." Si allontana in fretta.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	A few minutes later, someone shouts, "Hello there, Captain <last>!" It's Ijs Springborn. "I'm glad to see you again," he says.|1079|0
units.english: A few minutes later, someone shouts, "Hello there, Captain <last>!" It's Ijs Springborn. "I'm glad to see you again," he says.
units.italian: Pochi minuti dopo, qualcuno grida: "Salve, Capitano <last>!" È Ijs Springborn. "Sono contento di rivederti," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"You too. What brings you to Bourne?"|1081|0
units.english: "You too. What brings you to Bourne?"
units.italian: "Anche io. Che cosa ti porta a Bourne?"

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"You too. Did you hear what happened to Katya?"|1082|0
units.english: "You too. Did you hear what happened to Katya?"
units.italian: "Anche io. Hai sentito che cosa è successo a Katya?"

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"I guess I'm sort of a lobbyist," he says, "here to make Katya's dream a reality."|1084|0
units.english: "I guess I'm sort of a lobbyist," he says, "here to make Katya's dream a reality."
units.italian: "Immagino di essere una specie di lobbista," dice, "qui per trasformare in realtà il sogno di Katya."

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"Yes, that's why I'm here," he says, "to make sure her dream becomes a reality."|1087|0
units.english: "Yes, that's why I'm here," he says, "to make sure her dream becomes a reality."
units.italian: "Sì, ecco perché sono qui," dice, "per assicurarmi che il suo sogno diventi realtà."

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"Which dream?" you ask.|1089|0
units.english: "Which dream?" you ask.
units.italian: "Quale sogno?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"Terraforming for the masses. A publicly funded university and research center. Are you familiar with the Free Worlds taxation model?"|1090|0
units.english: "Terraforming for the masses. A publicly funded university and research center. Are you familiar with the Free Worlds taxation model?"
units.italian: "Il terraformaggio per tutti. Un'università e un centro di ricerca finanziati pubblicamente. Conosci il modello fiscale delle Free Worlds?"

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"Not really," you say.|1091|0
units.english: "Not really," you say.
units.italian: "Non proprio," dici.

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"It's brilliant. And probably totally unsustainable. Each world that joins us negotiates a certain yearly tax amount based on their population and resources. In return they gain access to our defense fleet and other shared resources. Twenty percent of each planet's tax payments are 'unrestricted,' money the Free Worlds can use for whatever we think is most important. But the rest of the taxes can be earmarked for whatever projects that world thinks are most important. Those taxes can also be in the form of a donation, such as supplying ships or crews for the common militia..."|1092|0
units.english: "It's brilliant. And probably totally unsustainable. Each world that joins us negotiates a certain yearly tax amount based on their population and resources. In return they gain access to our defense fleet and other shared resources. Twenty percent of each planet's tax payments are 'unrestricted,' money the Free Worlds can use for whatever we think is most important. But the rest of the taxes can be earmarked for whatever projects that world thinks are most important. Those taxes can also be in the form of a donation, such as supplying ships or crews for the common militia..."
units.italian: "È geniale. E probabilmente del tutto insostenibile. Ogni mondo che si unisce a noi negozia un certo importo fiscale annuo in base alla popolazione e alle risorse. In cambio ottiene l'accesso alla nostra flotta di difesa e ad altre risorse condivise. Il venti per cento delle imposte di ogni pianeta è 'senza vincoli', denaro che le Free Worlds possono usare per quello che ritengono più importante. Ma il resto delle imposte può essere destinato ai progetti che quel mondo ritiene più importanti. Quelle imposte possono anche assumere la forma di una donazione, per esempio fornire navi o equipaggi per la milizia comune..."

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	He continues talking for quite some time. You stop even trying to follow what he is saying. Finally he sees the blank expression on your face and stops babbling. "The point is," he says, "if we can convince enough worlds to pool their money, the Conservatory will become a reality. Our own public university."|1093|0
units.english: He continues talking for quite some time. You stop even trying to follow what he is saying. Finally he sees the blank expression on your face and stops babbling. "The point is," he says, "if we can convince enough worlds to pool their money, the Conservatory will become a reality. Our own public university."
units.italian: Continua a parlare per parecchio. Smetti persino di provare a seguirlo. Alla fine vede l'espressione vuota sul tuo viso e smette di cianciare. "Il punto è," dice, "che se riusciamo a convincere abbastanza mondi a mettere insieme i loro soldi, il Conservatorio diventerà realtà. Una nostra università pubblica."

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"So you're here to talk to the senators?"|1095|0
units.english: "So you're here to talk to the senators?"
units.italian: "Quindi sei qui per parlare ai senatori?"

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"Sounds like that could be a great public relations move for convincing more worlds to join us."|1096|0
units.english: "Sounds like that could be a great public relations move for convincing more worlds to join us."
units.italian: "Sembra che potrebbe essere una grande mossa di pubbliche relazioni per convincere altri mondi a unirsi a noi."

units.id: mission:FW Senate 1B|	"Indeed," he says. "Anyway, I'm off to a meeting, but meet me later in the spaceport if you've got room for some passengers."|1097|0
units.english: "Indeed," he says. "Anyway, I'm off to a meeting, but meet me later in the spaceport if you've got room for some passengers."
units.italian: "Esatto," dice. "Comunque, io vado a una riunione, ma raggiungimi più tardi allo spazioporto se hai spazio per qualche passeggero."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|name|1106|0
units.english: Southern Patrol
units.italian: Pattuglia nel Sud

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|description|1107|0
units.english: Lead a patrol through the Free Worlds systems on the Southern Rim, driving off any pirates you encounter, then meet up with Tomek on <destination>.
units.italian: Guida una pattuglia attraverso i sistemi delle Free Worlds sul Bordo meridionale, respingendo i pirati che incontri, poi incontra Tomek su <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|A few minutes later, Tomek shows up at your ship. "Glad you made it," he says. "Sorry to disappear on you earlier."|1125|0
units.english: A few minutes later, Tomek shows up at your ship. "Glad you made it," he says. "Sorry to disappear on you earlier."
units.italian: Pochi minuti dopo, Tomek si presenta alla tua nave. "Sono contento che sia andata," dice. "Scusa se sono sparito prima."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	"Has the Senate decided anything about the pirates yet?"|1127|0
units.english: "Has the Senate decided anything about the pirates yet?"
units.italian: "Il Senato ha deciso qualcosa sui pirati?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	"It seems like some people are a little bit hostile toward the Council."|1128|0
units.english: "It seems like some people are a little bit hostile toward the Council."
units.italian: "Sembra che alcune persone siano un po' ostili verso il Consiglio."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	"Not yet. This is why I wanted to get as much done as possible while we were still under a relatively agile leadership structure. Getting two dozen politicians to agree on any course of action is... difficult. What did your reconnaissance turn up?"|1130|0
units.english: "Not yet. This is why I wanted to get as much done as possible while we were still under a relatively agile leadership structure. Getting two dozen politicians to agree on any course of action is... difficult. What did your reconnaissance turn up?"
units.italian: "Non ancora. È per questo che volevo fare il più possibile mentre eravamo ancora sotto una struttura di comando relativamente snella. Mettere d'accordo due dozzine di politici su una linea d'azione è... difficile. Che cosa ha rivelato la tua ricognizione?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	"You mean Arianna? Don't worry, she's one of those people who by reflex opposes any idea that comes from someone other than her. Most people appreciate what the Council has done, and in fact before you even arrived the Senate voted to give us a continued advisory role, under the Senate's supervision."|1133|0
units.english: "You mean Arianna? Don't worry, she's one of those people who by reflex opposes any idea that comes from someone other than her. Most people appreciate what the Council has done, and in fact before you even arrived the Senate voted to give us a continued advisory role, under the Senate's supervision."
units.italian: "Vuoi dire Arianna? Non preoccuparti, è una di quelle persone che per riflesso si oppongono a qualsiasi idea venga da qualcuno che non siano loro. Ai più piace quello che il Consiglio ha fatto, e anzi, prima ancora che tu arrivassi, il Senato ha votato per darci un ruolo consultivo permanente, sotto la supervisione del Senato."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	"They had that vote before she arrived?"|1134|0
units.english: "They had that vote before she arrived?"
units.italian: "Hanno votato prima che lei arrivasse?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	"Yes, we already had a quorum. She was the last to get here, because of her transportation troubles. Sorry to give you a menial job like that, by the way. Now, what can you tell me about the pirates?"|1135|0
units.english: "Yes, we already had a quorum. She was the last to get here, because of her transportation troubles. Sorry to give you a menial job like that, by the way. Now, what can you tell me about the pirates?"
units.italian: "Sì, avevamo già il numero legale. Lei è stata l'ultima ad arrivare, per i suoi problemi di trasporto. Scusa se ti ho dato un incarico così meschino, comunque. Ora, che cosa mi puoi dire dei pirati?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	You show him your sensor logs. "I've been trying to decide what advice we should give the Senate," he says. "A shock and awe assault on Greenrock might bring all the pirate systems in this sector under our control overnight. But we might have fewer losses if we attack the smaller worlds first, then demand that Greenrock surrender. In any case, something must be done. Even though our biggest concern is the Republic, much of the animus toward them is as a result of their failure to get piracy in this region under control. We must succeed where they have failed, otherwise we'll be no better than they were. If confidence in this project falters, the Free Worlds will collapse, and we'll be back to square one, except with all our leadership, all those who got us this far, in prison."|1137|0
units.english: You show him your sensor logs. "I've been trying to decide what advice we should give the Senate," he says. "A shock and awe assault on Greenrock might bring all the pirate systems in this sector under our control overnight. But we might have fewer losses if we attack the smaller worlds first, then demand that Greenrock surrender. In any case, something must be done. Even though our biggest concern is the Republic, much of the animus toward them is as a result of their failure to get piracy in this region under control. We must succeed where they have failed, otherwise we'll be no better than they were. If confidence in this project falters, the Free Worlds will collapse, and we'll be back to square one, except with all our leadership, all those who got us this far, in prison."
units.italian: Gli mostri i registri dei sensori. "Sto cercando di decidere quale consiglio dare al Senato," dice. "Un assalto di shock e terrore su Greenrock potrebbe mettere sotto il nostro controllo dall'oggi al domani tutti i sistemi pirata di questo settore. Ma avremmo forse meno perdite attaccando prima i mondi più piccoli e poi chiedendo a Greenrock di arrendersi. In ogni caso, qualcosa va fatto. Anche se la nostra preoccupazione più grande è la Repubblica, buona parte dell'ostilità verso di loro nasce dal loro fallimento nel tenere a freno la pirateria in questa regione. Dobbiamo riuscire dove hanno fallito, altrimenti non saremo migliori di loro. Se la fiducia in questo progetto vacilla, le Free Worlds crolleranno e torneremo al punto di partenza, con la differenza che tutta la nostra dirigenza, tutti quelli che ci hanno portato fin qui, sarà in prigione."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	"I say we strike right at their heart, and launch a massive assault on Greenrock."|1139|0
units.english: "I say we strike right at their heart, and launch a massive assault on Greenrock."
units.italian: "Io dico di colpire il loro cuore e lanciare un assalto massiccio su Greenrock."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	"Why not start by clearing out the Antares system? It's not very well defended."|1140|0
units.english: "Why not start by clearing out the Antares system? It's not very well defended."
units.italian: "Perché non cominciare ripulendo il sistema Antares? Non è difeso molto bene."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	"Occupying four pirate systems in perpetuity would be a huge drain on our resources. Why not try to negotiate with them, say by offering those worlds freedom from our interference as long as they stop supporting pirate fleets?"|1142|0
units.english: "Occupying four pirate systems in perpetuity would be a huge drain on our resources. Why not try to negotiate with them, say by offering those worlds freedom from our interference as long as they stop supporting pirate fleets?"
units.italian: "Occupare quattro sistemi pirata in eterno sarebbe un enorme spreco delle nostre risorse. Perché non proviamo a negoziare, offrendo a quei mondi la libertà da ogni nostra interferenza finché smettono di sostenere le flotte pirata?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	"That's definitely the fastest solution," he says, "although it would also be a difficult one. Defending an assault from the Navy was one thing, but subjugating the seat of pirate power in the region is another. It would be a great show of strength, though, not only to the pirates, but also to the Republic."|1147|0
units.english: "That's definitely the fastest solution," he says, "although it would also be a difficult one. Defending an assault from the Navy was one thing, but subjugating the seat of pirate power in the region is another. It would be a great show of strength, though, not only to the pirates, but also to the Republic."
units.italian: "È decisamente la soluzione più rapida," dice, "anche se sarebbe anche difficile. Difendere un assalto della Marina era una cosa, ma soggiogare la sede del potere pirata della regione è un'altra. Sarebbe però una bella dimostrazione di forza, non solo per i pirati, ma anche per la Repubblica."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	"Sounds reasonable to me," he says. "We could probably do that with minimal loss of life. But the risk is that Greenrock would still refuse to surrender. Anyone could nip at the weakest member of the herd, but if we take down Greenrock first it would be a great show of strength, not only to the pirates, but also to the Republic."|1153|0
units.english: "Sounds reasonable to me," he says. "We could probably do that with minimal loss of life. But the risk is that Greenrock would still refuse to surrender. Anyone could nip at the weakest member of the herd, but if we take down Greenrock first it would be a great show of strength, not only to the pirates, but also to the Republic."
units.italian: "Mi sembra ragionevole," dice. "Probabilmente potremmo farlo con perdite minime. Ma il rischio è che Greenrock rifiuti comunque di arrendersi. Chiunque potrebbe mordere il membro più debole del branco, ma se abbattiamo prima Greenrock sarebbe una grande prova di forza, davanti ai pirati e anche alla Repubblica."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	He frowns. "Negotiate with criminals?"|1159|0
units.english: He frowns. "Negotiate with criminals?"
units.italian: Si acciglia. "Negoziare con dei criminali?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	"I'm told that only a small portion of the people on those worlds actually engage in piracy," you say, "and many of them are children pressed into service as crew members."|1160|0
units.english: "I'm told that only a small portion of the people on those worlds actually engage in piracy," you say, "and many of them are children pressed into service as crew members."
units.italian: "Mi dicono che solo una piccola parte della gente di quei mondi pratichi davvero la pirateria," dici, "e molti sono ragazzi arruolati a forza come membri dell'equipaggio."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	"That may be," he says, "but their leaders are dangerous criminals, perhaps even more dangerous than the Navy, because they have no honor or morality. Every anarchist world is also a possible haven for other lawless individuals, including any of the Alphas who are still in hiding, so I say we need to capture and control those worlds. The heart of piracy in this region is at Greenrock, and if we take down Greenrock first it would be a great show of strength, not only to the pirates, but also to the Republic."|1161|0
units.english: "That may be," he says, "but their leaders are dangerous criminals, perhaps even more dangerous than the Navy, because they have no honor or morality. Every anarchist world is also a possible haven for other lawless individuals, including any of the Alphas who are still in hiding, so I say we need to capture and control those worlds. The heart of piracy in this region is at Greenrock, and if we take down Greenrock first it would be a great show of strength, not only to the pirates, but also to the Republic."
units.italian: "Può essere," dice, "ma i loro capi sono criminali pericolosi, forse più pericolosi della Marina, perché non hanno né onore né moralità. Ogni mondo anarchico è anche un possibile rifugio per altri individui senza legge, compresi gli Alphas che si nascondono ancora, quindi dico che dobbiamo conquistare e controllare quei mondi. Il cuore della pirateria in questa regione è Greenrock, e se colpiamo Greenrock per primo mostreremmo i muscoli, ai pirati e alla Repubblica insieme."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	"But I suppose we need to wait for the Senate to decide?" you ask.|1164|0
units.english: "But I suppose we need to wait for the Senate to decide?" you ask.
units.italian: "Ma suppongo che dobbiamo aspettare la decisione del Senato?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|	"Perhaps," he says. "In the meantime, I've got a related mission for you. While the Senate is deliberating, I'd like you to lead a patrol through our systems in the Southern Rim, to keep up enough of a presence to keep the pirates at bay. Once you've finished patrolling, bring the fleet back to <planet>. By then I should be back there, and we'll discuss our next steps."|1165|0
units.english: "Perhaps," he says. "In the meantime, I've got a related mission for you. While the Senate is deliberating, I'd like you to lead a patrol through our systems in the Southern Rim, to keep up enough of a presence to keep the pirates at bay. Once you've finished patrolling, bring the fleet back to <planet>. By then I should be back there, and we'll discuss our next steps."
units.italian: "Forse," dice. "Nel frattempo ho una missione collegata per te. Mentre il Senato delibera, vorrei che guidassi una pattuglia attraverso i nostri sistemi nel Bordo meridionale, per mantenere una presenza sufficiente a tenere a bada i pirati. Quando hai finito di pattugliare, riporta la flotta su <planet>. A quel punto dovrei essere tornato anch'io, e parleremo dei prossimi passi."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates 2|dialog|1177|0
units.english: Your patrol fleet is still busy finding landing spots, but your work is done. Time to head to the spaceport bar and see if Tomek is there.
units.italian: La tua flotta di pattuglia è ancora impegnata a trovare posti dove atterrare, ma il tuo lavoro è finito. È tempo di andare al bar dello spazioporto e vedere se Tomek è lì.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates Patch|name|1184|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Pirates Patch|description|1185|0
units.english: Return to <destination> to continue your work with the Free Worlds.
units.italian: Torna su <destination> per continuare il tuo lavoro con le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates Patch|When you updated your game, you were in the middle of a story arc in the Free Worlds campaign that has since been changed. In order to continue, you should go to <destination>.|1205|0
units.english: When you updated your game, you were in the middle of a story arc in the Free Worlds campaign that has since been changed. In order to continue, you should go to <destination>.
units.italian: Quando hai aggiornato il gioco, eri nel mezzo di un arco narrativo della campagna delle Free Worlds che da allora è stato modificato. Per continuare, dovresti andare su <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|name|1211|0
units.english: Attack Greenrock
units.italian: Attacca Greenrock

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|description|1212|0
units.english: Disobeying the Senate's orders, head to <destination> and gather a Free Worlds fleet for an all-out attack on the pirate world of Greenrock.
units.italian: Disobbedendo agli ordini del Senato, vai su <destination> e raduna una flotta delle Free Worlds per un assalto in forze al mondo pirata di Greenrock.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|log|1224|0
units.english: Given orders by the Free Worlds Senate to escort a diplomatic mission to the anarchist planet Thule. Tomek is not happy about bargaining with the pirates instead of fighting them.
units.italian: Il Senato delle Free Worlds ti ha ordinato di scortare una missione diplomatica sul pianeta anarchico Thule. Tomek non è contento di trattare con i pirati invece di combatterli.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|Tomek meets you outside the spaceport bar and pulls you roughly aside into an alley. "Do you still think that an attack on the pirates is our best option?" he asks.|1228|0
units.english: Tomek meets you outside the spaceport bar and pulls you roughly aside into an alley. "Do you still think that an attack on the pirates is our best option?" he asks.
units.italian: Tomek ti incontra fuori dal bar dello spazioporto e ti tira bruscamente da parte in un vicolo. "Pensi ancora che un attacco ai pirati sia la nostra opzione migliore?" chiede.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"Yes, it's our best chance for eliminating the pirates."|1230|0
units.english: "Yes, it's our best chance for eliminating the pirates."
units.italian: "Sì, è la nostra migliore possibilità di eliminare i pirati."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"Only if the Senate agrees. This is a democratic government, after all."|1232|0
units.english: "Only if the Senate agrees. This is a democratic government, after all."
units.italian: "Solo se il Senato è d'accordo. Questo è un governo democratico, dopotutto."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"Why? What's going on?"|1233|0
units.english: "Why? What's going on?"
units.italian: "Perché? Che cosa succede?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"Those fools in the Senate want us to negotiate with the pirates," he says. "We need to save them from their own stupidity. I've rallied a battle fleet waiting for you on <planet>, brave captains who are willing to join an assault on Greenrock."|1234|0
units.english: "Those fools in the Senate want us to negotiate with the pirates," he says. "We need to save them from their own stupidity. I've rallied a battle fleet waiting for you on <planet>, brave captains who are willing to join an assault on Greenrock."
units.italian: "Quei folli del Senato vogliono che negoziamo con i pirati," dice. "Dobbiamo salvarli dalla loro stessa stupidità. Ho radunato una flotta da battaglia che ti aspetta su <planet>, capitani coraggiosi disposti a unirsi all'assalto a Greenrock."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"Then head to <planet> immediately. I've rallied some militia captains there who will join you in a battle fleet. Our target is Greenrock. It's now or never, before the Senate finishes their work of castrating our military."|1238|0
units.english: "Then head to <planet> immediately. I've rallied some militia captains there who will join you in a battle fleet. Our target is Greenrock. It's now or never, before the Senate finishes their work of castrating our military."
units.italian: "Allora vai subito su <planet>. Ho radunato là alcuni capitani della milizia che si uniranno a te in una flotta da battaglia. Il nostro obiettivo è Greenrock. È ora o mai più, prima che il Senato finisca il suo lavoro di evirazione del nostro esercito."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	Just then, JJ walks out of the bar and sees you talking with Tomek. "Tomek," he says, "what are you doing? Freya and I are waiting inside." He beckons you into the bar.|1241|0
units.english: Just then, JJ walks out of the bar and sees you talking with Tomek. "Tomek," he says, "what are you doing? Freya and I are waiting inside." He beckons you into the bar.
units.italian: Proprio allora JJ esce dal bar e ti vede parlare con Tomek. "Tomek," dice, "che cosa stai facendo? Freya e io ti aspettiamo dentro." Ti fa cenno di entrare nel bar.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	Inside, Freya and Alondo are sitting at a table looking at Tomek's battered galactic map. Tomek, JJ, and you sit down with them.|1242|0
units.english: Inside, Freya and Alondo are sitting at a table looking at Tomek's battered galactic map. Tomek, JJ, and you sit down with them.
units.italian: Dentro, Freya e Alondo sono seduti a un tavolo e guardano la mappa galattica malconcia di Tomek. Tomek, JJ e tu vi sedete con loro.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|You find Tomek in the spaceport bar, talking with Freya, JJ, and Alondo around Tomek's battered galactic map. "Well, Captain," says Tomek, "you're going to be happy to hear this. The Senate recommended the same approach you did: negotiating with the pirates." He seems very upset at this.|1246|0
units.english: You find Tomek in the spaceport bar, talking with Freya, JJ, and Alondo around Tomek's battered galactic map. "Well, Captain," says Tomek, "you're going to be happy to hear this. The Senate recommended the same approach you did: negotiating with the pirates." He seems very upset at this.
units.italian: Trovi Tomek nel bar dello spazioporto, che parla con Freya, JJ e Alondo intorno alla sua mappa galattica malconcia. "Beh, Capitano," dice Tomek, "sarai contento di sentirlo. Il Senato ha raccomandato lo stesso approccio che hai proposto tu: negoziare con i pirati." Sembra molto contrariato.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	JJ explains, "We've been asked to deliver an ultimatum to each pirate world: the Free Worlds maintains the right to attack any ships engaged in piracy. Any world that continues to support piracy, slavery, or illegal weapons manufacture will be a valid military target for us. But first, we are to offer each world the opportunity to become truly autonomous and free from outside intervention, if they will pledge to cease those activities."|1249|0
units.english: JJ explains, "We've been asked to deliver an ultimatum to each pirate world: the Free Worlds maintains the right to attack any ships engaged in piracy. Any world that continues to support piracy, slavery, or illegal weapons manufacture will be a valid military target for us. But first, we are to offer each world the opportunity to become truly autonomous and free from outside intervention, if they will pledge to cease those activities."
units.italian: JJ spiega: "Ci è stato chiesto di consegnare un ultimatum a ogni mondo pirata: le Free Worlds mantengono il diritto di attaccare qualsiasi nave impegnata nella pirateria. Ogni mondo che continuerà a sostenere la pirateria, la schiavitù o la fabbricazione illegale di armi sarà un obiettivo militare legittimo per noi. Ma prima dobbiamo offrire a ogni mondo la possibilità di diventare davvero autonomo e libero da interventi esterni, se si impegnerà a cessare quelle attività."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	Freya says, "The thing is, just like any other world, most people on the 'pirate' planets are just ordinary farmers, or factory workers, or whatever. The only difference is, they want no off-world government telling them how to live. So that's what we're going to offer them."|1250|0
units.english: Freya says, "The thing is, just like any other world, most people on the 'pirate' planets are just ordinary farmers, or factory workers, or whatever. The only difference is, they want no off-world government telling them how to live. So that's what we're going to offer them."
units.italian: Freya dice: "Il fatto è che, come in qualsiasi altro mondo, la maggior parte della gente sui pianeti 'pirata' è solo di contadini comuni, o operai, o roba del genere. L'unica differenza è che non vogliono un governo esterno che dica loro come vivere. Quindi è questo che offriremo."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"Our first mission will be to Thule in the Men system," Alondo says. "Although Thule is not the biggest hub of piracy in the region, it is the most populous with almost a billion people, a greater population than all the other pirate worlds in the region combined. We hope that by first coming to an agreement with the majority of the population of pirate worlds in the region, the rest will be easier to negotiate with. I will be leading the negotiations."|1251|0
units.english: "Our first mission will be to Thule in the Men system," Alondo says. "Although Thule is not the biggest hub of piracy in the region, it is the most populous with almost a billion people, a greater population than all the other pirate worlds in the region combined. We hope that by first coming to an agreement with the majority of the population of pirate worlds in the region, the rest will be easier to negotiate with. I will be leading the negotiations."
units.italian: "La nostra prima missione sarà su Thule, nel sistema Men," dice Alondo. "Anche se Thule non è il più grande centro di pirateria della regione, è il più popoloso con quasi un miliardo di persone, una popolazione maggiore di tutti gli altri mondi pirata della regione messi insieme. Speriamo che, raggiungendo prima un accordo con la maggioranza della popolazione dei mondi pirata della regione, sarà più facile negoziare con gli altri. Le trattative le guiderò io."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"That's good news! I think the Senate made the right choice."|1253|0
units.english: "That's good news! I think the Senate made the right choice."
units.italian: "È una buona notizia! Penso che il Senato abbia fatto la scelta giusta."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"How do you negotiate with a billion anarchists? Sounds like that will take forever."|1254|0
units.english: "How do you negotiate with a billion anarchists? Sounds like that will take forever."
units.italian: "Come si negozia con un miliardo di anarchici? Sembra che ci vorrà un'eternità."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"That doesn't make any sense. If we leave those pirate worlds alone, they'll stab us in the back some time in the future."|1256|0
units.english: "That doesn't make any sense. If we leave those pirate worlds alone, they'll stab us in the back some time in the future."
units.italian: "Non ha alcun senso. Se lasciamo in pace quei mondi pirata, ci pugnaleranno alle spalle prima o poi."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"Well, I think the Senate has water flowing through their veins instead of blood," says Tomek, "and I think asking anarchists to make a binding diplomatic contract is an exercise in futility. We should speak with them in the only language they'll understand: violence."|1259|0
units.english: "Well, I think the Senate has water flowing through their veins instead of blood," says Tomek, "and I think asking anarchists to make a binding diplomatic contract is an exercise in futility. We should speak with them in the only language they'll understand: violence."
units.italian: "Beh, penso che il Senato abbia acqua nelle vene invece del sangue," dice Tomek, "e penso che chiedere agli anarchici un contratto diplomatico vincolante sia un esercizio di futilità. Dovremmo parlare con loro nell'unico linguaggio che capiscono: la violenza."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"Good question," Tomek remarks mockingly. "It's almost like this will be an exercise in futility. We should speak with them in the only language they'll understand: violence."|1263|0
units.english: "Good question," Tomek remarks mockingly. "It's almost like this will be an exercise in futility. We should speak with them in the only language they'll understand: violence."
units.italian: "Bella domanda," commenta Tomek con sarcasmo. "È quasi come se questo fosse un esercizio di futilità. Dovremmo parlare con loro nell'unico linguaggio che capiscono: la violenza."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"Absolutely," says Tomek. "The Senate doesn't know what's best for them. Perhaps we should save them from their own stupidity and make sure the right thing gets done. A world of anarchists will never come to a binding agreement. We should speak with them in the only language they'll understand: violence."|1267|0
units.english: "Absolutely," says Tomek. "The Senate doesn't know what's best for them. Perhaps we should save them from their own stupidity and make sure the right thing gets done. A world of anarchists will never come to a binding agreement. We should speak with them in the only language they'll understand: violence."
units.italian: "Assolutamente," dice Tomek. "Il Senato non sa che cosa sia meglio per loro. Forse dovremmo salvarli dalla loro stessa stupidità e assicurarci che si faccia la cosa giusta. Un mondo di anarchici non arriverà mai a un accordo vincolante. Dovremmo parlare con loro nell'unico linguaggio che capiscono: la violenza."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"Tomek," says Freya, "this is a democracy. We follow the Senate's orders."|1270|0
units.english: "Tomek," says Freya, "this is a democracy. We follow the Senate's orders."
units.italian: "Tomek," dice Freya, "questa è una democrazia. Seguiamo gli ordini del Senato."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"And what if those orders are wrong?" Tomek shouts, drawing attention from some patrons of the bar. "When has diplomacy ever worked with pirates? Did diplomacy work for the Republic in the 2800s when they sought to eliminate slave trades across the galaxy? Has diplomacy worked during the years of neglect that the Navy has shown us with the constant raids that the South has experienced? No, it didn't! It was the force of the Republic Navy that nearly eliminated the slave trade! It was the force of OUR militia which finally put an end to the constant raids against our people!"|1271|0
units.english: "And what if those orders are wrong?" Tomek shouts, drawing attention from some patrons of the bar. "When has diplomacy ever worked with pirates? Did diplomacy work for the Republic in the 2800s when they sought to eliminate slave trades across the galaxy? Has diplomacy worked during the years of neglect that the Navy has shown us with the constant raids that the South has experienced? No, it didn't! It was the force of the Republic Navy that nearly eliminated the slave trade! It was the force of OUR militia which finally put an end to the constant raids against our people!"
units.italian: "E se quegli ordini fossero sbagliati?" urla Tomek, attirando l'attenzione di alcuni avventori del bar. "Quando mai la diplomazia ha funzionato con i pirati? La diplomazia ha funzionato per la Repubblica negli anni 2800, quando cercava di eliminare la tratta degli schiavi in tutta la galassia? Ha funzionato la diplomazia durante gli anni di abbandono in cui la Marina ci ha lasciati soli con le incursioni continue che il Sud ha subito? No, non ha funzionato! È stata la forza della Marina della Repubblica a quasi eliminare la tratta degli schiavi! È stata la forza della NOSTRA milizia a porre finalmente fine alle incursioni continue contro la nostra gente!"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"Tomek, that's enough," Alondo says softly.|1272|0
units.english: "Tomek, that's enough," Alondo says softly.
units.italian: "Tomek, basta così," dice Alondo a voce bassa.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	JJ, ignoring Tomek's outbursts, says to you, "Captain <last>, the Senate wants you to travel to Thule and deliver their ultimatum. You will be given a single Falcon as an escort: not enough for a battle fleet, just enough to keep you safe. You are to avoid engaging any pirates you meet, if possible. Alondo will be aboard the Falcon and will negotiate with the locals once you arrive. Understood?"|1273|0
units.english: JJ, ignoring Tomek's outbursts, says to you, "Captain <last>, the Senate wants you to travel to Thule and deliver their ultimatum. You will be given a single Falcon as an escort: not enough for a battle fleet, just enough to keep you safe. You are to avoid engaging any pirates you meet, if possible. Alondo will be aboard the Falcon and will negotiate with the locals once you arrive. Understood?"
units.italian: JJ, ignorando le sfuriate di Tomek, ti dice: "Capitano <last>, il Senato vuole che tu vada su Thule e consegni il loro ultimatum. Ti sarà data una sola Falcon come scorta: non abbastanza per una flotta da battaglia, appena sufficiente a tenerti al sicuro. Devi evitare di ingaggiare i pirati che incontri, se possibile. Alondo sarà a bordo della Falcon e negozierà con la gente del posto quando arrivate. Chiaro?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"Understood."|1275|0
units.english: "Understood."
units.italian: "Chiaro."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"So, we're not going to attack the pirates?"|1277|0
units.english: "So, we're not going to attack the pirates?"
units.italian: "Quindi non attaccheremo i pirati?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	Tomek says, "No, we're just going to let them sit there waiting to stab us in the back at the first opportunity."|1278|0
units.english: Tomek says, "No, we're just going to let them sit there waiting to stab us in the back at the first opportunity."
units.italian: Tomek dice: "No, li lasceremo stare lì ad aspettare di pugnalarci alle spalle alla prima occasione."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	Tomek looks at you in disbelief. "So you're just going to agree with them? You're just going to let the pirates stab us in the back at the first opportunity?"|1282|0
units.english: Tomek looks at you in disbelief. "So you're just going to agree with them? You're just going to let the pirates stab us in the back at the first opportunity?"
units.italian: Tomek ti guarda incredulo. "Quindi dai ragione a loro? Lasci che i pirati ci pugnalino alle spalle alla prima occasione?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	JJ puts a hand on his shoulder and says, a little more firmly than Alondo did, "Calm down, Tomek. We're obeying the orders of the Senate. We have to honor the democratic process even when we don't like the decisions they make."|1285|0
units.english: JJ puts a hand on his shoulder and says, a little more firmly than Alondo did, "Calm down, Tomek. We're obeying the orders of the Senate. We have to honor the democratic process even when we don't like the decisions they make."
units.italian: JJ gli mette una mano sulla spalla e dice, con un tono un po' più fermo di quello di Alondo: "Calmati, Tomek. Stiamo obbedendo agli ordini del Senato. Dobbiamo onorare il processo democratico anche quando non ci piacciono le decisioni che prende."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"Oh, the Senate. Of course. The Senate this, the Senate that," Tomek says mockingly while throwing his head back. "The Senate is in no position to be commanding this war. They do not have the military experience of JJ or myself. Do you think the Republic Parliament is busying themselves voting on every little fleet movement, or do you think they've put this in the hands of the Navy and told them to win this war? I made my reasons clear to you all many times why I didn't want to convene the Senate, because they would only hinder and handicap us from winning this war, and that's exactly what they're already doing!"|1286|0
units.english: "Oh, the Senate. Of course. The Senate this, the Senate that," Tomek says mockingly while throwing his head back. "The Senate is in no position to be commanding this war. They do not have the military experience of JJ or myself. Do you think the Republic Parliament is busying themselves voting on every little fleet movement, or do you think they've put this in the hands of the Navy and told them to win this war? I made my reasons clear to you all many times why I didn't want to convene the Senate, because they would only hinder and handicap us from winning this war, and that's exactly what they're already doing!"
units.italian: "Oh, il Senato. Certo. Il Senato di qua, il Senato di là," dice Tomek con sarcasmo, buttando la testa all'indietro. "Il Senato non è in posizione per comandare questa guerra. Non ha l'esperienza militare di JJ o la mia. Pensi che il Parlamento della Repubblica si metta a votare su ogni piccolo movimento di flotta, o pensi che abbiano messo la cosa nelle mani della Marina dicendole di vincere questa guerra? Ti ho spiegato chiaramente molte volte perché non volevo convocare il Senato: perché non avrebbe fatto che ostacolarci e azzopparci, impedendoci di vincere questa guerra, ed è esattamente quello che sta già facendo!"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"Tomek! That's enough!" JJ yells, which seems to draw even more surprise and attention than when Tomek yelled. "The Council decided that the Senate would convene, and so it did. It is only by the grace of the Senate that the Council even still exists."|1287|0
units.english: "Tomek! That's enough!" JJ yells, which seems to draw even more surprise and attention than when Tomek yelled. "The Council decided that the Senate would convene, and so it did. It is only by the grace of the Senate that the Council even still exists."
units.italian: "Tomek! Basta così!" urla JJ, il che sembra attirare ancora più sorpresa e attenzione di quando ha urlato Tomek. "Il Consiglio ha deciso che il Senato si sarebbe riunito, e così è stato. È solo per grazia del Senato che il Consiglio esiste ancora."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"And it'll be by the grace of God that we don't all end up dead because of it," Tomek responds.|1288|0
units.english: "And it'll be by the grace of God that we don't all end up dead because of it," Tomek responds.
units.italian: "E sarà per grazia di Dio che non finiremo tutti morti per colpa sua," risponde Tomek.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	JJ turns to you and Alondo. "<first>. Alondo. I pray your mission to Thule is a success."|1289|0
units.english: JJ turns to you and Alondo. "<first>. Alondo. I pray your mission to Thule is a success."
units.italian: JJ si volta verso di te e Alondo. "<first>. Alondo. Prego che la vostra missione su Thule sia un successo."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"I'll introduce you to your escort," says Tomek, shaking off JJ's hand as he leads you out of the bar.|1290|0
units.english: "I'll introduce you to your escort," says Tomek, shaking off JJ's hand as he leads you out of the bar.
units.italian: "Ti presento la tua scorta," dice Tomek, liberandosi della mano di JJ mentre ti porta fuori dal bar.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	Once you are outside, he pulls you aside and says, "If at any point you are attacked by pirates along the way or change your mind, head to <planet>. I've rallied a battle fleet waiting there, brave captains who are willing to join in an assault on Greenrock. If you join them, they should have enough firepower to take the system."|1294|0
units.english: Once you are outside, he pulls you aside and says, "If at any point you are attacked by pirates along the way or change your mind, head to <planet>. I've rallied a battle fleet waiting there, brave captains who are willing to join in an assault on Greenrock. If you join them, they should have enough firepower to take the system."
units.italian: Una volta fuori, ti prende da parte e dice: "Se in qualsiasi momento vieni attaccato dai pirati lungo la strada o cambi idea, vai su <planet>. Ho radunato là una flotta da battaglia che aspetta: capitani coraggiosi disposti a unirsi all'assalto a Greenrock. Se ti unisci a loro, dovrebbero avere abbastanza potenza di fuoco per prendere il sistema."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"You're asking me to go against the Senate's decision?"|1296|0
units.english: "You're asking me to go against the Senate's decision?"
units.italian: "Mi stai chiedendo di andare contro la decisione del Senato?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"Understood."|1297|0
units.english: "Understood."
units.italian: "Capito."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	"Never mind," he says, "I guess you're as weak-willed as the rest of them." He walks back into the bar and leaves you alone.|1299|0
units.english: "Never mind," he says, "I guess you're as weak-willed as the rest of them." He walks back into the bar and leaves you alone.
units.italian: "Lascia perdere," dice, "immagino che tu sia debole di volontà come tutti gli altri." Torna nel bar e ti lascia solo.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 1|	Once you are outside, he pulls you aside and says, "Remember what we talked about, <first>." He walks back into the bar and leaves you alone.|1303|0
units.english: Once you are outside, he pulls you aside and says, "Remember what we talked about, <first>." He walks back into the bar and leaves you alone.
units.italian: Una volta fuori, ti prende da parte e dice: "Ricordati di quello di cui abbiamo parlato, <first>." Torna nel bar e ti lascia solo.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|name|1310|0
units.english: Attack Greenrock
units.italian: Attacca Greenrock

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|description|1311|0
units.english: Disobeying the Senate's orders, launch an all-out attack on the pirate world of <destination>, then land there.
units.italian: Disobbedendo agli ordini del Senato, lancia un attacco in forze al mondo pirata di <destination>, poi atterraci.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|When you land on <origin>, you find the fleet that Tomek mentioned: a few militia heavy and medium warships, a carrier, three squadrons of interceptors, and even four merchant ships of varying sizes. In total the fleet is nearly as large as one of the fleets that defended Sabik or Kornephoros, but as you survey the motley mix of grizzled militia veterans, young, naive interceptor pilots, and eager merchant captains, you can't help but wonder if a fleet of this size has a good chance against the strongest pirate world in Southern space.|1322|0
units.english: When you land on <origin>, you find the fleet that Tomek mentioned: a few militia heavy and medium warships, a carrier, three squadrons of interceptors, and even four merchant ships of varying sizes. In total the fleet is nearly as large as one of the fleets that defended Sabik or Kornephoros, but as you survey the motley mix of grizzled militia veterans, young, naive interceptor pilots, and eager merchant captains, you can't help but wonder if a fleet of this size has a good chance against the strongest pirate world in Southern space.
units.italian: Quando atterri su <origin>, trovi la flotta di cui Tomek parlava: qualche nave da guerra pesante e media della milizia, una porta-navi, tre squadroni di intercettori e persino quattro mercantili di dimensioni diverse. In totale la flotta è quasi grande quanto una di quelle che hanno difeso Sabik o Kornephoros, ma mentre passi in rassegna quel misto eterogeneo di veterani induriti della milizia, giovani piloti di intercettore ingenui e capitani mercantili pieni di entusiasmo, non puoi fare a meno di chiederti se una flotta di queste dimensioni abbia buone possibilità contro il più forte mondo pirata dello spazio del Sud.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|	The Navy failed to conquer Longjump. Why would a fleet of a similar size be capable of conquering Greenrock? Perhaps the Senate was right in suggesting a diplomatic solution. Or perhaps luck will be in your favor.|1323|0
units.english: The Navy failed to conquer Longjump. Why would a fleet of a similar size be capable of conquering Greenrock? Perhaps the Senate was right in suggesting a diplomatic solution. Or perhaps luck will be in your favor.
