units.italian: La Marina non è riuscita a conquistare Longjump. Perché mai una flotta di dimensioni simili dovrebbe riuscire a conquistare Greenrock? Forse il Senato aveva ragione a suggerire una soluzione diplomatica. O forse la fortuna sarà dalla tua parte.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|	(Go ahead and attack Greenrock, disobeying the Senate's orders regardless of the consequences.)|1325|0
units.english: (Go ahead and attack Greenrock, disobeying the Senate's orders regardless of the consequences.)
units.italian: (Procedi e attacca Greenrock, disobbedendo agli ordini del Senato quali che siano le conseguenze.)

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|	(Give up on Tomek's scheme and follow the Senate's orders to make a diplomatic visit to Thule.)|1326|0
units.english: (Give up on Tomek's scheme and follow the Senate's orders to make a diplomatic visit to Thule.)
units.italian: (Rinuncia al piano di Tomek e segui gli ordini del Senato di fare una visita diplomatica a Thule.)

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|	You speak with some of the captains of the invasion fleet. Apparently Tomek has been busy visiting spaceports and giving rousing speeches about ending piracy and slavery once and for all in the South, hence the fleet being so large despite being unsanctioned by the Senate. That also explains the inclusion of a few merchant captains in the fleet, likely local captains who overheard the speeches and aren't interested in joining the Free Worlds to fight against the Navy, but are more than happy to make life easier for their freighters if this succeeds.|1328|0
units.english: You speak with some of the captains of the invasion fleet. Apparently Tomek has been busy visiting spaceports and giving rousing speeches about ending piracy and slavery once and for all in the South, hence the fleet being so large despite being unsanctioned by the Senate. That also explains the inclusion of a few merchant captains in the fleet, likely local captains who overheard the speeches and aren't interested in joining the Free Worlds to fight against the Navy, but are more than happy to make life easier for their freighters if this succeeds.
units.italian: Parli con alcuni capitani della flotta d'invasione. A quanto pare Tomek è stato impegnato a girare per gli spazioporti tenendo discorsi infiammati sulla fine della pirateria e della schiavitù una volta per tutte nel Sud, ed è per questo che la flotta è così grande nonostante non sia autorizzata dal Senato. Questo spiega anche la presenza di qualche capitano mercantile: probabilmente capitani del posto che hanno sentito i discorsi e non hanno interesse a unirsi alle Free Worlds per combattere contro la Marina, ma sarebbero più che felici di rendere la vita più facile ai loro mercantili se la cosa riesce.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|	You plan to leave after nightfall, which should hopefully mean that Alondo doesn't realize that you've left him behind until it's too late. Now all that remains is for you to travel to <system>, defeat whatever opposition you find, and land on <planet>. Or die trying.|1329|0
units.english: You plan to leave after nightfall, which should hopefully mean that Alondo doesn't realize that you've left him behind until it's too late. Now all that remains is for you to travel to <system>, defeat whatever opposition you find, and land on <planet>. Or die trying.
units.italian: Hai intenzione di partire dopo il calare della notte, il che sperabilmente significa che Alondo non si accorgerà che l'hai lasciato indietro finché non sarà troppo tardi. Ora non resta che viaggiare fino a <system>, sconfiggere qualsiasi opposizione trovi e atterrare su <planet>. O morire provandoci.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|dialog|1384|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but there are still pirates defending the system. All pirates in the system must be eliminated before <planet> can be taken.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora pirati che difendono il sistema. Tutti i pirati del sistema devono essere eliminati prima che <planet> possa essere preso.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|log|1387|0
units.english: Disobeyed the Free Worlds Senate by helping to launch an attack on the pirate hub world of Greenrock. Captured the planet after a massive battle, but it is unclear how long the Free Worlds can afford to keep them subdued by force.
units.italian: Hai disobbedito al Senato delle Free Worlds aiutando a lanciare un attacco al mondo centrale della pirateria, Greenrock. Hai conquistato il pianeta dopo una battaglia enorme, ma non è chiaro per quanto tempo le Free Worlds possano permettersi di tenerlo sottomesso con la forza.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|As the remaining invasion fleet comes in for a landing on <origin>, you spot small pirate ships scattering from the spaceport, not into space, but instead into the far reaches of the Greenrock wilderness. When you reach the spaceport, there is a wild mix of emotions from the locals who remained. Some spit at you and curse you out. Others thank you for driving off the pirates, even if only temporarily. Others still thank you for freeing them and ask for transportation off-world before the slavers return; Greenrock is the hub of the underground slave trade in the galaxy, and it seems in the confusion and rush for some criminals to escape the spaceport, they left their slaves behind.|1389|0
units.english: As the remaining invasion fleet comes in for a landing on <origin>, you spot small pirate ships scattering from the spaceport, not into space, but instead into the far reaches of the Greenrock wilderness. When you reach the spaceport, there is a wild mix of emotions from the locals who remained. Some spit at you and curse you out. Others thank you for driving off the pirates, even if only temporarily. Others still thank you for freeing them and ask for transportation off-world before the slavers return; Greenrock is the hub of the underground slave trade in the galaxy, and it seems in the confusion and rush for some criminals to escape the spaceport, they left their slaves behind.
units.italian: Mentre il resto della flotta d'invasione si avvicina per atterrare su <origin>, vedi piccole navi pirata disperdersi dallo spazioporto, non verso lo spazio, ma verso gli angoli più remoti delle terre selvagge di Greenrock. Quando raggiungi lo spazioporto, c'è un misto selvaggio di emozioni fra la gente del posto rimasta. Alcuni ti sputano addosso e ti insultano. Altri ti ringraziano per aver scacciato i pirati, anche se solo temporaneamente. Altri ancora ti ringraziano per averli liberati e chiedono un passaggio fuori dal pianeta prima che gli schiavisti tornino; Greenrock è il centro della tratta clandestina di schiavi della galassia, e sembra che nella confusione e nella fretta di alcuni criminali di fuggire dallo spazioporto, gli schiavi siano stati lasciati indietro.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|	In an attempt to not get yourselves assassinated by pirates looking for revenge, the fleet forms their ships into a circle just outside the spaceport and keeps an eye out for aggressors while waiting for Tomek, or anyone of authority within the Free Worlds for that matter, to show up and determine your next move.|1390|0
units.english: In an attempt to not get yourselves assassinated by pirates looking for revenge, the fleet forms their ships into a circle just outside the spaceport and keeps an eye out for aggressors while waiting for Tomek, or anyone of authority within the Free Worlds for that matter, to show up and determine your next move.
units.italian: Nel tentativo di non farsi assassinare da pirati in cerca di vendetta, la flotta dispone le navi in cerchio appena fuori dallo spazioporto e tiene d'occhio eventuali aggressori, aspettando che si presenti Tomek, o chiunque abbia autorità nelle Free Worlds, per decidere la prossima mossa.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|	Hours later, Tomek's ship arrives, with even more ships in tow, likely to support a continued occupation. Tomek greets the invasion fleet, looking ecstatic. "Wonderful work, all of you. The people of the Free Worlds will be thanking you for generations." Tomek orders the members of the occupation fleet to sweep the spaceport, freeing any slaves they find and arresting any known criminals and warlords. "We can't possibly take in every criminal here, but if you find someone with a big name, we need to take this opportunity to arrest them."|1391|0
units.english: Hours later, Tomek's ship arrives, with even more ships in tow, likely to support a continued occupation. Tomek greets the invasion fleet, looking ecstatic. "Wonderful work, all of you. The people of the Free Worlds will be thanking you for generations." Tomek orders the members of the occupation fleet to sweep the spaceport, freeing any slaves they find and arresting any known criminals and warlords. "We can't possibly take in every criminal here, but if you find someone with a big name, we need to take this opportunity to arrest them."
units.italian: Ore dopo arriva la nave di Tomek, con ancora più navi al seguito, probabilmente per sostenere un'occupazione prolungata. Tomek saluta la flotta d'invasione, raggiante. "Lavoro meraviglioso, tutti quanti. La gente delle Free Worlds vi ringrazierà per generazioni." Tomek ordina ai membri della flotta di occupazione di setacciare lo spazioporto, liberando gli schiavi che trovano e arrestando i criminali e i signori della guerra noti. "Non possiamo certamente prendere ogni criminale che c'è qui, ma se trovate qualcuno con un nome importante, dobbiamo cogliere l'occasione di arrestarlo."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|	After Tomek is done giving orders and celebrating, he approaches you and gives your hand a firm shake. "Thank you for listening to reason, Captain <last>. I know I asked a lot of you when I asked you to directly disobey Senate orders."|1392|0
units.english: After Tomek is done giving orders and celebrating, he approaches you and gives your hand a firm shake. "Thank you for listening to reason, Captain <last>. I know I asked a lot of you when I asked you to directly disobey Senate orders."
units.italian: Quando Tomek ha finito di dare ordini e di festeggiare, si avvicina a te e ti stringe la mano con fermezza. "Grazie per aver ascoltato la ragione, Capitano <last>. So di averti chiesto molto quando ti ho chiesto di disobbedire direttamente agli ordini del Senato."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|	"What now?"|1394|0
units.english: "What now?"
units.italian: "E adesso?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|	"I'm sure we'll be getting in trouble for this."|1395|0
units.english: "I'm sure we'll be getting in trouble for this."
units.italian: "Sono sicuro che ci metteremo nei guai per questo."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|	Tomek smiles. "Now we do what we can to rout the criminals and warlords out of this place while we have the advantage. The more damage we can do to them, the less innocent people within the Free Worlds will be hurt by piracy in the future. I've already ordered the men to sweep the spaceport, and we'll be leaving a fleet stationed here for some time to keep the peace. In time we may need to pull back to focus on the Navy again, but for now Greenrock is ours."|1398|0
units.english: Tomek smiles. "Now we do what we can to rout the criminals and warlords out of this place while we have the advantage. The more damage we can do to them, the less innocent people within the Free Worlds will be hurt by piracy in the future. I've already ordered the men to sweep the spaceport, and we'll be leaving a fleet stationed here for some time to keep the peace. In time we may need to pull back to focus on the Navy again, but for now Greenrock is ours."
units.italian: Tomek sorride. "Adesso facciamo quello che possiamo per stanare i criminali e i signori della guerra da questo posto finché abbiamo il vantaggio. Più danni riusciamo a fargli, meno gente innocente dentro le Free Worlds verrà ferita dalla pirateria in futuro. Ho già ordinato agli uomini di setacciare lo spazioporto, e lasceremo qui una flotta di stanza per un po' a mantenere la pace. Col tempo potremmo doverci ritirare per concentrarci di nuovo sulla Marina, ma per ora Greenrock è nostra."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|	"What about the Senate?" you ask. "We'll certainly be in trouble for this."|1399|0
units.english: "What about the Senate?" you ask. "We'll certainly be in trouble for this."
units.italian: "E il Senato?" chiedi. "Ci metteremo di sicuro nei guai per questo."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|	"No good deed goes unpunished, I suppose," Tomek says. "Despite the great opportunity we've created for the Free Worlds, I have no doubt that the Senate will not be happy with the actions we took here. Should they attempt to punish us, let me take full responsibility for what was done here. They need me, so my punishment will not be too severe, and any punishment that is placed upon you should hopefully be minor by comparison. If asked, you were simply following the orders of a superior."|1402|0
units.english: "No good deed goes unpunished, I suppose," Tomek says. "Despite the great opportunity we've created for the Free Worlds, I have no doubt that the Senate will not be happy with the actions we took here. Should they attempt to punish us, let me take full responsibility for what was done here. They need me, so my punishment will not be too severe, and any punishment that is placed upon you should hopefully be minor by comparison. If asked, you were simply following the orders of a superior."
units.italian: "Nessuna buona azione resta impunita, suppongo," dice Tomek. "Nonostante la grande occasione che abbiamo creato per le Free Worlds, non ho dubbi che il Senato non sarà contento di quello che abbiamo fatto qui. Se tenteranno di punirci, lascia che mi prenda io la piena responsabilità di quello che è stato fatto. Hanno bisogno di me, quindi la mia punizione non sarà troppo severa, e qualsiasi punizione venga inflitta a te dovrebbe essere sperabilmente minore in confronto. Se ti chiedono, stavi semplicemente seguendo gli ordini di un superiore."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 2|	Just then, you hear another ship coming in for a landing. You both look up to see a Falcon landing in the spaceport: Alondo's Falcon that you were supposed to escort to Thule. Tomek has a somber look on his face. "Let me speak with them first," he says to you. "Meet with us in the spaceport later. Hopefully I'll have smoothed things over by then."|1403|0
units.english: Just then, you hear another ship coming in for a landing. You both look up to see a Falcon landing in the spaceport: Alondo's Falcon that you were supposed to escort to Thule. Tomek has a somber look on his face. "Let me speak with them first," he says to you. "Meet with us in the spaceport later. Hopefully I'll have smoothed things over by then."
units.italian: Proprio allora senti un'altra nave in avvicinamento per atterrare. Alzate entrambi lo sguardo e vedete un Falcon atterrare nello spazioporto: il Falcon di Alondo, quello che avresti dovuto scortare fino a Thule. Tomek ha un'espressione cupa. "Lascia che parli io con loro per primo," ti dice. "Raggiungici allo spazioporto più tardi. Speriamo che a quel punto abbia appianato le cose."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|name|1483|0
units.english: Early Warning
units.italian: Allerta precoce

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|description|1484|0
units.english: The early warning systems you installed on Hope have detected a heightened Navy presence. Travel to <destination> to defend against the potential Navy assault. Any punishment for the invasion of Greenrock will come later.
units.italian: I sistemi di allerta precoce che hai installato su Hope hanno rilevato una presenza maggiore della Marina. Va' su <destination> per difenderti dal potenziale assalto della Marina. Qualsiasi punizione per l'invasione di Greenrock arriverà più tardi.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|When you return to the spaceport, you're pointed to a small tent staging area by a militia officer. Inside you find Tomek speaking with Freya and Alondo, both of whom look rather unhappy.|1494|0
units.english: When you return to the spaceport, you're pointed to a small tent staging area by a militia officer. Inside you find Tomek speaking with Freya and Alondo, both of whom look rather unhappy.
units.italian: Quando torni allo spazioporto, un ufficiale della milizia ti indica una piccola tenda adibita a posto di comando. Dentro trovi Tomek che parla con Freya e Alondo, entrambi piuttosto scontenti.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	"Do you not realize how weak of a position this puts us into?" Alondo says to Tomek. "If we want to keep Greenrock then it will be a perpetual resource drain that we cannot afford right now."|1495|0
units.english: "Do you not realize how weak of a position this puts us into?" Alondo says to Tomek. "If we want to keep Greenrock then it will be a perpetual resource drain that we cannot afford right now."
units.italian: "Non ti rendi conto in che posizione debole ci mette questo?" dice Alondo a Tomek. "Se vogliamo tenere Greenrock, sarà uno spreco continuo di risorse che al momento non possiamo permetterci."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	"You're not seeing the bigger picture," Tomek responds. "Yes, we will need to spend resources keeping Greenrock under control, but we're already spending copious amounts of resources defending our planets, systems, and freighters from pirates as is. If we have Greenrock under our control and the other pirate worlds become afraid to act against us then that is one concentrated place that we need to focus on as opposed to being spread thin across our territory. In the end I imagine this will be a net positive for us."|1496|0
units.english: "You're not seeing the bigger picture," Tomek responds. "Yes, we will need to spend resources keeping Greenrock under control, but we're already spending copious amounts of resources defending our planets, systems, and freighters from pirates as is. If we have Greenrock under our control and the other pirate worlds become afraid to act against us then that is one concentrated place that we need to focus on as opposed to being spread thin across our territory. In the end I imagine this will be a net positive for us."
units.italian: "Non stai guardando il quadro generale," risponde Tomek. "Sì, dovremo spendere risorse per tenere Greenrock sotto controllo, ma stiamo già spendendo quantità enormi di risorse per difendere i nostri pianeti, i nostri sistemi e i nostri mercantili dai pirati. Se abbiamo Greenrock sotto controllo e gli altri mondi pirata cominciano ad aver paura di agire contro di noi, allora sarà un unico posto concentrato su cui dobbiamo concentrarci, invece di essere sparsi in tutto il nostro territorio. Alla fine immagino che sarà un guadagno netto per noi."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	"That is yet to be seen," says Freya, "but right now we're in the red. Do you know how much we're going to need to spend on repairs as a result of this stunt of yours, not only in credits but in man-hours? A massive amount of our fleet is out of commission because of this. If the Navy attacked now we'd be practically defenseless."|1497|0
units.english: "That is yet to be seen," says Freya, "but right now we're in the red. Do you know how much we're going to need to spend on repairs as a result of this stunt of yours, not only in credits but in man-hours? A massive amount of our fleet is out of commission because of this. If the Navy attacked now we'd be practically defenseless."
units.italian: "Questo è ancora da vedere," dice Freya, "ma al momento siamo in rosso. Sai quanto dovremo spendere in riparazioni per via di questa tua trovata, non solo in crediti ma in ore di lavoro? Una quantità enorme della nostra flotta è fuori uso per colpa di questo. Se la Marina attaccasse adesso, saremmo praticamente indifesi."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	Tomek pauses as he notices you standing at the entryway to the tent. Freya and Alondo also look over to you. "Care to explain yourself?" Freya asks.|1498|0
units.english: Tomek pauses as he notices you standing at the entryway to the tent. Freya and Alondo also look over to you. "Care to explain yourself?" Freya asks.
units.italian: Tomek si interrompe quando ti nota sull'ingresso della tenda. Anche Freya e Alondo si voltano verso di te. "Vuoi spiegarci che cosa è successo?" chiede Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	"I was simply following the orders of a superior. This was Tomek's idea."|1500|0
units.english: "I was simply following the orders of a superior. This was Tomek's idea."
units.italian: "Stavo semplicemente seguendo gli ordini di un superiore. È stata un'idea di Tomek."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	"No."|1501|0
units.english: "No."
units.italian: "No."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	"The orders of your superior were the orders from the Senate to escort me to Thule for a diplomatic mission," Alondo responds angrily. "Now that I'm late and word of this has spread quickly, the people of Thule are not interested in negotiating. I'm sure the Senate would love to hear your explanation. You know full well that you should not have come here, yet you did. You, Tomek, and every other captain here will be answering to the Senate shortly."|1503|0
units.english: "The orders of your superior were the orders from the Senate to escort me to Thule for a diplomatic mission," Alondo responds angrily. "Now that I'm late and word of this has spread quickly, the people of Thule are not interested in negotiating. I'm sure the Senate would love to hear your explanation. You know full well that you should not have come here, yet you did. You, Tomek, and every other captain here will be answering to the Senate shortly."
units.italian: "Gli ordini del tuo superiore erano gli ordini del Senato di scortarmi a Thule per una missione diplomatica," risponde Alondo arrabbiato. "Ora che sono in ritardo e la notizia si è sparsa in fretta, la gente di Thule non ha interesse a negoziare. Sono sicuro che al Senato piacerebbe sentire la tua spiegazione. Sai benissimo che non dovevi venire qui, e invece sei venuto. Tu, Tomek e ogni altro capitano qui dovrete rispondere al Senato a breve."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	Freya heaves a deep sigh and looks to the side for a moment before reaching to her hip, drawing her sidearm, and shooting you. You do not have an opportunity to react. You must have caught Freya on a particularly bad day. Try again.|1509|0
units.english: Freya heaves a deep sigh and looks to the side for a moment before reaching to her hip, drawing her sidearm, and shooting you. You do not have an opportunity to react. You must have caught Freya on a particularly bad day. Try again.
units.italian: Freya tira un profondo sospiro e guarda di lato per un momento, poi allunga la mano verso il fianco, estrae l'arma e ti spara. Non hai il tempo di reagire. Devi aver beccato Freya in una giornata particolarmente storta. Riprova.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	"Well maybe you'll be willing to explain yourself to the Senate," Alondo responds angrily. "Your orders were to escort me to Thule for a diplomatic mission, but now that I'm late and word of this has spread quickly, the people of Thule are not interested in negotiating. You know full well that you should not have come here, yet you did. You, Tomek, and every other captain who took part in this attack will be answering to the Senate shortly."|1513|0
units.english: "Well maybe you'll be willing to explain yourself to the Senate," Alondo responds angrily. "Your orders were to escort me to Thule for a diplomatic mission, but now that I'm late and word of this has spread quickly, the people of Thule are not interested in negotiating. You know full well that you should not have come here, yet you did. You, Tomek, and every other captain who took part in this attack will be answering to the Senate shortly."
units.italian: "Beh, forse sarai disposto a spiegarti davanti al Senato," risponde Alondo arrabbiato. "I tuoi ordini erano di scortarmi a Thule per una missione diplomatica, ma ora che sono in ritardo e la notizia si è sparsa in fretta, la gente di Thule non ha interesse a negoziare. Sai benissimo che non dovevi venire qui, e invece sei venuto. Tu, Tomek e ogni altro capitano che ha partecipato a questo attacco dovrete rispondere al Senato a breve."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	Before anyone can continue arguing, JJ rushes into the tent. "Sorry to interrupt, but this little spat is going to need to wait. I just got word that our sensors on Hope have detected increased Navy fleet movements. It seems like they're getting ready for an assault."|1516|0
units.english: Before anyone can continue arguing, JJ rushes into the tent. "Sorry to interrupt, but this little spat is going to need to wait. I just got word that our sensors on Hope have detected increased Navy fleet movements. It seems like they're getting ready for an assault."
units.italian: Prima che qualcuno possa continuare a discutere, JJ irrompe nella tenda. "Scusate l'interruzione, ma questa piccola lite dovrà aspettare. Mi è appena arrivata voce che i nostri sensori su Hope hanno rilevato movimenti crescenti della flotta della Marina. Sembra che si stiano preparando a un assalto."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	"Have they entered our space?" Alondo asks.|1517|0
units.english: "Have they entered our space?" Alondo asks.
units.italian: "Sono entrati nel nostro spazio?" chiede Alondo.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	"No, not yet. Not even a single scout," says JJ.|1518|0
units.english: "No, not yet. Not even a single scout," says JJ.
units.italian: "No, non ancora. Nemmeno un esploratore," dice JJ.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	"Leave a small fleet here to maintain our occupation, but move the rest of our available forces to <system>," Tomek says, taking charge of the situation. "Recall the eastern patrols. They might arrive late to any battle, but they can at least act as reinforcements if necessary."|1519|0
units.english: "Leave a small fleet here to maintain our occupation, but move the rest of our available forces to <system>," Tomek says, taking charge of the situation. "Recall the eastern patrols. They might arrive late to any battle, but they can at least act as reinforcements if necessary."
units.italian: "Lasciate qui una piccola flotta a mantenere l'occupazione, ma spostate il resto delle nostre forze disponibili su <system>," dice Tomek, prendendo in mano la situazione. "Richiamate le pattuglie a est. Potrebbero arrivare in ritardo a un eventuale battaglia, ma almeno possono servire da rinforzi se necessario."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	"You're in no position to be giving orders," Freya says, looking disgusted at Tomek. "You and <first> should both be placed under arrest for disobeying the Senate."|1520|0
units.english: "You're in no position to be giving orders," Freya says, looking disgusted at Tomek. "You and <first> should both be placed under arrest for disobeying the Senate."
units.italian: "Non sei in posizione per dare ordini," dice Freya, guardando Tomek con disgusto. "Tu e <first> dovreste essere entrambi agli arresti per aver disobbedito al Senato."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	"No," JJ says. "At least not yet. If the Navy is about to attack then we need everyone we can get. We'll resolve this matter once we have the time. And for now, Tomek is still a part of the Council. But if you won't listen to his orders, then I imagine you'll listen to mine, and I agree with Tomek, at least in this instance. Do what he says. Move our forces to <system> and recall any patrols."|1521|0
units.english: "No," JJ says. "At least not yet. If the Navy is about to attack then we need everyone we can get. We'll resolve this matter once we have the time. And for now, Tomek is still a part of the Council. But if you won't listen to his orders, then I imagine you'll listen to mine, and I agree with Tomek, at least in this instance. Do what he says. Move our forces to <system> and recall any patrols."
units.italian: "No," dice JJ. "Almeno non ancora. Se la Marina sta per attaccare, allora abbiamo bisogno di tutti quelli che possiamo avere. Risolveremo questa faccenda quando avremo il tempo. E per ora Tomek fa ancora parte del Consiglio. Ma se non vuoi ascoltare i suoi ordini, immagino che ascolterai i miei, e io sono d'accordo con Tomek, almeno in questo caso. Fate quello che dice. Spostate le nostre forze su <system> e richiamate le pattuglie."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	With that, JJ leaves the tent, hurrying off to a ship. Alondo too leaves without a word. As Freya begins to leave, she turns back to you and Tomek. "I'm very disappointed in you. Both of you." She exits the tent, leaving you and Tomek alone.|1522|0
units.english: With that, JJ leaves the tent, hurrying off to a ship. Alondo too leaves without a word. As Freya begins to leave, she turns back to you and Tomek. "I'm very disappointed in you. Both of you." She exits the tent, leaving you and Tomek alone.
units.italian: Detto questo, JJ lascia la tenda e corre verso una nave. Anche Alondo se ne va senza dire una parola. Mentre Freya si appresta a uscire, si volta verso di te e Tomek. "Sono molto delusa da voi. Da entrambi." Esce dalla tenda, lasciandovi soli.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|	"You should get going," Tomek says solemnly. "And don't get yourself killed in this battle just because of this little mess here. As disappointed as they might be, you still have a part to play. The Free Worlds still needs you. I can feel it." He pauses for a moment before saying, "See you on <planet>," and leaving.|1523|0
units.english: "You should get going," Tomek says solemnly. "And don't get yourself killed in this battle just because of this little mess here. As disappointed as they might be, you still have a part to play. The Free Worlds still needs you. I can feel it." He pauses for a moment before saying, "See you on <planet>," and leaving.
units.italian: "Dovresti andare," dice Tomek, solenne. "E non farti ammazzare in questa battaglia solo per colpa di questo piccolo pasticcio. Per quanto delusi possano essere, hai ancora una parte da recitare. Le Free Worlds hanno ancora bisogno di te. Lo sento." Si ferma un momento prima di dire: "Ci vediamo su <planet>," e andarsene.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Attack 3|dialog|1527|0
units.english: When you launch, you receive a message from the Terebinth, Alondo's transport. "Greetings, Captain <last>. This is the captain of the F.S. Terebinth. I have the Council in tow. I know that Greenrock has been suppressed, but I wouldn't be surprised if there are pirates looking for revenge. Care to watch my back on our way to <planet>? Thanks."
units.italian: Quando decolli, ricevi un messaggio dalla Terebinth, il trasporto di Alondo. "Salve, Capitano <last>. Sono il capitano della F.S. Terebinth. Ho il Consiglio a bordo. So che Greenrock è stata repressa, ma non mi sorprenderebbe se ci fossero pirati in cerca di vendetta. Ti va di coprirmi le spalle mentre andiamo su <planet>? Grazie."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 1|name|1546|0
units.english: Pirate Diplomacy
units.italian: Diplomazia con i pirati

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 1|description|1547|0
units.english: Following the Senate's orders, travel to <destination> and negotiate with the ruling authorities. Don't fight pirates if you don't have to, and don't let your escort be destroyed.
units.italian: Seguendo gli ordini del Senato, va' su <destination> e negozia con le autorità che governano il pianeta. Non combattere i pirati se non devi, e non lasciare che la tua scorta venga distrutta.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 2|name|1574|0
units.english: Defend Thule
units.italian: Difendi Thule

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 2|description|1575|0
units.english: Destroy the pirate fleet that is attacking the spaceport on Thule. Free Worlds reinforcements ought to be on their way.
units.italian: Distruggi la flotta pirata che sta attaccando lo spazioporto su Thule. I rinforzi delle Free Worlds dovrebbero essere in arrivo.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 2|One of the first people to step off the Falcon "Terebinth" when it lands is Alondo. You ask him what the plan is.|1586|0
units.english: One of the first people to step off the Falcon "Terebinth" when it lands is Alondo. You ask him what the plan is.
units.italian: Una delle prime persone a scendere dal Falcon "Terebinth" quando atterra è Alondo. Gli chiedi qual è il piano.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 2|	"Well," he says, "the people I'll be meeting with here are tribal elders, of a sort. But the tribes are separated not so much by ethnicity, as by geography and ideology. I can't claim to understand all the intricacies, really, but in matters affecting the entire planet they have authority to make consensus decisions. Of course, there are hundreds of independent settlements and groups that may or may not abide by that decision. So I hate to say it, but Tomek is right that this will be difficult to pull off."|1587|0
units.english: "Well," he says, "the people I'll be meeting with here are tribal elders, of a sort. But the tribes are separated not so much by ethnicity, as by geography and ideology. I can't claim to understand all the intricacies, really, but in matters affecting the entire planet they have authority to make consensus decisions. Of course, there are hundreds of independent settlements and groups that may or may not abide by that decision. So I hate to say it, but Tomek is right that this will be difficult to pull off."
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "le persone che incontrerò qui sono una specie di anziani delle tribù. Ma le tribù sono separate non tanto per etnia, quanto per geografia e ideologia. Non posso dire di capire tutte le sottigliezze, davvero, ma nelle questioni che riguardano l'intero pianeta hanno l'autorità di prendere decisioni per consenso. Naturalmente ci sono centinaia di insediamenti e gruppi indipendenti che possono o non possono rispettare quella decisione. Quindi mi dispiace dirlo, ma Tomek ha ragione che sarà difficile riuscirci."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 2|	"What do you think our odds are of a successful negotiation?"|1589|0
units.english: "What do you think our odds are of a successful negotiation?"
units.italian: "Quante probabilità pensi che abbiamo di una negoziazione riuscita?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 2|	"What do we do if diplomacy doesn't work?"|1590|0
units.english: "What do we do if diplomacy doesn't work?"
units.italian: "Che cosa facciamo se la diplomazia non funziona?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 2|	Before he has a chance to respond, the sky lights up with incoming particle beams, and you see one of the Terebinth's engines erupt in a gout of flames. "What the hell?" says Alondo.|1592|0
units.english: Before he has a chance to respond, the sky lights up with incoming particle beams, and you see one of the Terebinth's engines erupt in a gout of flames. "What the hell?" says Alondo.
units.italian: Prima che abbia la possibilità di rispondere, il cielo si illumina di raggi di particelle in arrivo, e vedi uno dei motori della Terebinth esplodere in una vampata di fiamme. "Che diavolo succede?" dice Alondo.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 2|	The captain of the Terebinth, who is standing next to you, stares slack-jawed at his ship for a second before jumping into action. "Captain <last>," he says, "fire up your ship immediately and go after whoever is attacking us. I'll call for backup, but you will need to keep the attackers distracted until they arrive."|1593|0
units.english: The captain of the Terebinth, who is standing next to you, stares slack-jawed at his ship for a second before jumping into action. "Captain <last>," he says, "fire up your ship immediately and go after whoever is attacking us. I'll call for backup, but you will need to keep the attackers distracted until they arrive."
units.italian: Il capitano della Terebinth, che ti sta accanto, fissa la sua nave a bocca aperta per un secondo prima di scattare. "Capitano <last>," dice, "accendi subito la nave e vai dietro a chiunque ci stia attaccando. Chiamerò i rinforzi, ma dovrai tenere occupati gli attaccanti finché non arrivano."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 3|name|1639|0
units.english: Return to Longjump
units.italian: Torna a Longjump

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 3|description|1640|0
units.english: Escort the newly repaired F.S. Terebinth back to the Free Worlds base on <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta la F.S. Terebinth, appena riparata, fino alla base delle Free Worlds su <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 3|log|1651|0
units.english: The elders on Thule do not want to join the Free Worlds, but they have agreed to crack down on pirate activity in their system and to welcome Free Worlds visitors to their planet.
units.italian: Gli anziani di Thule non vogliono unirsi alle Free Worlds, ma hanno accettato di contrastare l'attività pirata nel loro sistema e di accogliere i visitatori delle Free Worlds sul loro pianeta.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 3|A pall of smoke still hangs over the spaceport, and as you are coming in for a landing you fly over one landing pad where bodies draped in sheets have been laid out side by side: dozens of casualties. Several buildings are in ruins, some of them still smoldering.|1653|0
units.english: A pall of smoke still hangs over the spaceport, and as you are coming in for a landing you fly over one landing pad where bodies draped in sheets have been laid out side by side: dozens of casualties. Several buildings are in ruins, some of them still smoldering.
units.italian: Una coltre di fumo pende ancora sullo spazioporto, e mentre ti avvicini per atterrare sorvoli una piazzola dove sono stati disposti fianco a fianco i corpi coperti da lenzuoli: decine di vittime. Diversi edifici sono in rovina, alcuni ancora fumanti.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 3|	Alondo has survived, fortunately. He tells you, "While the fight was going on overhead, I met with the elders, and they agreed that now that the Free Worlds exist and opposing the pirates is a viable option, they will try to put an end to piracy in this system. But they have no interest whatsoever in joining the Free Worlds."|1654|0
units.english: Alondo has survived, fortunately. He tells you, "While the fight was going on overhead, I met with the elders, and they agreed that now that the Free Worlds exist and opposing the pirates is a viable option, they will try to put an end to piracy in this system. But they have no interest whatsoever in joining the Free Worlds."
units.italian: Alondo è sopravvissuto, per fortuna. Ti dice: "Mentre lo scontro infuriava là sopra, ho incontrato gli anziani, e hanno convenuto che, ora che le Free Worlds esistono e opporsi ai pirati è un'opzione praticabile, cercheranno di porre fine alla pirateria in questo sistema. Ma non hanno alcun interesse a unirsi alle Free Worlds."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 3|	"That's the best we had hoped for, right?"|1656|0
units.english: "That's the best we had hoped for, right?"
units.italian: "Era il massimo che potevamo sperare, no?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 3|	"While we've got our fleet here, why not just demand that they join us?"|1658|0
units.english: "While we've got our fleet here, why not just demand that they join us?"
units.italian: "Finché abbiamo la flotta qui, perché non chiedere semplicemente che si uniscano a noi?"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 3|	"You can't force people to join a democracy," he says. "Maybe some day they'll be ready, but in the meantime, any pressure we exert on them will turn them from an almost-ally into an enemy."|1659|0
units.english: "You can't force people to join a democracy," he says. "Maybe some day they'll be ready, but in the meantime, any pressure we exert on them will turn them from an almost-ally into an enemy."
units.italian: "Non puoi costringere la gente a unirsi a una democrazia," dice. "Magari un giorno saranno pronti, ma nel frattempo qualsiasi pressione che esercitiamo su di loro li trasformerà da quasi-alleati in nemici."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 3|	"Indeed," he says, "I hate to say it, but that pirate attack actually helped our case. But only time will tell what will come of this experiment of letting worlds be 'independent.' If more worlds start wanting total independence, rather than joining us, our future may not be sustainable."|1662|0
units.english: "Indeed," he says, "I hate to say it, but that pirate attack actually helped our case. But only time will tell what will come of this experiment of letting worlds be 'independent.' If more worlds start wanting total independence, rather than joining us, our future may not be sustainable."
units.italian: "Esatto," dice, "mi dispiace dirlo, ma quell'attacco dei pirati ha in realtà aiutato la nostra causa. Ma solo il tempo dirà che cosa verrà da questo esperimento di lasciare i mondi 'indipendenti'. Se sempre più mondi cominceranno a volere l'indipendenza totale, invece di unirsi a noi, il nostro futuro potrebbe non essere sostenibile."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 3|	"So, what do we do next?" you ask.|1664|0
units.english: "So, what do we do next?" you ask.
units.italian: "E allora qual è il prossimo passo?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 3|	"Well, the Terebinth is patched up, but they could use an escort back to <planet>. After that, you'll have to see what the Senate or the Council want you to do."|1665|0
units.english: "Well, the Terebinth is patched up, but they could use an escort back to <planet>. After that, you'll have to see what the Senate or the Council want you to do."
units.italian: "Beh, la Terebinth è stata rattoppata, ma un po' di scorta fino a <planet> le servirebbe. Dopo, dovrai vedere che cosa vogliono farti fare il Senato o il Consiglio."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|name|1680|0
units.english: Early Warning
units.italian: Allerta precoce

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|description|1681|0
units.english: The early warning systems you installed on Hope have detected a heightened Navy presence. Travel to <destination> to defend against the potential Navy assault. Any punishment for the invasion of Greenrock will come later.
units.italian: I sistemi di allerta precoce che hai installato su Hope hanno rilevato una presenza maggiore della Marina. Va' su <destination> per difenderti dal potenziale assalto della Marina. Qualsiasi punizione per l'invasione di Greenrock arriverà più tardi.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|You arrive back on Longjump to a hero's welcome. People have heard of the battle you fought on Thule and the deal that was forged with the locals there. JJ and Freya greet you too, and congratulate you. But then Freya says, "We need to talk in private."|1692|0
units.english: You arrive back on Longjump to a hero's welcome. People have heard of the battle you fought on Thule and the deal that was forged with the locals there. JJ and Freya greet you too, and congratulate you. But then Freya says, "We need to talk in private."
units.italian: Torni su Longjump e trovi un'accoglienza da eroe. La gente ha sentito della battaglia che hai combattuto su Thule e dell'accordo raggiunto con la gente del posto. Anche JJ e Freya ti salutano e si congratulano. Ma poi Freya dice: "Dobbiamo parlare in privato."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	You lead them into your ship, where Freya explains, "Soon after you left for Thule, Tomek took off on his own and raised a fleet for an attack on Greenrock. He thought the Senate's plan of making a deal with the pirate worlds was too cowardly, and that we needed a show of strength instead. Surprisingly, his stunt succeeded; Greenrock is now nominally under Free Worlds control."|1693|0
units.english: You lead them into your ship, where Freya explains, "Soon after you left for Thule, Tomek took off on his own and raised a fleet for an attack on Greenrock. He thought the Senate's plan of making a deal with the pirate worlds was too cowardly, and that we needed a show of strength instead. Surprisingly, his stunt succeeded; Greenrock is now nominally under Free Worlds control."
units.italian: Li fai entrare nella tua nave, dove Freya spiega: "Poco dopo la tua partenza per Thule, Tomek è partito per conto suo e ha radunato una flotta per un attacco a Greenrock. Pensava che il piano del Senato di fare un accordo con i mondi pirata fosse troppo codardo, e che invece servisse una dimostrazione di forza. Sorprendentemente, la sua trovata è riuscita; Greenrock ora è nominalmente sotto il controllo delle Free Worlds."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	"This puts us in a rather difficult position," says JJ. "Much of Tomek's fleet didn't survive the assault, and those ships didn't come out of thin air; they were intended for defensive purposes in case the Navy attacks again. Word of this has spread quickly. Thule is already second guessing their deal with us, and if Thule has heard of this then there's no doubt in my mind that the Republic has as well."|1694|0
units.english: "This puts us in a rather difficult position," says JJ. "Much of Tomek's fleet didn't survive the assault, and those ships didn't come out of thin air; they were intended for defensive purposes in case the Navy attacks again. Word of this has spread quickly. Thule is already second guessing their deal with us, and if Thule has heard of this then there's no doubt in my mind that the Republic has as well."
units.italian: "Questo ci mette in una posizione piuttosto difficile," dice JJ. "Gran parte della flotta di Tomek non è sopravvissuta all'assalto, e quelle navi non sono uscite dal nulla: erano destinate alla difesa nel caso la Marina attacchi di nuovo. La notizia si è sparsa in fretta. Thule sta già rimettendo in discussione l'accordo con noi, e se Thule ne ha sentito parlare, non ho alcun dubbio che anche la Repubblica lo sappia."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	"And regardless of his success, an invasion of Greenrock was not approved by the Senate," says Freya. "Tomek was detained on Greenrock by some of our officers on order of the Senate, and he's currently being transported to Bourne for a hearing."|1695|0
units.english: "And regardless of his success, an invasion of Greenrock was not approved by the Senate," says Freya. "Tomek was detained on Greenrock by some of our officers on order of the Senate, and he's currently being transported to Bourne for a hearing."
units.italian: "E a prescindere dal suo successo, un'invasione di Greenrock non è stata approvata dal Senato," dice Freya. "Tomek è stato fermato su Greenrock da alcuni dei nostri ufficiali su ordine del Senato, e al momento è in trasferimento verso Bourne per un'udienza."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	"Why would Tomek do something like that? It's unthinkable!"|1697|0
units.english: "Why would Tomek do something like that? It's unthinkable!"
units.italian: "Perché Tomek avrebbe fatto una cosa del genere? È impensabile!"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	"How can the Senate have him arrested? He's part of the Council!"|1698|0
units.english: "How can the Senate have him arrested? He's part of the Council!"
units.italian: "Come fa il Senato ad arrestarlo? Fa parte del Consiglio!"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	"That's easy to answer," says Freya. "He didn't like the idea of taking orders from the Senate. He thought they should treat him like a hero and go along with whatever he thought best."|1700|0
units.english: "That's easy to answer," says Freya. "He didn't like the idea of taking orders from the Senate. He thought they should treat him like a hero and go along with whatever he thought best."
units.italian: "È facile rispondere," dice Freya. "Non gli piaceva l'idea di prendere ordini dal Senato. Pensava che dovessero trattarlo come un eroe e assecondare quello che riteneva meglio."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	"Is it really that easy?" says JJ softly. Freya raises an eyebrow, but doesn't respond to the question.|1701|0
units.english: "Is it really that easy?" says JJ softly. Freya raises an eyebrow, but doesn't respond to the question.
units.italian: "È davvero così facile?" dice JJ a voce bassa. Freya alza un sopracciglio, ma non risponde alla domanda.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	JJ and Freya are both quiet for a minute, then Freya says, "You know, there are people in the Senate who worry that the Council could become the ruling authority in the Free Worlds, instead of a democratic Senate. It wouldn't be the first time a people's revolution turned into an oligarchy. We of the Council have to be careful not to let that happen."|1704|0
units.english: JJ and Freya are both quiet for a minute, then Freya says, "You know, there are people in the Senate who worry that the Council could become the ruling authority in the Free Worlds, instead of a democratic Senate. It wouldn't be the first time a people's revolution turned into an oligarchy. We of the Council have to be careful not to let that happen."
units.italian: JJ e Freya restano entrambi in silenzio per un minuto, poi Freya dice: "Sai, ci sono persone nel Senato che temono che il Consiglio possa diventare l'autorità dominante nelle Free Worlds, invece di un Senato democratico. Non sarebbe la prima volta che una rivoluzione popolare si trasforma in un'oligarchia. Noi del Consiglio dobbiamo stare attenti a non permetterlo."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	"So, what will happen to Tomek?" you ask.|1706|0
units.english: "So, what will happen to Tomek?" you ask.
units.italian: "Allora, che cosa succederà a Tomek?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	"That's for the Senate to decide," says JJ. "But he's a tactical genius. We'll need his advice, if this war turns worse."|1707|0
units.english: "That's for the Senate to decide," says JJ. "But he's a tactical genius. We'll need his advice, if this war turns worse."
units.italian: "Lo deciderà il Senato," dice JJ. "Ma è un genio tattico. Avremo bisogno dei suoi consigli, se questa guerra peggiora."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	Just then, Alondo comes running onto your ship, looking particularly worried. "I hope I'm not interrupting anything too important, but I just received word that our sensors on Hope have detected increased Navy fleet movements. It seems like they're getting ready for an assault."|1708|0
units.english: Just then, Alondo comes running onto your ship, looking particularly worried. "I hope I'm not interrupting anything too important, but I just received word that our sensors on Hope have detected increased Navy fleet movements. It seems like they're getting ready for an assault."
units.italian: Proprio allora Alondo entra di corsa nella tua nave, con un'aria particolarmente preoccupata. "Spero di non interrompere niente di troppo importante, ma mi è appena arrivata voce che i nostri sensori su Hope hanno rilevato movimenti crescenti della flotta della Marina. Sembra che si stiano preparando a un assalto."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	"Have they entered our space?" JJ asks.|1709|0
units.english: "Have they entered our space?" JJ asks.
units.italian: "Sono entrati nel nostro spazio?" chiede JJ.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	"No, not yet. Not even a single scout," says Alondo.|1710|0
units.english: "No, not yet. Not even a single scout," says Alondo.
units.italian: "No, non ancora. Nemmeno un esploratore," dice Alondo.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	"We should head to <planet> before deciding our next move," says Freya.|1711|0
units.english: "We should head to <planet> before deciding our next move," says Freya.
units.italian: "Dovremmo andare su <planet> prima di decidere la prossima mossa," dice Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	"About that," says Alondo. "It seems like Tomek is way ahead of us. The news that Tomek is under arrest by the Senate didn't spread quickly enough, and an officer gave him the news about the sensors. He argued that since his position in the Council hasn't yet been revoked, he still has the power to command the militia, and he already ordered all available forces to <system>, including recalling our patrols in the eastern Dirt Belt. The officers who were detaining him reluctantly agreed, given the situation, and released him."|1712|0
units.english: "About that," says Alondo. "It seems like Tomek is way ahead of us. The news that Tomek is under arrest by the Senate didn't spread quickly enough, and an officer gave him the news about the sensors. He argued that since his position in the Council hasn't yet been revoked, he still has the power to command the militia, and he already ordered all available forces to <system>, including recalling our patrols in the eastern Dirt Belt. The officers who were detaining him reluctantly agreed, given the situation, and released him."
units.italian: "A proposito," dice Alondo. "Sembra che Tomek ci abbia battuti sul tempo. La notizia che il Senato lo stava arrestando non si è sparsa abbastanza in fretta, e un ufficiale gli ha dato la notizia dei sensori. Ha sostenuto che, dato che la sua posizione nel Consiglio non è ancora stata revocata, ha ancora il potere di comandare la milizia, e ha già ordinato a tutte le forze disponibili di andare su <system>, compreso il richiamo delle nostre pattuglie nella Fascia di Terra orientale. Gli ufficiali che lo trattenevano hanno accettato a malincuore, vista la situazione, e l'hanno rilasciato."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	"What?" Freya says with disbelief. "Tomek is in no position to be giving orders! Let everyone know that he is not to be obeyed!"|1713|0
units.english: "What?" Freya says with disbelief. "Tomek is in no position to be giving orders! Let everyone know that he is not to be obeyed!"
units.italian: "Che cosa?" dice Freya incredula. "Tomek non è in posizione per dare ordini! Fate sapere a tutti che non va obbedito!"

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	"No," JJ says. "At least not yet. If the Navy is about to attack then we need everyone we can get. We'll resolve this matter once we have the time. And for now, Tomek is still a part of the Council. But if you won't listen to his orders, then I imagine you'll listen to mine, and I agree with Tomek, at least in this instance. Do what he says. Move our forces to <system> and recall any patrols."|1714|0
units.english: "No," JJ says. "At least not yet. If the Navy is about to attack then we need everyone we can get. We'll resolve this matter once we have the time. And for now, Tomek is still a part of the Council. But if you won't listen to his orders, then I imagine you'll listen to mine, and I agree with Tomek, at least in this instance. Do what he says. Move our forces to <system> and recall any patrols."
units.italian: "No," dice JJ. "Almeno non ancora. Se la Marina sta per attaccare, abbiamo bisogno di tutti quelli che possiamo avere. Risolveremo la faccenda quando avremo il tempo. E per ora Tomek fa ancora parte del Consiglio. Ma se non vuoi ascoltare i suoi ordini, immagino che ascolterai i miei, e io sono d'accordo con Tomek, almeno in questo caso. Fate quello che dice. Spostate le nostre forze su <system> e richiamate le pattuglie."

units.id: mission:FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4|	Freya doesn't argue with JJ. "We should get going," says Alondo. "The Terebinth has room for all of us. I'm sure Tomek will find his own way to <planet>."|1715|0
units.english: Freya doesn't argue with JJ. "We should get going," says Alondo. "The Terebinth has room for all of us. I'm sure Tomek will find his own way to <planet>."
units.italian: Freya non discute con JJ. "Dovremmo andare," dice Alondo. "La Terebinth ha spazio per tutti noi. Sono sicuro che Tomek troverà il modo di arrivare su <planet> da solo."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|name|1730|0
units.english: Early Warning
units.italian: Allerta precoce

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|description|1731|0
units.english: The Navy looks as though they're preparing for an attack. Scout the <waypoints> systems just north of Free Worlds space to determine the strength of the Navy there.
units.italian: La Marina sembra prepararsi a un attacco. Esplora i sistemi <waypoints>, appena a nord dello spazio delle Free Worlds, per stabilire la forza della Marina che c'è.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|When you arrive at the quartermaster's building in the spaceport where the militia are gathering, you find that the rest of the Council has already found Tomek and are arguing with him in front of a silent crowd of militia officers who look as though they're watching their parents fighting.|1749|0
units.english: When you arrive at the quartermaster's building in the spaceport where the militia are gathering, you find that the rest of the Council has already found Tomek and are arguing with him in front of a silent crowd of militia officers who look as though they're watching their parents fighting.
units.italian: Quando arrivi all'edificio del quartiermastro nello spazioporto, dove si sta radunando la milizia, scopri che il resto del Consiglio ha già trovato Tomek e sta discutendo con lui davanti a una folla silenziosa di ufficiali della milizia che sembrano assistere a una lite fra i genitori.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	"Do you not realize how weak of a position this puts us into?" Alondo says to Tomek. "If we want to keep Greenrock then it will be a perpetual resource drain that we cannot afford right now."|1750|0
units.english: "Do you not realize how weak of a position this puts us into?" Alondo says to Tomek. "If we want to keep Greenrock then it will be a perpetual resource drain that we cannot afford right now."
units.italian: "Non ti rendi conto in che posizione debole ci mette questo?" dice Alondo a Tomek. "Se vogliamo tenere Greenrock, sarà uno spreco continuo di risorse che al momento non possiamo permetterci."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	"You're not seeing the bigger picture," Tomek responds. "Yes, we will need to spend resources keeping Greenrock under control, but we're already spending copious amounts of resources defending our planets, systems, and freighters from pirates as is. If we have Greenrock under our control and the other pirate worlds become afraid to act against us then that is one concentrated place that we need to focus on as opposed to being spread thin across our territory. In the end I imagine this will be a net positive for us."|1751|0
units.english: "You're not seeing the bigger picture," Tomek responds. "Yes, we will need to spend resources keeping Greenrock under control, but we're already spending copious amounts of resources defending our planets, systems, and freighters from pirates as is. If we have Greenrock under our control and the other pirate worlds become afraid to act against us then that is one concentrated place that we need to focus on as opposed to being spread thin across our territory. In the end I imagine this will be a net positive for us."
units.italian: "Non stai guardando il quadro generale," risponde Tomek. "Sì, dovremo spendere risorse per tenere Greenrock sotto controllo, ma stiamo già spendendo quantità enormi di risorse per difendere i nostri pianeti, i nostri sistemi e i nostri mercantili dai pirati. Se abbiamo Greenrock sotto controllo e gli altri mondi pirata cominciano ad aver paura di agire contro di noi, allora sarà un unico posto concentrato su cui dobbiamo concentrarci, invece di essere sparsi in tutto il nostro territorio. Alla fine immagino che sarà un guadagno netto per noi."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	"That is yet to be seen," says Freya, "but right now we're in the red. Do you know how much we're going to need to spend on repairs as a result of this stunt of yours, not only in credits but in man-hours? A massive amount of our fleet is out of commission because of this. If the Navy attacked now we'd be practically defenseless."|1752|0
units.english: "That is yet to be seen," says Freya, "but right now we're in the red. Do you know how much we're going to need to spend on repairs as a result of this stunt of yours, not only in credits but in man-hours? A massive amount of our fleet is out of commission because of this. If the Navy attacked now we'd be practically defenseless."
units.italian: "Questo è ancora da vedere," dice Freya, "ma al momento siamo in rosso. Sai quanto dovremo spendere in riparazioni per via di questa tua trovata, non solo in crediti ma in ore di lavoro? Una quantità enorme della nostra flotta è fuori uso per colpa di questo. Se la Marina attaccasse adesso, saremmo praticamente indifesi."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	Tomek pauses for a moment, allowing JJ to step in. "We can discuss the consequences of Tomek's actions later. For now we need to focus on the situation at hand."|1753|0
units.english: Tomek pauses for a moment, allowing JJ to step in. "We can discuss the consequences of Tomek's actions later. For now we need to focus on the situation at hand."
units.italian: Tomek si ferma un momento, lasciando spazio a JJ. "Possiamo discutere le conseguenze delle azioni di Tomek più tardi. Per ora dobbiamo concentrarci sulla situazione presente."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|You arrive at the quartermaster's building in the spaceport where the militia are gathering. The Council are standing outside, along with a silent crowd of militia officers who look as though they've just watched their parents fighting.|1757|0
units.english: You arrive at the quartermaster's building in the spaceport where the militia are gathering. The Council are standing outside, along with a silent crowd of militia officers who look as though they've just watched their parents fighting.
units.italian: Arrivi all'edificio del quartiermastro nello spazioporto, dove si sta radunando la milizia. Il Consiglio è fuori, insieme a una folla silenziosa di ufficiali della milizia che sembra aver appena assistito a una lite fra i genitori.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	"Let's get inside," Tomek says, motioning for a number of militia officers to follow. As they file in, he also motions to you.|1760|0
units.english: "Let's get inside," Tomek says, motioning for a number of militia officers to follow. As they file in, he also motions to you.
units.italian: "Entriamo," dice Tomek, facendo cenno a diversi ufficiali della milizia di seguirlo. Mentre entrano in fila, fa cenno anche a te.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	(Go inside.)|1762|0
units.english: (Go inside.)
units.italian: (Entra pure.)

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	On the inside there is a large table with a map of the region at its center, much nicer than Tomek's map that he was using on Longjump. "Officer Sullivan, please give us a sitrep," JJ says.|1763|0
units.english: On the inside there is a large table with a map of the region at its center, much nicer than Tomek's map that he was using on Longjump. "Officer Sullivan, please give us a sitrep," JJ says.
units.italian: Dentro c'è un grande tavolo con al centro una mappa della regione, molto più bella di quella che Tomek usava su Longjump. "Ufficiale Sullivan, ci dia un rapporto sulla situazione," dice JJ.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	"Yes, sir. As the quartermaster of Deep, I have been monitoring the results of the early warning sensors installed on Hope by Captain <last>. For months now we would receive only the occasional ping of Navy ships entering the system, presumably scout fleets or fleets passing through the system from the western Dirt Belt to the east.|1764|0
units.english: "Yes, sir. As the quartermaster of Deep, I have been monitoring the results of the early warning sensors installed on Hope by Captain <last>. For months now we would receive only the occasional ping of Navy ships entering the system, presumably scout fleets or fleets passing through the system from the western Dirt Belt to the east.
units.italian: "Sissignore. Come quartiermastro di Deep, ho monitorato i risultati dei sensori di allerta precoce installati su Hope dal Capitano <last>. Per mesi abbiamo ricevuto solo un ping occasionale di navi della Marina che entravano nel sistema, presumibilmente flotte esplorative o flotte di passaggio dal settore occidentale della Fascia di Terra verso est.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	"But starting within the past week, the number of Navy ships passing through the system began to rapidly increase. We went from seeing a fleet every few days to multiple per day, and those fleets that did enter often lingered for a longer amount of time for an unknown reason."|1765|0
units.english: "But starting within the past week, the number of Navy ships passing through the system began to rapidly increase. We went from seeing a fleet every few days to multiple per day, and those fleets that did enter often lingered for a longer amount of time for an unknown reason."
units.italian: "Ma a partire dall'ultima settimana, il numero di navi della Marina che attraversano il sistema ha cominciato ad aumentare rapidamente. Siamo passati da una flotta ogni pochi giorni a più di una al giorno, e quelle flotte che entravano spesso restavano più a lungo per ragioni ignote."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	"Whatever we're capable of, they're capable of and then some," says JJ. "I wouldn't be surprised if they know about our sensors and are trying to use them against us."|1768|0
units.english: "Whatever we're capable of, they're capable of and then some," says JJ. "I wouldn't be surprised if they know about our sensors and are trying to use them against us."
units.italian: "Qualunque cosa siamo capaci di fare noi, loro sono capaci di farla e anche di più," dice JJ. "Non mi sorprenderebbe se sapessero dei nostri sensori e stessero cercando di usarli contro di noi."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	"Captain <last> discovered a Navy Gunboat planting sensors of their own onto Hope when we installed ours," JJ says. "Surely they suspect that we have some as well."|1772|0
units.english: "Captain <last> discovered a Navy Gunboat planting sensors of their own onto Hope when we installed ours," JJ says. "Surely they suspect that we have some as well."
units.italian: "Il Capitano <last> ha scoperto una cannoniera della Marina che installava sensori propri su Hope quando abbiamo installato i nostri," dice JJ. "Di sicuro sospettano che ne abbiamo anche noi."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	"They're trying to bait us," Tomek says. "Or they're distracting us."|1774|0
units.english: "They're trying to bait us," Tomek says. "Or they're distracting us."
units.italian: "Ci stanno provocando," dice Tomek. "O ci stanno distraendo."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	"Distracting us from what?" Alondo asks.|1775|0
units.english: "Distracting us from what?" Alondo asks.
units.italian: "Distraendo da che cosa?" chiede Alondo.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	Tomek thinks for a moment. "Have any of the eastern patrols returned yet?"|1776|0
units.english: Tomek thinks for a moment. "Have any of the eastern patrols returned yet?"
units.italian: Tomek riflette un momento. "Qualcuna delle pattuglie orientali è già rientrata?"

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	"None," says an officer. "Most of our patrols have been sticking close to Tarazed to stay out of reach of the Navy. It'll take a few more days for them to begin arriving."|1777|0
units.english: "None," says an officer. "Most of our patrols have been sticking close to Tarazed to stay out of reach of the Navy. It'll take a few more days for them to begin arriving."
units.italian: "Nessuna," dice un ufficiale. "La maggior parte delle nostre pattuglie è rimasta vicino a Tarazed per restare fuori portata della Marina. Ci vorranno ancora qualche giorno perché comincino ad arrivare."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	"We could sure use those ships that were lost attacking Greenrock," Freya snips.|1781|0
units.english: "We could sure use those ships that were lost attacking Greenrock," Freya snips.
units.italian: "Ci farebbero proprio comodo quelle navi perse attaccando Greenrock," sibila Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|label|1784|0
units.english: no casualties
units.italian: no casualties

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	"Pulling our fleets out of position to attack Greenrock sure helped our patrol schedule," Freya snips.|1785|0
units.english: "Pulling our fleets out of position to attack Greenrock sure helped our patrol schedule," Freya snips.
units.italian: "Tirare fuori le nostre flotte dalla posizione per attaccare Greenrock ha proprio aiutato il nostro programma di pattugliamento," sibila Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 1|	Tomek ignores her. "Alright, Captain <last>, I want you to scout <waypoints>. Simply enter the systems, look at what forces the Navy has there, then leave as soon as possible. We need to know what we're up against, if the Navy truly are moving to attack from Wei. If it turns out this is a distraction, hopefully we'll have intel from the returning patrol fleets by then."|1788|0
units.english: Tomek ignores her. "Alright, Captain <last>, I want you to scout <waypoints>. Simply enter the systems, look at what forces the Navy has there, then leave as soon as possible. We need to know what we're up against, if the Navy truly are moving to attack from Wei. If it turns out this is a distraction, hopefully we'll have intel from the returning patrol fleets by then."
units.italian: Tomek la ignora. "Va bene, Capitano <last>, voglio che esplori <waypoints>. Entra nei sistemi, guarda che forze ha la Marina, poi vattene il prima possibile. Dobbiamo sapere contro che cosa stiamo andando, se la Marina si sta davvero muovendo per attaccare da Wei. Se si scopre che è una distrazione, sperabilmente a quel punto avremo informazioni dalle flotte di pattuglia che rientrano."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|name|1853|0
units.english: Seeking Harmony
units.italian: Alla ricerca di Harmony

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|description|1854|0
units.english: <planet> has become an unofficial ceasefire zone for the Navy and Free Worlds patrols in the eastern Dirt Belt. Bring JJ there to attempt to negotiate with the Navy to prevent an attack.
units.italian: <planet> è diventata una zona di cessate il fuoco non ufficiale per le pattuglie della Marina e delle Free Worlds nella Fascia di Terra orientale. Porta lì JJ per tentare di negoziare con la Marina e impedire un attacco.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|blocked|1858|0
units.english: JJ contacts you and says, "Captain, you're going to need a bunk free for me. Do you have space?" You do not, so you should complete or abort another mission to make room for him, then return here.
units.italian: JJ ti contatta e dice: "Capitano, avrai bisogno di una cuccetta libera per me. Hai spazio?" Non ne hai, quindi dovresti completare o interrompere un'altra missione per fargli posto, poi tornare qui.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|When you return, you find Tomek and JJ speaking with captains of the eastern patrols. The rest of the Council has been moved off-world in case the Navy retakes Kornephoros.|1865|0
units.english: When you return, you find Tomek and JJ speaking with captains of the eastern patrols. The rest of the Council has been moved off-world in case the Navy retakes Kornephoros.
units.italian: Quando torni, trovi Tomek e JJ che parlano con i capitani delle pattuglie orientali. Il resto del Consiglio è stato allontanato dal pianeta nel caso la Marina riprenda Kornephoros.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"Welcome back, Captain," says Tomek. "I pray that your scouting mission went well."|1866|0
units.english: "Welcome back, Captain," says Tomek. "I pray that your scouting mission went well."
units.italian: "Bentornato, Capitano," dice Tomek. "Spero che la tua missione di ricognizione sia andata bene."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"Yes. The Navy didn't give me too much trouble passing through their systems."|1868|0
units.english: "Yes. The Navy didn't give me too much trouble passing through their systems."
units.italian: "Sì. La Marina non mi ha dato troppo fastidio attraversando i loro sistemi."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"The Navy gave me some difficulty, but I was able to pull through."|1869|0
units.english: "The Navy gave me some difficulty, but I was able to pull through."
units.italian: "La Marina mi ha dato qualche difficoltà, ma sono riuscito a cavarmela."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	You recall the strength of the Navy fleets to Tomek and JJ, mentioning the small fleets in Wei as well as the larger fleets in Alioth, Alphecca, and Seginus. "I also spotted a few Protectors in Navy colors," you add. "They were a part of the Navy fleets."|1870|0
units.english: You recall the strength of the Navy fleets to Tomek and JJ, mentioning the small fleets in Wei as well as the larger fleets in Alioth, Alphecca, and Seginus. "I also spotted a few Protectors in Navy colors," you add. "They were a part of the Navy fleets."
units.italian: Riferisci a Tomek e JJ della forza delle flotte della Marina, menzionando le piccole flotte a Wei e le flotte più grandi ad Alioth, Alphecca e Seginus. "Ho anche avvistato qualche Protector con i colori della Marina," aggiungi. "Facevano parte delle flotte della Marina."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"I thought we had an agreement that the Syndicate would not act as mercenaries for the Republic," JJ says.|1871|0
units.english: "I thought we had an agreement that the Syndicate would not act as mercenaries for the Republic," JJ says.
units.italian: "Pensavo avessimo un accordo sul fatto che il Sindacato non avrebbe agito come mercenario per la Repubblica," dice JJ.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"They never said anything about selling supplies to the Republic," says Tomek. "They're doing the same for us, after all."|1872|0
units.english: "They never said anything about selling supplies to the Republic," says Tomek. "They're doing the same for us, after all."
units.italian: "Non hanno mai detto niente sulla vendita di forniture alla Repubblica," dice Tomek. "Dopotutto fanno la stessa cosa per noi."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"What's our next move?"|1874|0
units.english: "What's our next move?"
units.italian: "Qual è la nostra prossima mossa?"

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"Have we learned anything from the patrols?"|1875|0
units.english: "Have we learned anything from the patrols?"
units.italian: "Abbiamo imparato qualcosa dalle pattuglie?"

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"The patrols tell us that the Navy presence to the east dropped recently," says Tomek. "Most of them are still there, but it was a big enough drop for our patrols to notice."|1876|0
units.english: "The patrols tell us that the Navy presence to the east dropped recently," says Tomek. "Most of them are still there, but it was a big enough drop for our patrols to notice."
units.italian: "Le pattuglie ci dicono che la presenza della Marina a est è calata di recente," dice Tomek. "La maggior parte è ancora là, ma il calo è stato abbastanza grande da essere notato dalle nostre pattuglie."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"Apparently the Navy patrols and militia patrols in the eastern Dirt Belt are on friendly terms," says JJ. "No information sharing, of course, but they're not shooting at one another. Neither side has found it advantageous to attack the other; Navy patrols outgun ours and so our patrols don't provoke them, but if the Navy patrols drew our attention then they'd be easily cut off. Given that, we've been able to keep accurate head counts of each other in the east."|1877|0
units.english: "Apparently the Navy patrols and militia patrols in the eastern Dirt Belt are on friendly terms," says JJ. "No information sharing, of course, but they're not shooting at one another. Neither side has found it advantageous to attack the other; Navy patrols outgun ours and so our patrols don't provoke them, but if the Navy patrols drew our attention then they'd be easily cut off. Given that, we've been able to keep accurate head counts of each other in the east."
units.italian: "A quanto pare le pattuglie della Marina e quelle della milizia nella Fascia di Terra orientale sono in rapporti amichevoli," dice JJ. "Nessuno scambio di informazioni, naturalmente, ma non si sparano addosso. Nessuna delle due parti ha trovato vantaggioso attaccare l'altra: le pattuglie della Marina sono più armate delle nostre, quindi le nostre non le provocano, ma se le pattuglie della Marina attirassero la nostra attenzione potrebbero essere facilmente tagliate fuori. Così facendo, siamo riusciti a tenere un conteggio accurato delle rispettive presenze a est."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"Which means they'll have noticed our own drop in presence there," says Tomek. "They know that we know that they're making moves to our north. Hopefully baiting us into recalling our patrols wasn't a part of their plan."|1878|0
units.english: "Which means they'll have noticed our own drop in presence there," says Tomek. "They know that we know that they're making moves to our north. Hopefully baiting us into recalling our patrols wasn't a part of their plan."
units.italian: "Il che significa che avranno notato anche il nostro calo di presenza là," dice Tomek. "Sanno che noi sappiamo che si stanno muovendo a nord di noi. Speriamo che attirarci a richiamare le pattuglie non facesse parte del loro piano."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"Well if our patrols are already friendly, perhaps we can talk ourselves out of another battle," says JJ.|1879|0
units.english: "Well if our patrols are already friendly, perhaps we can talk ourselves out of another battle," says JJ.
units.italian: "Beh, se le nostre pattuglie sono già amichevoli, forse possiamo convincerli a evitare un'altra battaglia," dice JJ.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"<planet> has become something of a neutral zone," one of the militia officers jumps in, presumably one from the eastern patrols. "Navy and militia patrols pass each other by in the spaceport without incident. People from the Republic and Free Worlds who know each other meet there often. We could arrange a meeting there."|1880|0
units.english: "<planet> has become something of a neutral zone," one of the militia officers jumps in, presumably one from the eastern patrols. "Navy and militia patrols pass each other by in the spaceport without incident. People from the Republic and Free Worlds who know each other meet there often. We could arrange a meeting there."
units.italian: "<planet> è diventata una specie di zona neutrale," interviene uno degli ufficiali della milizia, presumibilmente uno delle pattuglie orientali. "Le pattuglie della Marina e della milizia si incrociano nello spazioporto senza incidenti. Gente della Repubblica e delle Free Worlds che si conosce si incontra lì spesso. Potremmo organizzare un incontro là."
