units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"I'll travel there to speak with the Navy. Captain <last> shall be my transport," says JJ. "Tomek shall remain here with the fleet." Tomek nods in agreement. "Meeting dismissed."|1881|0
units.english: "I'll travel there to speak with the Navy. Captain <last> shall be my transport," says JJ. "Tomek shall remain here with the fleet." Tomek nods in agreement. "Meeting dismissed."
units.italian: "Andrò io a parlare con la Marina. Il Capitano <last> sarà il mio trasporto," dice JJ. "Tomek resterà qui con la flotta." Tomek annuisce d'accordo. "Riunione aggiornata."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	After the officers shuffle out, just you, JJ, and Tomek remain. JJ tells you to wait outside. "I want to speak with Tomek in private for a moment."|1882|0
units.english: After the officers shuffle out, just you, JJ, and Tomek remain. JJ tells you to wait outside. "I want to speak with Tomek in private for a moment."
units.italian: Dopo che gli ufficiali se ne sono andati, restate solo tu, JJ e Tomek. JJ ti dice di aspettare fuori. "Voglio parlare con Tomek in privato un momento."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	You move outside the building and stand next to the doorway. From inside you can hear the mumbling of Tomek and JJ speaking. You could probably press your ear to the door to hear what's going on.|1883|0
units.english: You move outside the building and stand next to the doorway. From inside you can hear the mumbling of Tomek and JJ speaking. You could probably press your ear to the door to hear what's going on.
units.italian: Esci dall'edificio e ti fermi accanto alla porta. Da dentro senti il mormorio di Tomek e JJ che parlano. Potresti probabilmente premere l'orecchio sulla porta per sentire che cosa succede.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	(Step away so I don't hear anything.)|1885|0
units.english: (Step away so I don't hear anything.)
units.italian: (Allontanati per non sentire niente.)

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	(Eavesdrop on them.)|1887|0
units.english: (Eavesdrop on them.)
units.italian: (Metti l'orecchio alla porta.)

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"You will go peacefully to the Senate when this situation is handled, right, Tomek?" JJ asks.|1888|0
units.english: "You will go peacefully to the Senate when this situation is handled, right, Tomek?" JJ asks.
units.italian: "Andrai pacificamente al Senato quando questa situazione sarà risolta, vero, Tomek?" chiede JJ.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"I did what I had to, and I will not fight the punishment I receive," Tomek responds. "But it's up to you to not squander the opportunity I've provided us."|1889|0
units.english: "I did what I had to, and I will not fight the punishment I receive," Tomek responds. "But it's up to you to not squander the opportunity I've provided us."
units.italian: "Ho fatto quello che dovevo, e non combatterò la punizione che riceverò," risponde Tomek. "Ma sta a te non sprecare l'occasione che ci ho offerto."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"I'll do what I can," says JJ.|1890|0
units.english: "I'll do what I can," says JJ.
units.italian: "Farò quello che posso," dice JJ.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	You hear JJ walking toward the door and step away as to not be seen eavesdropping. He exits the building.|1891|0
units.english: You hear JJ walking toward the door and step away as to not be seen eavesdropping. He exits the building.
units.italian: Senti JJ avvicinarsi alla porta e ti allontani per non essere visto origliare. Esce dall'edificio.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	Once they are done speaking, JJ exits the building.|1894|0
units.english: Once they are done speaking, JJ exits the building.
units.italian: Quando hanno finito di parlare, JJ esce dall'edificio.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|	"Alright, let's move quickly," he says. "There's no telling when the Navy could attack. Chart a course for <destination>. I'll contact the Navy and arrange the meeting on our way there."|1896|0
units.english: "Alright, let's move quickly," he says. "There's no telling when the Navy could attack. Chart a course for <destination>. I'll contact the Navy and arrange the meeting on our way there."
units.italian: "Va bene, muoviamoci in fretta," dice. "Non si può sapere quando la Marina potrebbe attaccare. Traccia una rotta per <destination>. Contatterò la Marina e organizzerò l'incontro mentre andiamo."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 2|dialog|1900|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying JJ hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta JJ non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|name|1907|0
units.english: Harmony Lost
units.italian: Harmony perduta

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|description|1908|0
units.english: The peace talks with the Navy have broken down. Another battle seems inevitable. Return to <destination> with JJ to prepare.
units.italian: I colloqui di pace con la Marina sono falliti. Un'altra battaglia sembra inevitabile. Torna su <destination> con JJ per prepararti.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|log|1918|0
units.english: People
units.italian: People

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|When you arrive, you see that the local Navy and Free Worlds soldiers have already gathered in the spaceport, keeping their distance from one another. News of the meeting must have already spread through the ranks. You see some civilians continuing to go about their day, while others are standing around watching the soldiers, but even with all the soldiers and civilians, the streets feel empty; perhaps many of the civilians that would normally be here have sought out shelter in fear of violence.|1920|0
units.english: When you arrive, you see that the local Navy and Free Worlds soldiers have already gathered in the spaceport, keeping their distance from one another. News of the meeting must have already spread through the ranks. You see some civilians continuing to go about their day, while others are standing around watching the soldiers, but even with all the soldiers and civilians, the streets feel empty; perhaps many of the civilians that would normally be here have sought out shelter in fear of violence.
units.italian: Quando arrivi, vedi che i soldati della Marina e delle Free Worlds del posto si sono già radunati nello spazioporto, tenendosi a distanza gli uni dagli altri. La notizia dell'incontro deve essersi già sparsa fra i ranghi. Vedi alcuni civili che continuano la loro giornata, mentre altri stanno intorno a guardare i soldati, ma anche con tutti quei soldati e civili le strade sembrano vuote; forse molti dei civili che di solito sarebbero qui hanno cercato rifugio per paura della violenza.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	JJ speaks with a Navy officer, asking him who he'll be meeting to negotiate with. "Commander Ranulph Hines, sir." The officer responds, seeming to catch himself up on calling JJ "sir." JJ has a look of concern on his face, but you don't think it's because of the Navy officer calling him "sir."|1921|0
units.english: JJ speaks with a Navy officer, asking him who he'll be meeting to negotiate with. "Commander Ranulph Hines, sir." The officer responds, seeming to catch himself up on calling JJ "sir." JJ has a look of concern on his face, but you don't think it's because of the Navy officer calling him "sir."
units.italian: JJ parla con un ufficiale della Marina, chiedendogli con chi si incontrerà per negoziare. "Il comandante Ranulph Hines, signore." L'ufficiale risponde, sembrando correggersi sul fatto di aver chiamato JJ "signore". JJ ha un'espressione preoccupata, ma non credi che sia per l'ufficiale della Marina che lo ha chiamato "signore".

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	"Is something wrong?"|1923|0
units.english: "Is something wrong?"
units.italian: "Qualcosa non va?"

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	(Say nothing.)|1924|0
units.english: (Say nothing.)
units.italian: (Non dire niente.)

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	"Nothing," JJ responds, then pauses before saying, "I fear this won't end well."|1926|0
units.english: "Nothing," JJ responds, then pauses before saying, "I fear this won't end well."
units.italian: "Niente," risponde JJ, poi si ferma prima di dire: "Temo che non finirà bene."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	The officer directs you and JJ to an outdoor seating area of one of the spaceport's restaurants, where you find Commander Ranulph Hines finishing what looks like a plate of salmon. JJ sits down across from him.|1928|0
units.english: The officer directs you and JJ to an outdoor seating area of one of the spaceport's restaurants, where you find Commander Ranulph Hines finishing what looks like a plate of salmon. JJ sits down across from him.
units.italian: L'ufficiale ti indirizza con JJ verso la zona all'aperto di uno dei ristoranti dello spazioporto, dove trovi il comandante Ranulph Hines che finisce quello che sembra un piatto di salmone. JJ si siede di fronte a lui.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	"Lieutenant Commander Jean-Jacques Soleau, in the flesh before my very eyes," Hines says, wiping the edges of his mouth. "I never imagined I'd be seeing you again after you so unceremoniously left the Navy."|1929|0
units.english: "Lieutenant Commander Jean-Jacques Soleau, in the flesh before my very eyes," Hines says, wiping the edges of his mouth. "I never imagined I'd be seeing you again after you so unceremoniously left the Navy."
units.italian: "Tenente comandante Jean-Jacques Soleau, in carne e ossa davanti ai miei occhi," dice Hines, asciugandosi gli angoli della bocca. "Non avrei mai immaginato di rivederti, dopo che hai lasciato la Marina con tanta poca cerimonia."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	"I'm not here to discuss the past, Commander," JJ responds. "I'm here to prevent more bloodshed in this pointless war."|1930|0
units.english: "I'm not here to discuss the past, Commander," JJ responds. "I'm here to prevent more bloodshed in this pointless war."
units.italian: "Non sono qui per discutere del passato, comandante," risponde JJ. "Sono qui per impedire altro spargimento di sangue in questa guerra senza senso."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	"As am I, Soleau, as am I. Although I might ask, were the lives lost in your attacks on Geminus and Martini pointless, or were those necessary losses."|1931|0
units.english: "As am I, Soleau, as am I. Although I might ask, were the lives lost in your attacks on Geminus and Martini pointless, or were those necessary losses."
units.italian: "Lo sono anch'io, Soleau, lo sono anch'io. Anche se potrei chiedere: le vite perse nei vostri attacchi a Geminus e Martini sono state inutili, o sono state perdite necessarie?"

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	"The Free Worlds are not responsible for those bombings," says JJ, sounding somewhat shaken. "We maintain our innocence, and were seeking to uncover who was responsible before the Republic ordered the Navy to take Kornephoros from us."|1932|0
units.english: "The Free Worlds are not responsible for those bombings," says JJ, sounding somewhat shaken. "We maintain our innocence, and were seeking to uncover who was responsible before the Republic ordered the Navy to take Kornephoros from us."
units.italian: "Le Free Worlds non sono responsabili di quei bombardamenti," dice JJ, con la voce un po' scossa. "Sosteniamo la nostra innocenza, e stavamo cercando di scoprire chi fosse il responsabile prima che la Repubblica ordinasse alla Marina di toglierci Kornephoros."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	"There was no 'taking,' Soleau. Kornephoros is rightfully Republic territory. We were simply enacting a police action on one of our own worlds, and arresting the terrorists who-"|1933|0
units.english: "There was no 'taking,' Soleau. Kornephoros is rightfully Republic territory. We were simply enacting a police action on one of our own worlds, and arresting the terrorists who-"
units.italian: "Non c'è stato nessun 'togliere', Soleau. Kornephoros è legittimamente territorio della Repubblica. Stavamo semplicemente eseguendo un'azione di polizia su uno dei nostri mondi, arrestando i terroristi che..."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	"So did you only come here to insult me and the Free Worlds or are you here to discuss peace as I asked?" JJ says, cutting Hines off. "As I said, I'm here to prevent more bloodshed. The deaths of those on Geminus and Martini as well as those in Kornephoros and Sabik were enough already. Continued bloodshed will not satisfy either side in this war."|1934|0
units.english: "So did you only come here to insult me and the Free Worlds or are you here to discuss peace as I asked?" JJ says, cutting Hines off. "As I said, I'm here to prevent more bloodshed. The deaths of those on Geminus and Martini as well as those in Kornephoros and Sabik were enough already. Continued bloodshed will not satisfy either side in this war."
units.italian: "Quindi sei venuto qui solo per insultare me e le Free Worlds, o sei qui per discutere di pace come ho chiesto?" dice JJ, interrompendo Hines. "Come ho detto, sono qui per impedire altro spargimento di sangue. Le morti di quelli di Geminus e Martini e quelle di Kornephoros e Sabik sono già state abbastanza. Un ulteriore spargimento di sangue non soddisferà nessuna delle due parti in questa guerra."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	"Continued bloodshed like what occurred on Greenrock only days ago?" Hines quips. "I'm sure you are aware that the Navy cannot bring its full force upon the 'Free Worlds.' We have borders to patrol and piracy to tend to. You, on the other hand, have just shattered the biggest hub of piracy in the region, and I have no doubt that this has freed up many resources. It would appear to me that you yourselves are consolidating your forces for an offensive and further bloodshed despite your insistence to the opposite."|1935|0
units.english: "Continued bloodshed like what occurred on Greenrock only days ago?" Hines quips. "I'm sure you are aware that the Navy cannot bring its full force upon the 'Free Worlds.' We have borders to patrol and piracy to tend to. You, on the other hand, have just shattered the biggest hub of piracy in the region, and I have no doubt that this has freed up many resources. It would appear to me that you yourselves are consolidating your forces for an offensive and further bloodshed despite your insistence to the opposite."
units.italian: "Un ulteriore spargimento di sangue come quello che c'è stato su Greenrock solo pochi giorni fa?" ribatte Hines. "Sono sicuro che saprai che la Marina non può scatenare tutte le sue forze contro le 'Free Worlds'. Abbiamo confini da pattugliare e pirateria da gestire. Voi, invece, avete appena distrutto il più grande centro di pirateria della regione, e non ho dubbio che questo abbia liberato molte risorse. Mi sembra che siate voi a stare consolidando le forze per un'offensiva e per altro spargimento di sangue, nonostante insistiate sul contrario."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	"The actions that were taken on Greenrock were unsanctioned by the Free Worlds Senate or Council," JJ responds. "It was the result of rogue elements that have been taken care of."|1936|0
units.english: "The actions that were taken on Greenrock were unsanctioned by the Free Worlds Senate or Council," JJ responds. "It was the result of rogue elements that have been taken care of."
units.italian: "Le azioni intraprese su Greenrock non sono state autorizzate dal Senato né dal Consiglio delle Free Worlds," risponde JJ. "Sono state il risultato di elementi incontrollati di cui ci siamo già occupati."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	"Rogue elements within your ranks? You certainly have a history of those if it was a rogue element within your insurgency that committed the terrorist acts that took the lives of thousands of Republic citizens. At least, I presume it was a rogue element, as I've never known the venerable Jean-Jacques Soleau to be a liar, so I certainly believe you when you tell me that your 'Free Worlds' wouldn't do that. Although I'm sure you would have also told me that your 'Free Worlds' would never subjugate the population of Greenrock, either."|1937|0
units.english: "Rogue elements within your ranks? You certainly have a history of those if it was a rogue element within your insurgency that committed the terrorist acts that took the lives of thousands of Republic citizens. At least, I presume it was a rogue element, as I've never known the venerable Jean-Jacques Soleau to be a liar, so I certainly believe you when you tell me that your 'Free Worlds' wouldn't do that. Although I'm sure you would have also told me that your 'Free Worlds' would never subjugate the population of Greenrock, either."
units.italian: "Elementi incontrollati nei vostri ranghi? Avete certo una storia di questi elementi, se è stato un elemento incontrollato della vostra insurrezione a commettere gli atti terroristici che hanno ucciso migliaia di cittadini della Repubblica. O almeno, presumo che fosse un elemento incontrollato, dato che non ho mai conosciuto il venerabile Jean-Jacques Soleau come un bugiardo, quindi ti credo certamente quando mi dici che le tue 'Free Worlds' non farebbero una cosa del genere. Anche se sono sicuro che mi avresti detto anche che le tue 'Free Worlds' non avrebbero mai soggiogato la popolazione di Greenrock."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	"This guy doesn't seem too interested in peace talks. We should go."|1939|0
units.english: "This guy doesn't seem too interested in peace talks. We should go."
units.italian: "Questo tizio non sembra troppo interessato ai colloqui di pace. Dovremmo andarcene."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	(Let JJ handle the situation.)|1940|0
units.english: (Let JJ handle the situation.)
units.italian: (Lascia che JJ gestisca la situazione.)

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	You whisper your concerns to JJ. "No," he responds. "I can handle this."|1942|0
units.english: You whisper your concerns to JJ. "No," he responds. "I can handle this."
units.italian: Gli sussurri le tue preoccupazioni a JJ. "No," risponde. "Posso gestirla io."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	"So it would seem that the answer to my question is no," JJ says, raising his voice. "You're not interested in peace talks."|1944|0
units.english: "So it would seem that the answer to my question is no," JJ says, raising his voice. "You're not interested in peace talks."
units.italian: "Quindi sembra che la risposta alla mia domanda sia no," dice JJ, alzando la voce. "Non sei interessato ai colloqui di pace."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	"I am afraid so, Soleau. The Republic does not wish to lower itself to negotiating with terrorists. As such, I am ordering the arrest of you and every captain and crew member of the so-called 'Free Worlds' here for acts of terrorism and treason against the Republic."|1945|0
units.english: "I am afraid so, Soleau. The Republic does not wish to lower itself to negotiating with terrorists. As such, I am ordering the arrest of you and every captain and crew member of the so-called 'Free Worlds' here for acts of terrorism and treason against the Republic."
units.italian: "Temo di no, Soleau. La Repubblica non desidera abbassarsi a negoziare con i terroristi. Pertanto ordino l'arresto tuo e di ogni capitano e membro dell'equipaggio delle cosiddette 'Free Worlds' qui presenti, per atti di terrorismo e tradimento contro la Repubblica."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	Some of the militia watching begin to reach for their weapons or move away as some Navy soldiers step forward, but JJ raises his hand to motion them to stop. The militia notice and hold their ground, as do the Navy soldiers. "Where is the Navy honor that we've all heard so much about?" JJ shouts loud enough for everyone watching to hear. "We come here with open arms asking for peace talks and you move to arrest us?" You hear jeers coming from some of the civilians watching.|1946|0
units.english: Some of the militia watching begin to reach for their weapons or move away as some Navy soldiers step forward, but JJ raises his hand to motion them to stop. The militia notice and hold their ground, as do the Navy soldiers. "Where is the Navy honor that we've all heard so much about?" JJ shouts loud enough for everyone watching to hear. "We come here with open arms asking for peace talks and you move to arrest us?" You hear jeers coming from some of the civilians watching.
units.italian: Alcune delle milizie che assistono cominciano ad allungare le mani verso le armi o ad allontanarsi mentre alcuni soldati della Marina fanno un passo avanti, ma JJ alza la mano per farli fermare. I miliziani se ne accorgono e tengono la posizione, e così i soldati della Marina. "Dov'è finito l'onore della Marina di cui abbiamo tanto sentito parlare?" grida JJ, abbastanza forte perché tutti quelli che guardano lo sentano. "Veniamo qui a braccia aperte chiedendo colloqui di pace e voi vi muovete per arrestarci?" Senti dei fischi da alcuni dei civili che guardano.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	Hines turns up his nose. "This is undoubtedly Republic territory you're standing on, Soleau, and therefore we have every right to arrest you."|1947|0
units.english: Hines turns up his nose. "This is undoubtedly Republic territory you're standing on, Soleau, and therefore we have every right to arrest you."
units.italian: Hines arriccia il naso. "Questo è senza dubbio territorio della Repubblica, Soleau, e quindi abbiamo tutto il diritto di arrestarti."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	"I think your men disagree," JJ remarks. All of the Navy personnel have either remained in or returned to formation. "Remember that I myself was a part of the Navy once. A Navy that each and every one of your honored men surely remember, either because they lived it or because they grew up revering it. But a Navy that I left because of those like you. I'm sorry to disappoint you, but if we can't negotiate peace talks then we'll be leaving. I pray that you'll be wise enough to see the error in your ways and let us go." JJ stands up and begins walking off, leaving Hines to sulk in his chair.|1948|0
units.english: "I think your men disagree," JJ remarks. All of the Navy personnel have either remained in or returned to formation. "Remember that I myself was a part of the Navy once. A Navy that each and every one of your honored men surely remember, either because they lived it or because they grew up revering it. But a Navy that I left because of those like you. I'm sorry to disappoint you, but if we can't negotiate peace talks then we'll be leaving. I pray that you'll be wise enough to see the error in your ways and let us go." JJ stands up and begins walking off, leaving Hines to sulk in his chair.
units.italian: "Credo che i tuoi uomini non siano d'accordo," osserva JJ. Tutto il personale della Marina è rimasto o è tornato in formazione. "Ricorda che anch'io facevo parte della Marina. Una Marina che ognuno dei tuoi onorevoli uomini ricorda certamente, o perché l'ha vissuta o perché è cresciuto rispettandola. Ma una Marina che ho lasciato per colpa di gente come te. Mi dispiace deluderti, ma se non possiamo negoziare colloqui di pace, ce ne andremo. Prego che tu sia abbastanza saggio da vedere l'errore delle tue vie e lasciarci andare." JJ si alza e comincia ad allontanarsi, lasciando Hines a rimuginare sulla sedia.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	"Your days are numbered, Soleau," Hines shouts, but he remains in his chair and gives no orders to his soldiers.|1949|0
units.english: "Your days are numbered, Soleau," Hines shouts, but he remains in his chair and gives no orders to his soldiers.
units.italian: "I tuoi giorni sono contati, Soleau," grida Hines, ma resta sulla sedia e non dà ordini ai suoi soldati.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|	The Navy allows you to leave unmolested as you enter your ship with JJ. "Launch your ship immediately and return to <planet>," he says. "The only thing that rivals honor among the Navy is duty, and I don't want to be around when Hines starts whipping his men into his shape."|1950|0
units.english: The Navy allows you to leave unmolested as you enter your ship with JJ. "Launch your ship immediately and return to <planet>," he says. "The only thing that rivals honor among the Navy is duty, and I don't want to be around when Hines starts whipping his men into his shape."
units.italian: La Marina vi lascia andare indisturbati mentre entri nella nave con JJ. "Decolla subito e torna su <planet>," dice. "L'unica cosa che nella Marina rivaleggia con l'onore è il dovere, e non voglio essere nei paraggi quando Hines comincia a fomentare i suoi uomini a sua immagine."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|dialog|1954|0
units.english: Upon entering <system>, you spot Free Worlds ships in combat with the Navy. It looks like the Navy only sent a small force so far; there are only a few ships remaining and there don't appear to be many destroyed ships. Regardless, the Free Worlds captains defending the system would probably appreciate help clearing out the rest before you land.
units.italian: Entrando nel sistema <system>, avvisti navi delle Free Worlds in combattimento con la Marina. Sembra che la Marina abbia mandato finora solo una piccola forza; restano poche navi e non sembrano esserci molte navi distrutte. In ogni caso, i capitani delle Free Worlds che difendono il sistema apprezzeranno probabilmente un aiuto a ripulire il resto prima che atterri.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 3|dialog|2001|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but you haven't yet completed all the objectives. Either there are still Navy ships in the system, or one of your ships carrying JJ is not yet in the system.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora completato tutti gli obiettivi. O ci sono ancora navi della Marina nel sistema, o una delle tue navi che porta JJ non è ancora nel sistema.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 4|name|2007|0
units.english: Preemptive Strike
units.italian: Attacco preventivo

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 4|description|2008|0
units.english: Meet the Navy ships for battle in <system>, attacking them before they can enter Free Worlds space. Once all the ships have been destroyed, land on <planet>.
units.italian: Incontra le navi della Marina in battaglia a <system>, attaccandole prima che possano entrare nello spazio delle Free Worlds. Una volta distrutte tutte le navi, atterra su <planet>.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 4|When you return, Tomek is busy preparing the fleet. It looks like most of the ships are ready to go, with some already starting their engines. "I take it the peace talks didn't work out," he says.|2019|0
units.english: When you return, Tomek is busy preparing the fleet. It looks like most of the ships are ready to go, with some already starting their engines. "I take it the peace talks didn't work out," he says.
units.italian: Quando torni, Tomek è impegnato a preparare la flotta. Sembra che la maggior parte delle navi sia pronta a partire, e alcune stanno già accendendo i motori. "Immagino che i colloqui di pace non siano andati bene," dice.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 4|	"Not quite," says JJ. "Although I think we won a small victory in another way."|2020|0
units.english: "Not quite," says JJ. "Although I think we won a small victory in another way."
units.italian: "Non proprio," dice JJ. "Anche se penso che abbiamo vinto una piccola vittoria in un altro senso."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 4|	"You'll have to tell me later," Tomek says, beginning to shout as ships around you begin to take off. "Captain <last>, get your ship ready for the air. Our sensors tell us there's a massive Navy fleet in <system>. They could jump in here any hour now. I've ordered a preemptive strike; we're going to rush into <system> and take them head on before they can reach our territory. Detain any surviving Navy personnel on <planet> and we'll send in transports to either ferry them back to the Republic if they agree to join the Oathkeepers, or to Bourne if they refuse. Now get going. We have no time to waste."|2021|0
units.english: "You'll have to tell me later," Tomek says, beginning to shout as ships around you begin to take off. "Captain <last>, get your ship ready for the air. Our sensors tell us there's a massive Navy fleet in <system>. They could jump in here any hour now. I've ordered a preemptive strike; we're going to rush into <system> and take them head on before they can reach our territory. Detain any surviving Navy personnel on <planet> and we'll send in transports to either ferry them back to the Republic if they agree to join the Oathkeepers, or to Bourne if they refuse. Now get going. We have no time to waste."
units.italian: "Me lo racconterai più tardi," dice Tomek, cominciando a gridare mentre le navi intorno a voi cominciano a decollare. "Capitano <last>, prepara la nave al decollo. I nostri sensori ci dicono che c'è una flotta enorme della Marina a <system>. Potrebbero saltare qui da un'ora all'altra. Ho ordinato un attacco preventivo: ci precipiteremo a <system> e li prenderemo di petto prima che possano raggiungere il nostro territorio. Trattieni il personale della Marina sopravvissuto su <planet> e manderemo dei trasporti per riportarli alla Repubblica se accettano di unirsi agli Oathkeepers, o a Bourne se rifiutano. Ora muoviti. Non abbiamo tempo da perdere."

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 4|dialog|2103|0
units.english: There are still Navy ships overhead. Staying on <planet> while your allies are dying in orbit would be a very bad idea.
units.italian: Ci sono ancora navi della Marina là sopra. Restare su <planet> mentre i tuoi alleati muoiono in orbita sarebbe un'idea pessima.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 4|dialog|2106|0
units.english: Although the battle is won, the mood is somber, just as with the first battles of the war. You help the militia tend to the wounded on both sides, caring for the Navy survivors, even on this harsh snowy planet. Within the hour, Free Worlds troop transports arrive to pick them up. As the transports take off, you receive a message from Freya calling you back to Longjump.
units.italian: Anche se la battaglia è vinta, l'umore è cupo, come nelle prime battaglie della guerra. Aiuti la milizia a curare i feriti di entrambe le parti, prendendoti cura dei sopravvissuti della Marina, anche su questo pianeta freddo e nevoso. Nel giro di un'ora arrivano i trasporti di truppe delle Free Worlds a prelevarli. Mentre i trasporti decollano, ricevi un messaggio di Freya che ti richiama a Longjump.

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 5|name|2127|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Early Warning 5|description|2128|0
units.english: With the battle won, return to <destination> to report to Freya.
units.italian: Con la battaglia vinta, torna su <destination> per riferire a Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|name|2141|0
units.english: Senate Hearing
units.italian: Udienza al Senato

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|description|2142|0
units.english: Report to <destination> for a Senate hearing on your recent failure to obey their orders. If you do not arrive by <date>, your service will be terminated.
units.italian: Presentati su <destination> per un'udienza del Senato sul tuo recente rifiuto di obbedire ai loro ordini. Se non arrivi entro il <date>, il tuo servizio sarà terminato.

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|JJ and Freya meet you soon after you land on <origin>. "Great work in the battle, Captain," Freya says. "Unfortunately, we can't delay the outcome of your attack on Greenrock any longer."|2155|0
units.english: JJ and Freya meet you soon after you land on <origin>. "Great work in the battle, Captain," Freya says. "Unfortunately, we can't delay the outcome of your attack on Greenrock any longer."
units.italian: JJ e Freya ti incontrano poco dopo che atterri su <origin>. "Ottimo lavoro nella battaglia, Capitano," dice Freya. "Purtroppo non possiamo più rimandare l'esito del tuo attacco a Greenrock."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	JJ says, "You have been suspended from your service to the Free Worlds by order of the Free Worlds Council, and are commanded to report to <planet> for a Senate hearing within the next two weeks. There, the Senate will decide your fate. If you do not report for your hearing, your service will be terminated."|2156|0
units.english: JJ says, "You have been suspended from your service to the Free Worlds by order of the Free Worlds Council, and are commanded to report to <planet> for a Senate hearing within the next two weeks. There, the Senate will decide your fate. If you do not report for your hearing, your service will be terminated."
units.italian: JJ dice: "Sei stato sospeso dal tuo servizio alle Free Worlds per ordine del Consiglio delle Free Worlds, e hai il comando di presentarti su <planet> per un'udienza del Senato entro le prossime due settimane. Lì il Senato deciderà il tuo destino. Se non ti presenterai all'udienza, il tuo servizio sarà terminato."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"It's been an honor serving with you."|2158|0
units.english: "It's been an honor serving with you."
units.italian: "È stato un onore servire con voi."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"What's happened to Tomek?"|2159|0
units.english: "What's happened to Tomek?"
units.italian: "Che cosa è successo a Tomek?"

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"You've been a good soldier," JJ says. "May you return to us in time. Goodbye, Captain."|2161|0
units.english: "You've been a good soldier," JJ says. "May you return to us in time. Goodbye, Captain."
units.italian: "Sei stato un buon soldato," dice JJ. "Che tu possa tornare da noi in tempo. Addio, Capitano."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"Tomek is on his way to the Senate right now," Freya says. "He left as soon as the news of the victory arrived. I imagine his Senate hearing will have occurred by the time you reach <planet>." She pauses. "Goodbye, Captain."|2164|0
units.english: "Tomek is on his way to the Senate right now," Freya says. "He left as soon as the news of the victory arrived. I imagine his Senate hearing will have occurred by the time you reach <planet>." She pauses. "Goodbye, Captain."
units.italian: "Tomek è in viaggio verso il Senato proprio ora," dice Freya. "È partito appena è arrivata la notizia della vittoria. Immagino che la sua udienza al Senato sarà già avvenuta quando arriverai su <planet>." Si ferma. "Addio, Capitano."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|log|2171|0
units.english: Officially censured by the Free Worlds Senate for launching an attack on a pirate world rather than obeying their instructions to seek a diplomatic solution. It may be a while before any further work for the Free Worlds are available.
units.italian: Sei stato ufficialmente censurato dal Senato delle Free Worlds per aver lanciato un attacco a un mondo pirata invece di obbedire alle istruzioni di cercare una soluzione diplomatica. Potrebbe volerci un po' prima che sia disponibile altro lavoro per le Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|log|2172|0
units.english: Tomek was removed from the Council and placed under house arrest by the Senate after he disobeyed their orders and captured the pirate world of Greenrock rather than pursue the diplomatic solution that the Senate preferred.
units.italian: Tomek è stato rimosso dal Consiglio e posto agli arresti domiciliari dal Senato dopo aver disobbedito ai loro ordini e aver conquistato il mondo pirata di Greenrock invece di perseguire la soluzione diplomatica che il Senato preferiva.

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|With some trepidation, you enter the Senate building and introduce yourself to the receptionist. He says, "Please wait here. Someone will come for you when they are ready."|2174|0
units.english: With some trepidation, you enter the Senate building and introduce yourself to the receptionist. He says, "Please wait here. Someone will come for you when they are ready."
units.italian: Con una certa apprensione entri nell'edificio del Senato e ti presenti alla reception. L'uomo dice: "La prego di aspettare qui. Qualcuno verrà a chiamarla quando sarà pronto."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	Several hours pass. Finally, you are led into the Senate chamber, where several dozen senators sit, each with a name card identifying the world they represent. Senator Huygens of Mere asks the first question. "Captain <last>, is it true that you took part in a recent unauthorized attack on Greenrock in the Shaula system?"|2175|0
units.english: Several hours pass. Finally, you are led into the Senate chamber, where several dozen senators sit, each with a name card identifying the world they represent. Senator Huygens of Mere asks the first question. "Captain <last>, is it true that you took part in a recent unauthorized attack on Greenrock in the Shaula system?"
units.italian: Passano diverse ore. Alla fine vieni condotto nella camera del Senato, dove siedono alcune decine di senatori, ciascuno con un cartellino che identifica il mondo che rappresenta. La senatrice Huygens di Mere fa la prima domanda. "Capitano <last>, è vero che ha preso parte a un recente attacco non autorizzato a Greenrock, nel sistema Shaula?"

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"Yes, that is correct."|2177|0
units.english: "Yes, that is correct."
units.italian: "Sì, è corretto."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"I was following orders from Tomek, from the Council."|2179|0
units.english: "I was following orders from Tomek, from the Council."
units.italian: "Stavo seguendo gli ordini di Tomek, del Consiglio."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"I didn't ask what your excuse is," she says. "I asked whether you took part in the attack."|2180|0
units.english: "I didn't ask what your excuse is," she says. "I asked whether you took part in the attack."
units.italian: "Non ho chiesto quale sia la sua scusa," dice. "Ho chiesto se ha preso parte all'attacco."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"Yes, I did," you say.|2181|0
units.english: "Yes, I did," you say.
units.italian: "Sì, ho partecipato," dici.

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"Were you aware at the time that you were going against the orders of the Senate?"|2183|0
units.english: "Were you aware at the time that you were going against the orders of the Senate?"
units.italian: "Era consapevole, al momento, di andare contro gli ordini del Senato?"

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"Yes."|2185|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"No, I was led to believe that I was following the Senate's orders."|2187|0
units.english: "No, I was led to believe that I was following the Senate's orders."
units.italian: "No, mi era stato fatto credere che stessi seguendo gli ordini del Senato."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"Interesting," says Arianna. "That's not what Tomek told us. And JJ and Freya both said that you were well aware of the Senate's wishes."|2188|0
units.english: "Interesting," says Arianna. "That's not what Tomek told us. And JJ and Freya both said that you were well aware of the Senate's wishes."
units.italian: "Interessante," dice Arianna. "Non è quello che ci ha detto Tomek. E sia JJ sia Freya hanno detto che lei era ben consapevole dei desideri del Senato."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	One of the other senators, an older man, asks, "Why did you choose to take part in the attack?"|2190|0
units.english: One of the other senators, an older man, asks, "Why did you choose to take part in the attack?"
units.italian: Un altro senatore, un uomo anziano, chiede: "Perché ha scelto di prendere parte all'attacco?"

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"I wanted to do something to end the pirate threat."|2192|0
units.english: "I wanted to do something to end the pirate threat."
units.italian: "Volevo fare qualcosa per porre fine alla minaccia dei pirati."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"I trusted that Tomek would know the best strategy."|2193|0
units.english: "I trusted that Tomek would know the best strategy."
units.italian: "Mi fidavo del fatto che Tomek conoscesse la strategia migliore."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"I guess I got too caught up in trying to be a hero."|2194|0
units.english: "I guess I got too caught up in trying to be a hero."
units.italian: "Immagino di essermi fatto troppo prendere dal voler fare l'eroe."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"I knew my fleet could subdue the planet without suffering serious losses."|2196|0
units.english: "I knew my fleet could subdue the planet without suffering serious losses."
units.italian: "Sapevo che la mia flotta poteva soggiogare il pianeta senza subire gravi perdite."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"And how did that work out?" says the old man. "Shortly after your attack on Greenrock, the Navy made moves to invade us once again, a plan that was no doubt helped by your actions."|2203|0
units.english: "And how did that work out?" says the old man. "Shortly after your attack on Greenrock, the Navy made moves to invade us once again, a plan that was no doubt helped by your actions."
units.italian: "E come è andata?" dice l'anziano. "Poco dopo il suo attacco a Greenrock, la Marina si è mossa per invaderci ancora una volta, un piano a cui senza dubbio hanno contribuito le sue azioni."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"Indeed," says the senator. "And I bet it wasn't long after the battle that you realized saving the galaxy isn't that easy."|2206|0
units.english: "Indeed," says the senator. "And I bet it wasn't long after the battle that you realized saving the galaxy isn't that easy."
units.italian: "Esatto," dice il senatore. "E scommetto che non è passato molto dalla battaglia prima che lei si rendesse conto che salvare la galassia non è così facile."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"And yet the fleet did suffer losses," says the senator. "Not to mention that you took your ships, which are among the strongest in the whole of the Free Worlds, and tied them up an a meaningless battle that risked opening up an entirely new front of the war. Are you saying you did all of this without permission, without even considering the reasons the Free Worlds had decided not to launch an assault, just because you thought you could get away with it?"|2211|0
units.english: "And yet the fleet did suffer losses," says the senator. "Not to mention that you took your ships, which are among the strongest in the whole of the Free Worlds, and tied them up an a meaningless battle that risked opening up an entirely new front of the war. Are you saying you did all of this without permission, without even considering the reasons the Free Worlds had decided not to launch an assault, just because you thought you could get away with it?"
units.italian: "Eppure la flotta ha subito perdite," dice il senatore. "Senza contare che ha preso le sue navi, che sono fra le più forti di tutte le Free Worlds, e le ha impegnate in una battaglia senza senso che rischiava di aprire un fronte completamente nuovo della guerra. Sta dicendo di aver fatto tutto questo senza permesso, senza nemmeno considerare le ragioni per cui le Free Worlds avevano deciso di non lanciare un assalto, solo perché pensava di potersela cavare?"

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"Captain," replies the senator, "can't you realize this isn't about casualties? It doesn't matter that you managed the invasion flawlessly - we can all agree on that. What matters is that there wasn't supposed to be an invasion in the first place. Can't you see how your actions disrupted the Free Worlds' entire military and diplomatic strategy?"|2215|0
units.english: "Captain," replies the senator, "can't you realize this isn't about casualties? It doesn't matter that you managed the invasion flawlessly - we can all agree on that. What matters is that there wasn't supposed to be an invasion in the first place. Can't you see how your actions disrupted the Free Worlds' entire military and diplomatic strategy?"
units.italian: "Capitano," risponde il senatore, "non si rende conto che non si tratta di vittime? Non importa che lei abbia condotto l'invasione in modo impeccabile: su questo siamo tutti d'accordo. Quello che importa è che un'invasione non doveva esserci. Non vede come le sue azioni hanno sconvolto l'intera strategia militare e diplomatica delle Free Worlds?"

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"I suppose so," you admit.|2216|0
units.english: "I suppose so," you admit.
units.italian: "Suppongo di sì," ammetti.

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	A third senator speaks up, a woman whose name card identifies her as Sara, from Skymoot. "That will be all, Captain <last>. The Senate will confer and decide whether we want your continued services."|2217|0
units.english: A third senator speaks up, a woman whose name card identifies her as Sara, from Skymoot. "That will be all, Captain <last>. The Senate will confer and decide whether we want your continued services."
units.italian: Interviene un terzo senatore, una donna il cui cartellino la identifica come Sara, di Skymoot. "È tutto, Capitano <last>. Il Senato si riunirà e deciderà se vogliamo i suoi servizi ancora."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	You are led back out to the lobby, where you wait for what feels like another hour. During that time, you speak with someone else and learn that Tomek has been removed from the Council and put under house arrest. Although interestingly, despite Tomek disobeying orders, the Senate has decided to continue the occupation of Greenrock, at least for now, because leaving the planet so quickly would only foment greater chaos in the region.|2218|0
units.english: You are led back out to the lobby, where you wait for what feels like another hour. During that time, you speak with someone else and learn that Tomek has been removed from the Council and put under house arrest. Although interestingly, despite Tomek disobeying orders, the Senate has decided to continue the occupation of Greenrock, at least for now, because leaving the planet so quickly would only foment greater chaos in the region.
units.italian: Vieni riportato nella sala d'attesa, dove aspetti per quella che sembra un'altra ora. Durante quel tempo parli con qualcun altro e scopri che Tomek è stato rimosso dal Consiglio e posto agli arresti domiciliari. Curiosamente, però, nonostante Tomek abbia disobbedito agli ordini, il Senato ha deciso di continuare l'occupazione di Greenrock, almeno per ora, perché lasciare il pianeta così in fretta non farebbe che fomentare maggiore caos nella regione.

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	Finally, a messenger comes and hands you a small slip of paper. You open it. The message reads: "We have decided that you will be suspended without pay and stripped of your rank. When we are in need of your services again, we will contact you, and your rank will be reinstated as the Senate or Council sees fit." It looks like for now, you are back to being a simple merchant captain.|2219|0
units.english: Finally, a messenger comes and hands you a small slip of paper. You open it. The message reads: "We have decided that you will be suspended without pay and stripped of your rank. When we are in need of your services again, we will contact you, and your rank will be reinstated as the Senate or Council sees fit." It looks like for now, you are back to being a simple merchant captain.
units.italian: Alla fine arriva un messaggero e ti consegna un piccolo foglietto. Lo apri. Il messaggio dice: "Abbiamo deciso che sarai sospeso senza stipendio e privato del tuo grado. Quando avremo di nuovo bisogno dei tuoi servizi, ti contatteremo, e il tuo grado sarà reintegrato come il Senato o il Consiglio riterranno opportuno." Sembra che per ora tu sia tornato a essere un semplice capitano mercantile.

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	"I suppose so," you admit.|2223|0
units.english: "I suppose so," you admit.
units.italian: "Suppongo di sì," ammetti.

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	A third senator speaks up, a woman whose name card identifies her as Sara, from Skymoot. "That will be all, Captain <last>. The Senate will confer and decide whether we want your continued services."|2224|0
units.english: A third senator speaks up, a woman whose name card identifies her as Sara, from Skymoot. "That will be all, Captain <last>. The Senate will confer and decide whether we want your continued services."
units.italian: Interviene un terzo senatore, una donna il cui cartellino la identifica come Sara, di Skymoot. "È tutto, Capitano <last>. Il Senato si riunirà e deciderà se vogliamo i suoi servizi ancora."

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	You are led back out to the lobby, where you wait for what feels like another hour. During that time, you speak with someone else and learn that Tomek has been removed from the Council and put under house arrest. Although interestingly, despite Tomek disobeying orders, the Senate has decided to continue the occupation of Greenrock, at least for now, because it would "dishonor those who lost their lives doing what they believed to be right" to leave the planet so quickly.|2225|0
units.english: You are led back out to the lobby, where you wait for what feels like another hour. During that time, you speak with someone else and learn that Tomek has been removed from the Council and put under house arrest. Although interestingly, despite Tomek disobeying orders, the Senate has decided to continue the occupation of Greenrock, at least for now, because it would "dishonor those who lost their lives doing what they believed to be right" to leave the planet so quickly.
units.italian: Vieni riportato nella sala d'attesa, dove aspetti per quella che sembra un'altra ora. Durante quel tempo parli con qualcun altro e scopri che Tomek è stato rimosso dal Consiglio e posto agli arresti domiciliari. Curiosamente, però, nonostante Tomek abbia disobbedito agli ordini, il Senato ha deciso di continuare l'occupazione di Greenrock, almeno per ora, perché lasciare il pianeta così in fretta "disonorerebbe quelli che hanno perso la vita facendo quello che credevano giusto".

units.id: mission:FW Senate Hearing|	Finally, a messenger comes and hands you a small slip of paper. You open it. The message reads: "We have decided that you will be suspended without pay and stripped of your rank. When we are in need of your services again, we will contact you, and your rank will be reinstated as the Senate or Council sees fit." It looks like for now, you are back to being a simple merchant captain.|2226|0
units.english: Finally, a messenger comes and hands you a small slip of paper. You open it. The message reads: "We have decided that you will be suspended without pay and stripped of your rank. When we are in need of your services again, we will contact you, and your rank will be reinstated as the Senate or Council sees fit." It looks like for now, you are back to being a simple merchant captain.
units.italian: Alla fine arriva un messaggero e ti consegna un piccolo foglietto. Lo apri. Il messaggio dice: "Abbiamo deciso che sarai sospeso senza stipendio e privato del tuo grado. Quando avremo di nuovo bisogno dei tuoi servizi, ti contatteremo, e il tuo grado sarà reintegrato come il Senato o il Consiglio riterranno opportuno." Sembra che per ora tu sia tornato a essere un semplice capitano mercantile.

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|name|2239|0
units.english: Smuggler's Den Repairs
units.italian: Riparazioni a Smuggler's Den

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|description|2240|0
units.english: Travel to <planet> and pick up a shipment of equipment from the Syndicate for repairing the refinery on Smuggler's Den.
units.italian: Va' su <planet> e ritira una spedizione di equipaggiamento dal Sindacato per riparare la raffineria su Smuggler's Den.

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|JJ and Freya meet you soon after you land on <origin>. "Great work in the battle, Captain," Freya says. "Unfortunately, we now need to turn our attention to cleaning up Tomek's mess."|2252|0
units.english: JJ and Freya meet you soon after you land on <origin>. "Great work in the battle, Captain," Freya says. "Unfortunately, we now need to turn our attention to cleaning up Tomek's mess."
units.italian: JJ e Freya ti incontrano poco dopo che atterri su <origin>. "Ottimo lavoro nella battaglia, Capitano," dice Freya. "Purtroppo ora dobbiamo occuparci di ripulire il pasticcio di Tomek."

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|	"The people of Thule became wary of our deal with them after Tomek's attack on Greenrock," JJ explains. "They feared that they would be next, and that our negotiations with them were just an attempt to get them to distance themselves from what would be their main line of defense."|2253|0
units.english: "The people of Thule became wary of our deal with them after Tomek's attack on Greenrock," JJ explains. "They feared that they would be next, and that our negotiations with them were just an attempt to get them to distance themselves from what would be their main line of defense."
units.italian: "La gente di Thule è diventata diffidente verso il nostro accordo dopo l'attacco di Tomek a Greenrock," spiega JJ. "Temevano di essere i prossimi, e che le nostre trattative con loro fossero solo un tentativo di allontanarli da quella che sarebbe stata la loro principale linea di difesa."

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|	"We have to show them that our offer was genuine," Freya says.|2254|0
units.english: "We have to show them that our offer was genuine," Freya says.
units.italian: "Dobbiamo dimostrare loro che la nostra offerta era sincera," dice Freya.

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|	"How are we going to do that?"|2256|0
units.english: "How are we going to do that?"
units.italian: "E come facciamo a farlo?"

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|	"So what happens to Tomek now?"|2258|0
units.english: "So what happens to Tomek now?"
units.italian: "E che cosa succede a Tomek, adesso?"

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|	"Tomek is on his way to Bourne right now," Freya says. "He left as soon as the news of the victory arrived. I imagine we'll know the outcome of his Senate hearing once you've returned from your mission."|2259|0
units.english: "Tomek is on his way to Bourne right now," Freya says. "He left as soon as the news of the victory arrived. I imagine we'll know the outcome of his Senate hearing once you've returned from your mission."
units.italian: "Tomek è in viaggio verso Bourne proprio ora," dice Freya. "È partito appena è arrivata la notizia della vittoria. Immagino che sapremo l'esito della sua udienza al Senato quando sarai tornato dalla missione."

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|	"What mission?" you ask.|2260|0
units.english: "What mission?" you ask.
units.italian: "Quale missione?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|	"Well, thanks to you, the Men system is no longer engaged in piracy," says JJ. "And that means the folks on Smuggler's Den are in need of new work. That station used to be a deuterium refinery. With a little work, it can be one, again."|2262|0
units.english: "Well, thanks to you, the Men system is no longer engaged in piracy," says JJ. "And that means the folks on Smuggler's Den are in need of new work. That station used to be a deuterium refinery. With a little work, it can be one, again."
units.italian: "Beh, grazie a te il sistema Men non è più impegnato nella pirateria," dice JJ. "E questo significa che la gente di Smuggler's Den ha bisogno di un nuovo lavoro. Quella stazione era una raffineria di deuterio. Con un po' di lavoro, può tornare a esserlo."

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|	"A working refinery could bring more income to that system than piracy ever did, and helping to repair it would show the people of Thule that we mean them no harm," says Freya. "Only problem is, the replacement parts are rare, and hard to come by. The Syndicate agreed to sell us the parts, but only if we meet them halfway, on <planet>. That's in the <system> system. Just one jump away from one of the major new Navy bases."|2263|0
units.english: "A working refinery could bring more income to that system than piracy ever did, and helping to repair it would show the people of Thule that we mean them no harm," says Freya. "Only problem is, the replacement parts are rare, and hard to come by. The Syndicate agreed to sell us the parts, but only if we meet them halfway, on <planet>. That's in the <system> system. Just one jump away from one of the major new Navy bases."
units.italian: "Una raffineria funzionante potrebbe portare a quel sistema più introiti di quanti ne abbia mai portati la pirateria, e aiutare a ripararla dimostrerebbe alla gente di Thule che non vogliamo far loro del male," dice Freya. "L'unico problema è che i pezzi di ricambio sono rari e difficili da trovare. Il Sindacato ha accettato di venderci i pezzi, ma solo se li incontriamo a metà strada, su <planet>. Che si trova nel sistema <system>. A un solo salto da una delle principali nuove basi della Marina."

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|	"We're going to take a supply convoy through Republic space?"|2265|0
units.english: "We're going to take a supply convoy through Republic space?"
units.italian: "Dobbiamo portare un convoglio di rifornimenti attraverso lo spazio della Repubblica?"

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|	"How do we know this isn't a trap?"|2267|0
units.english: "How do we know this isn't a trap?"
units.italian: "Come facciamo a sapere che non è una trappola?"

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|	"We don't," says Freya, "but the Syndicate has helped us before, and they are always willing to make deals. I don't think they're ready to give up on the chance to sell their wares to both sides in this war just yet."|2268|0
units.english: "We don't," says Freya, "but the Syndicate has helped us before, and they are always willing to make deals. I don't think they're ready to give up on the chance to sell their wares to both sides in this war just yet."
units.italian: "Non lo sappiamo," dice Freya, "ma il Sindacato ci ha già aiutati in passato, e sono sempre disposti a fare affari. Non credo che siano pronti a rinunciare alla possibilità di vendere le loro merci a entrambe le parti di questa guerra, non ancora."

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|	"Still, how do they expect us to get a convoy safely to Tundra?" you ask|2269|0
units.english: "Still, how do they expect us to get a convoy safely to Tundra?" you ask
units.italian: "Comunque, come pensano che possiamo portare un convoglio sano e salvo su Tundra?" chiedi

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|	"Not a convoy," says JJ. "Just you, Captain. It's only ten tons of spare parts. Your job is to fly to Tundra, retrieve the parts, and return here."|2271|0
units.english: "Not a convoy," says JJ. "Just you, Captain. It's only ten tons of spare parts. Your job is to fly to Tundra, retrieve the parts, and return here."
units.italian: "Non un convoglio," dice JJ. "Solo tu, Capitano. Sono appena dieci tonnellate di pezzi di ricambio. Il tuo compito è volare su Tundra, ritirare i pezzi e tornare qui."

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|	"I'll do my best."|2273|0
units.english: "I'll do my best."
units.italian: "Farò del mio meglio."

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|	"I hope this doesn't turn out to be a suicide mission."|2275|0
units.english: "I hope this doesn't turn out to be a suicide mission."
units.italian: "Spero che non si riveli una missione suicida."

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1|	"I hope so too," says Freya. "If your ship has enough fuel capacity, you might try flying over to the neutral territory of Dabih or Tarazed, and then up to Cebalrai from there, to avoid the worst of the Navy patrols. Good luck, Captain. If anyone can do it, you can."|2276|0
units.english: "I hope so too," says Freya. "If your ship has enough fuel capacity, you might try flying over to the neutral territory of Dabih or Tarazed, and then up to Cebalrai from there, to avoid the worst of the Navy patrols. Good luck, Captain. If anyone can do it, you can."
units.italian: "Lo spero anch'io," dice Freya. "Se la tua nave ha abbastanza capacità di carburante, potresti provare a volare fino al territorio neutrale di Dabih o di Tarazed, e da lì salire a Cebalrai, per evitare il grosso delle pattuglie della Marina. Buona fortuna, Capitano. Se qualcuno può farcela, quello sei tu."

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1A|name|2283|0
units.english: <planet> Repairs
units.italian: Riparazioni a <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1A|description|2284|0
units.english: Bring a shipment of special refinery equipment to <destination>.
units.italian: Porta una spedizione di equipaggiamento speciale per la raffineria su <destination>.

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1A|blocked|2288|0
units.english: You have reached <origin>, but you do not have ten tons of cargo space free for the equipment. Return here when you have made more space available.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <origin>, ma non hai dieci tonnellate di spazio cargo libere per l'equipaggiamento. Torna qui quando avrai liberato più spazio.

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1A|Your landing site is an abandoned settlement a thousand kilometers from <origin>'s main spaceport. It's an old oil field that ran dry decades ago, and only a few of the landing pads are still usable. The Syndicate employees quickly load the cargo onto your ship, and say, "Now, take off quickly, before the Navy sees us doing business with a ship flying Free Worlds colors."|2296|0
units.english: Your landing site is an abandoned settlement a thousand kilometers from <origin>'s main spaceport. It's an old oil field that ran dry decades ago, and only a few of the landing pads are still usable. The Syndicate employees quickly load the cargo onto your ship, and say, "Now, take off quickly, before the Navy sees us doing business with a ship flying Free Worlds colors."
units.italian: Il tuo luogo di atterraggio è un insediamento abbandonato a mille chilometri dallo spazioporto principale di <origin>. È un vecchio campo petrolifero prosciugato da decenni, e solo poche piazzole di atterraggio sono ancora utilizzabili. I dipendenti del Sindacato caricano in fretta il carico sulla tua nave e dicono: "Ora decolla in fretta, prima che la Marina ci veda fare affari con una nave che vola con i colori delle Free Worlds."

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1A|log|2304|0
units.english: Brought supplies to Smuggler's Den to help upgrade the station into a working deuterium refinery. No further orders from the Free Worlds, so this might be a good time to find ways to earn more money on the side.
units.italian: Hai portato rifornimenti a Smuggler's Den per aiutare ad aggiornare la stazione a una raffineria di deuterio funzionante. Nessun altro ordine dalle Free Worlds, quindi potrebbe essere un buon momento per trovare modi di guadagnare più soldi per conto tuo.

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1A|log|2305|0
units.english: Tomek was removed from the Council and placed under house arrest by the Senate after he disobeyed their orders and captured the pirate world of Greenrock rather than pursue the diplomatic solution that the Senate preferred.
units.italian: Tomek è stato rimosso dal Consiglio e posto agli arresti domiciliari dal Senato dopo aver disobbedito ai loro ordini e aver conquistato il mondo pirata di Greenrock invece di perseguire la soluzione diplomatica che il Senato preferiva.

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1A|After unloading the supplies, you send Freya and JJ a message letting them know that you arrived safely with the refinery equipment. Locals work alongside Free Worlds militia members to throw out the old, rusted hardware and install the new equipment. It will likely take a few days for everything to get up and running again, but the people of this system seem eager to get back to more honest work.|2307|0
units.english: After unloading the supplies, you send Freya and JJ a message letting them know that you arrived safely with the refinery equipment. Locals work alongside Free Worlds militia members to throw out the old, rusted hardware and install the new equipment. It will likely take a few days for everything to get up and running again, but the people of this system seem eager to get back to more honest work.
units.italian: Dopo aver scaricato i rifornimenti, mandi a Freya e JJ un messaggio per far sapere che sei arrivato sano e salvo con l'equipaggiamento della raffineria. La gente del posto lavora insieme ai membri della milizia delle Free Worlds per buttare via il vecchio hardware arrugginito e installare il nuovo. Ci vorranno probabilmente qualche giorno perché tutto riprenda a funzionare, ma la gente di questo sistema sembra impaziente di tornare a un lavoro più onesto.

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1A|	At the end of the day you receive a response from JJ. "Great work, Captain! This gesture will go a long way. With a great blow being dealt to the Navy, I doubt they'll come for us any time soon, and with our relationship with Thule repaired, I'm sure piracy will be at its lowest in years in this region. Thanks to our successes, we don't have any more work for you at the moment. We'll call upon you in the future when you're needed, but in the mean time you could help our officers with the occasional odd job. They've been posting on job boards around the Free Worlds looking for help from militia captains with spare time. Or you could just take time to relax if you need it. War can be taxing on the soul. Rest if you need to.|2308|0
units.english: At the end of the day you receive a response from JJ. "Great work, Captain! This gesture will go a long way. With a great blow being dealt to the Navy, I doubt they'll come for us any time soon, and with our relationship with Thule repaired, I'm sure piracy will be at its lowest in years in this region. Thanks to our successes, we don't have any more work for you at the moment. We'll call upon you in the future when you're needed, but in the mean time you could help our officers with the occasional odd job. They've been posting on job boards around the Free Worlds looking for help from militia captains with spare time. Or you could just take time to relax if you need it. War can be taxing on the soul. Rest if you need to.
units.italian: Alla fine della giornata ricevi una risposta da JJ. "Ottimo lavoro, Capitano! Questo gesto sarà molto utile. Con un duro colpo inferto alla Marina, dubito che verranno da noi presto, e con il nostro rapporto con Thule riparato, sono sicuro che la pirateria sarà al minimo da anni in questa regione. Grazie ai nostri successi, al momento non abbiamo altro lavoro per te. Ti chiameremo in futuro quando avremo bisogno di te, ma nel frattempo potresti aiutare i nostri ufficiali con qualche lavoretto occasionale. Hanno messo annunci nelle bacheche degli incarichi in giro per le Free Worlds cercando aiuto da capitani della milizia con tempo libero. Oppure potresti semplicemente prenderti un po' di tempo per riposarti, se ne hai bisogno. La guerra può pesare sull'anima. Riposa se devi.

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1A|	"Before I sign off, I should also mention that I've just learned of the Senate's decision on Tomek. He's been removed from the Council and placed under house arrest until further notice. Furthermore, the Senate has decided that the occupation of Greenrock will continue, at least for now. Although they disagree with Tomek's disobedience, it seems he convinced the Senate during his hearing that holding Greenrock would provide a tactical advantage. Let's pray that this is the right decision to make.|2309|0
units.english: "Before I sign off, I should also mention that I've just learned of the Senate's decision on Tomek. He's been removed from the Council and placed under house arrest until further notice. Furthermore, the Senate has decided that the occupation of Greenrock will continue, at least for now. Although they disagree with Tomek's disobedience, it seems he convinced the Senate during his hearing that holding Greenrock would provide a tactical advantage. Let's pray that this is the right decision to make.
units.italian: "Prima di chiudere, devo anche dirti che ho appena saputo della decisione del Senato su Tomek. È stato rimosso dal Consiglio e posto agli arresti domiciliari fino a nuovo ordine. Inoltre il Senato ha deciso che l'occupazione di Greenrock continuerà, almeno per ora. Anche se disapprovano la disobbedienza di Tomek, sembra che durante l'udienza li abbia convinti che tenere Greenrock offrirebbe un vantaggio tattico. Preghiamo che sia la decisione giusta.

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1A|	"Goodbye, Captain. Stay well."|2310|0
units.english: "Goodbye, Captain. Stay well."
units.italian: "Addio, Capitano. Stai bene."

units.id: mission:FW Refinery 1A|	After months of just traveling around following other people's orders, it feels odd to be left to your own devices for a change.|2311|0
units.english: After months of just traveling around following other people's orders, it feels odd to be left to your own devices for a change.
units.italian: Dopo mesi passati solo a girare seguendo gli ordini degli altri, sembra strano essere lasciato a te stesso, per cambiare.

units.id: mission:FW Rogue Elements|After you land, you notice that a sizable crowd has gathered around a video screen near the edge of the <origin> spaceport. You approach to find out what's going on. You're about to ask someone what's happening when you overhear Tomek's voice coming from the screen. You look up to see a video of Tomek standing atop a Free Worlds warship and addressing an unseen crowd.|2330|0
units.english: After you land, you notice that a sizable crowd has gathered around a video screen near the edge of the <origin> spaceport. You approach to find out what's going on. You're about to ask someone what's happening when you overhear Tomek's voice coming from the screen. You look up to see a video of Tomek standing atop a Free Worlds warship and addressing an unseen crowd.
units.italian: Dopo che atterri, noti che una folla considerevole si è radunata intorno a uno schermo video vicino al bordo dello spazioporto di <origin>. Ti avvicini per scoprire che cosa succede. Stai per chiedere a qualcuno che cosa stia accadendo quando senti la voce di Tomek uscire dallo schermo. Alzi lo sguardo e vedi un video di Tomek in piedi sopra una nave da guerra delle Free Worlds che si rivolge a una folla che non si vede.

units.id: mission:FW Rogue Elements|	"For generations we have been neglected by the Republic!" he shouts. "Our grievances were ignored! Our pain and suffering was ignored! Our needs were ignored! We cried out for help, and yet the Republic did nothing, allowing our planets to be ravaged by piracy while continuing to tax our credits for services we were not provided. And as the years have gone on the pirates have only become more and more emboldened.|2331|0
units.english: "For generations we have been neglected by the Republic!" he shouts. "Our grievances were ignored! Our pain and suffering was ignored! Our needs were ignored! We cried out for help, and yet the Republic did nothing, allowing our planets to be ravaged by piracy while continuing to tax our credits for services we were not provided. And as the years have gone on the pirates have only become more and more emboldened.
units.italian: "Per generazioni siamo stati trascurati dalla Repubblica!" grida. "Le nostre lamentele sono state ignorate! Il nostro dolore e la nostra sofferenza sono stati ignorati! I nostri bisogni sono stati ignorati! Abbiamo gridato aiuto, e la Repubblica non ha fatto nulla, lasciando che i nostri pianeti fossero devastati dalla pirateria mentre continuava a tassare i nostri crediti per servizi che non ci venivano forniti. E con il passare degli anni i pirati sono diventati sempre più audaci.

units.id: mission:FW Rogue Elements|	"We tried our best, even with the system stacked against us. Councilor Katya Reynolds and others like her spoke on the behalf of billions within the South, Rim, and Dirt Belt. On behalf of us. On behalf of our brothers and sisters, our fathers and mothers, our sons and daughters. And they spat in her face! And when they did that, they spat in our faces!|2332|0
units.english: "We tried our best, even with the system stacked against us. Councilor Katya Reynolds and others like her spoke on the behalf of billions within the South, Rim, and Dirt Belt. On behalf of us. On behalf of our brothers and sisters, our fathers and mothers, our sons and daughters. And they spat in her face! And when they did that, they spat in our faces!
units.italian: "Abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio, anche con il sistema schierato contro di noi. La consigliera Katya Reynolds e altri come lei hanno parlato a nome di miliardi di persone nel Sud, nel Bordo e nella Fascia di Terra. A nome nostro. A nome dei nostri fratelli e delle nostre sorelle, dei nostri padri e delle nostre madri, dei nostri figli e delle nostre figlie. E gli hanno sputato in faccia! E quando l'hanno fatto, hanno sputato in faccia a noi!

units.id: mission:FW Rogue Elements|	"And so we banded together. Friends and family locked in arms, doing that which the Republic would not. We looked out for each other, and raised our own defenses against the piracy that we so feared. And then we stood up together and told the Republic that we would take their neglect no longer. We shouted that the system does not work, and so we will create our own! We, with the sweat, blood, and tears of generations, birthed these Free Worlds!|2333|0
units.english: "And so we banded together. Friends and family locked in arms, doing that which the Republic would not. We looked out for each other, and raised our own defenses against the piracy that we so feared. And then we stood up together and told the Republic that we would take their neglect no longer. We shouted that the system does not work, and so we will create our own! We, with the sweat, blood, and tears of generations, birthed these Free Worlds!
units.italian: "E così ci siamo uniti. Amici e famiglie a braccetto, a fare quello che la Repubblica non faceva. Ci siamo presi cura gli uni degli altri e abbiamo eretto le nostre difese contro la pirateria che tanto temevamo. E poi ci siamo alzati insieme e abbiamo detto alla Repubblica che non avremmo più accettato la sua negligenza. Abbiamo gridato che il sistema non funziona, e quindi ne creeremo uno nostro! Noi, con il sudore, il sangue e le lacrime di generazioni, abbiamo partorito queste Free Worlds!

units.id: mission:FW Rogue Elements|	"And how does the Republic respond to this? They have finally given us the attention we've asked, but not in the form we desired. They have attacked us! Waged war on us! And in doing so, Katya has become a prisoner of war, held for crimes she did not commit by a system that did not listen to her despite her greatest attempts to be heard."|2334|0
units.english: "And how does the Republic respond to this? They have finally given us the attention we've asked, but not in the form we desired. They have attacked us! Waged war on us! And in doing so, Katya has become a prisoner of war, held for crimes she did not commit by a system that did not listen to her despite her greatest attempts to be heard."
units.italian: "E come risponde la Repubblica a questo? Finalmente ci hanno dato l'attenzione che chiedevamo, ma non nella forma che desideravamo. Ci hanno attaccati! Ci hanno fatto guerra! E così facendo Katya è diventata prigioniera di guerra, tenuta per crimini che non ha commesso da un sistema che non l'ha ascoltata nonostante i suoi più grandi sforzi di farsi sentire."

units.id: mission:FW Rogue Elements|	"Is this live?"|2336|0
units.english: "Is this live?"
units.italian: "È in diretta?"

units.id: mission:FW Rogue Elements|	"What's happening?"|2337|0
units.english: "What's happening?"
units.italian: "Che cosa sta succedendo?"

units.id: mission:FW Rogue Elements|	"I don't know," a man next to you says. "It was playing the news like usual when suddenly this came on."|2338|0
units.english: "I don't know," a man next to you says. "It was playing the news like usual when suddenly this came on."
units.italian: "Non lo so," dice un uomo accanto a te. "Stava trasmettendo le notizie come al solito quando all'improvviso è comparso questo."

units.id: mission:FW Rogue Elements|	You look back up to Tomek. "Yet even now our struggle does not end. Our new system is already beginning to fail us. I tell you now that the Free Worlds Senate has decided that instead of fighting piracy, they will negotiate with them instead! They will attempt to negotiate with those most known in this galaxy for lying and backstabbing and swindling. Those most known for not following the laws of the Republic, and who will undoubtedly refuse to follow the laws of these Free Worlds.|2339|0
units.english: You look back up to Tomek. "Yet even now our struggle does not end. Our new system is already beginning to fail us. I tell you now that the Free Worlds Senate has decided that instead of fighting piracy, they will negotiate with them instead! They will attempt to negotiate with those most known in this galaxy for lying and backstabbing and swindling. Those most known for not following the laws of the Republic, and who will undoubtedly refuse to follow the laws of these Free Worlds.
units.italian: Alzi di nuovo lo sguardo verso Tomek. "Eppure anche ora la nostra lotta non finisce. Il nostro nuovo sistema ha già cominciato a tradirci. Vi dico ora che il Senato delle Free Worlds ha deciso che, invece di combattere la pirateria, negozierà con essa! Tenteranno di negoziare con quelli che in questa galassia sono più noti per mentire, pugnalare alle spalle e truffare. Quelli più noti per non rispettare le leggi della Repubblica, e che senza dubbio si rifiuteranno di rispettare le leggi di queste Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:FW Rogue Elements|	"And so I make my plea to you, to those who fight for those who cannot, to join me in arms to give the pirates what they rightfully deserve! For inflicting so much pain upon us! For enslaving and killing our friends and family! For ruining our lives and businesses! For making us live in terror and fear! Who will join me to put an end to it all?"|2340|0
units.english: "And so I make my plea to you, to those who fight for those who cannot, to join me in arms to give the pirates what they rightfully deserve! For inflicting so much pain upon us! For enslaving and killing our friends and family! For ruining our lives and businesses! For making us live in terror and fear! Who will join me to put an end to it all?"
units.italian: "E così faccio appello a voi, a quelli che combattono per chi non può farlo, di unirvi a me in armi per dare ai pirati quello che si meritano! Per averci inflitto tanto dolore! Per aver ridotto in schiavitù e ucciso i nostri amici e le nostre famiglie! Per aver rovinato le nostre vite e le nostre attività! Per averci fatto vivere nel terrore e nella paura! Chi si unirà a me per mettere fine a tutto questo?"

units.id: mission:FW Rogue Elements|	The crowd on the video can be heard cheering, and some of the crowd around you even cheers along with them.|2341|0
units.english: The crowd on the video can be heard cheering, and some of the crowd around you even cheers along with them.
units.italian: Si sente la folla nel video acclamare, e persino alcuni della folla intorno a te si uniscono alle acclamazioni.

units.id: mission:FW Rogue Elements|	The screen then changes from the video of Tomek to a picture of a news clipping talking about Tomek's house arrest, with words flashing on the screen: "He fought for us, and for that they put him down." A symbol of three green wolves howling at a full moon appears, then the screen fades to black. A few seconds later the recording repeats, showing Tomek stepping up onto the top of a Free Worlds warship. "Captains and crew of the Free Worlds. Merchants of the Free Worlds. People of the Free Worlds. Please give me your attention. I have a plea, a cry for help that has gone unanswered.|2342|0
units.english: The screen then changes from the video of Tomek to a picture of a news clipping talking about Tomek's house arrest, with words flashing on the screen: "He fought for us, and for that they put him down." A symbol of three green wolves howling at a full moon appears, then the screen fades to black. A few seconds later the recording repeats, showing Tomek stepping up onto the top of a Free Worlds warship. "Captains and crew of the Free Worlds. Merchants of the Free Worlds. People of the Free Worlds. Please give me your attention. I have a plea, a cry for help that has gone unanswered.
units.italian: Lo schermo passa poi dal video di Tomek a un'immagine di un ritaglio di giornale che parla dei suoi arresti domiciliari, con parole che lampeggiano sullo schermo: "Ha combattuto per noi, e per questo lo hanno abbattuto." Compare un simbolo di tre lupi verdi che ululano a una luna piena, poi lo schermo si oscura. Pochi secondi dopo la registrazione si ripete, mostrando Tomek che sale sopra una nave da guerra delle Free Worlds. "Capitani ed equipaggi delle Free Worlds. Mercanti delle Free Worlds. Gente delle Free Worlds. Vi prego di darmi la vostra attenzione. Ho un appello, un grido d'aiuto rimasto senza risposta.

units.id: mission:FW Rogue Elements|	"For generations we have been neglected by the Republic! Our grievances..." The video continues as you saw it. You leave the crowd, not quite sure what to make of this situation.|2343|0
units.english: "For generations we have been neglected by the Republic! Our grievances..." The video continues as you saw it. You leave the crowd, not quite sure what to make of this situation.
units.italian: "Per generazioni siamo stati trascurati dalla Repubblica! Le nostre lamentele..." Il video continua come l'hai visto. Lasci la folla, non del tutto sicuro di che cosa pensare di questa situazione.
